prs.title: chore(vendor): Prologue SDK 换到 main 94ee1ea4（#42–#46：写后检查交回命令、命令 PATH 只用根外绝对项）；S-34 命令只在授权根之外找
prs.body:
换 Prologue 包：从上游 main `94ee1ea4` 打包（[Prologue #42](https://github.com/molis-ai/prologue/pull/42)–[#46](https://github.com/molis-ai/prologue/pull/46)），加 S-34：Agent 的命令只按裸名、只在授权根之外找，Molis 自己有断言拒绝的用例。只换包和加这一行，Molis 的代码不改；写后检查的 Molis 实现（采用 spec §6.0p）和手册线 C4 的 Molis 半边排在这之后。

分支 `adoption/sdk-after-write-check`，从 main `877dc7626` 开，合过 main `6505378e8`（#695）。

## 比上一份多的五项

| PR | 合并 / head | 改了什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| #42 | `3766ed52` / `67098790` | `dispatch-subagent` 的说明写清点名的角色和子任务的步骤对它能用的工具有什么影响。只改说明文字 |
| #43 | `68545af6` / `c4b1652b` | `search` 的说明写清它按文件内容找，不按文件名找。只改说明文字 |
| #44 | `1110049c` / `17436096` | 两台 Host 起命令时，`PATH` 只留授权根之外的绝对项（见下面 S-34） |
| #45 | `7b201ed5` / `f29a0ec5` | 写后检查改成执行器只回一条命令（JSON），SDK 核过、经命令审查去跑，事实拼进写入的观察；删全局开关 `config.workspace.diagnoseAfterWrite` |
| #46 | `94ee1ea4` / `ccd6a649` | `ask-user` 题目 `id` 的说明写出校验接受的格式。只改说明文字 |

## 对 Molis 的影响

1. **开发时根里的 `node_modules/.bin` 找不到了。** 起 Host 的进程，`PATH` 里的相对项和落在授权根里的目录都不再用：前台命令回 `exitCode` 为空的回执，后台和交互进程报 `COMMAND_FAILED`。用 pnpm 脚本起 Host 时，pnpm 会在 `PATH` 前面加 `node_modules/.bin`；授权根里若有它（例如 Coding 打开的就是本仓库），`tsc`、`vitest` 这类只装在仓库里的工具，Agent 的命令就找不到了。要用，就把工具装在授权根之外，再把那个绝对目录放进 Host 进程的 `PATH`。
2. **`config.workspace.diagnoseAfterWrite` 没有了。** Molis 从没设过它，`git grep` 只在 2026-10-02 的评审文档里找到。
3. **写后检查只在会话的包声明了它、又有执行器时才有。** Molis 没有一条会话的包声明 `coding.diagnose-after-write`，也没给 `coding.diagnostics` 执行器（创作台的编码 Agent 用自己的 `checkPack()`），所以写入的观察和换包前一样，一个字不加。Molis 自己的写后检查（[采用 spec](https://github.com/molis-ai/molis-work/blob/main/specs/prologue-adoption/spec.md) §6.0p）随后单独做。

## S-34：命令的 `PATH` 只用授权根之外的绝对项

`docs/system/SECURITY-INVARIANTS.md` 表里新加一行（统筹 10-17 定为正式一行，不放 §4）：Coding 在用户的机器上跑命令，这条边界 Molis 自己要有断言拒绝的用例，下次换包时 Prologue 那边若退回去，Molis 的 CI 要能红。

- **被拒绝的**：`.`、空项、相对项，以及落在任何一个已授权根里的绝对项（根本身、根里的目录、指进根的链接，按真实路径判断）；一项不剩时不给 `PATH`（给空串等于给一个空项，空项就是根）。模型写得进授权根，留着这些项，人批的 `fakecheck` 跑的就可能是根里模型改过的那一个。根外的绝对项照常找。
- **守在哪**：SDK 的两台 Host（[Prologue #44](https://github.com/molis-ai/prologue/pull/44)）：Node 的 `packages/sdk/src/host/plugin/node-command-env.ts`（`commandEnv`）与 Tauri 的 `crates/prologue-host-tauri/src/processes.rs`（`path_outside_roots`）；SDK 自己的拒绝用例是 `packages/sdk/test/host-command-path.test.ts` 与 `crates/prologue-host-tauri/tests/command_path.rs`。Molis 的 Agent 命令由 `horizontal/agent-host/src/adapters/prologue-node.ts` 起的 Node Host 跑，Tauri 那一台 Molis 不用。
- **用例**：`tests/security-invariants-command-path.test.ts`，照 S-13（`prologue-memory-boundary`）的写法：只经 `@molis-ai/molis-work-service-agent-host` 的公开出口（`createPrologueNodeAdapter`、`AgentReviewQueue`），不新开对 `@prologue/sdk` 的依赖；模型请求用 `fetch` 的替身，不出网。临时根里有 `project/fakecheck`、`project/bin/fakecheck`，根外有 `outside/fakecheck` 和指进 `project/bin` 的链接 `outside/linked-bin`。Agent 发 `run-command {executable: "fakecheck"}`，人在命令审查里批准，再看命令的结果回给模型的是谁：
  - 「S-34 a command finds its bare name in an absolute directory outside the root…」：`PATH` 是 `.:bin:<根>:<根>/bin:<根外>/linked-bin:<根外>:/usr/bin:/bin`，跑的是根外那个，根里的一个都没跑。
  - 「S-34 when every PATH entry leads into the root, the command gets no PATH…」：`PATH` 里只有 `.`、空项、`bin`、根、根里的目录、指进根的链接，命令找不到，根里的一个都没跑。
- **用例确实会红**：把装进来的包里 `commandEnv` 改成五种变体各跑一次（改完换回、核对 SHA-256 一致），每种都至少红一条：

  | 变体 | 结果 |
  | --- | --- |
  | 不过滤，`PATH` 原样给（#44 之前的行为） | 2 条都红 |
  | 只丢相对项，不查是否落在根里 | 2 条都红 |
  | 按字面比，不取真实路径（链接漏掉） | 2 条都红 |
  | 相对项也留着 | 2 条都红 |
  | 一项不剩时给空 `PATH` | 第 2 条红 |

  最后一种先活着：第一版用例总在后面加 `/usr/bin:/bin`，「一项不剩」从没发生。第 2 条改成只给落进根的项之后才红。
- 编号：#695 先合入、占了 S-33，这一行取 S-34，用例标题同号（统筹 10-17 定：谁后合入谁顺延，表里编号连续）。merge main 时表里只有这一处冲突，两行都留，S-33 在前。

## vendored 的记录（`vendor/prologue-sdk/`）

| 文件 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `prologue-sdk-0.0.0-rc.1-after-write-check.tgz` | 1,218,580 字节，SHA-256 `ba2507c9e02a11c4768d0234e67f9eb8b3ee3e93b9ce4ca026e05054f5a7448d`，integrity `sha512-wd9dSJiJGj86+LHcK59/rKmC7IcM+XWP/XWrnXe12arnZMjO1cNw8ZEIrOwOJBH47yFax92qRAl+g7A2FgKdBw==` |
| `….tgz.sha256` | `ba2507c9…  prologue-sdk-0.0.0-rc.1-after-write-check.tgz` |
| `….tgz.provenance.json` | `source.commit` = `94ee1ea4f48baf529b2ce624b8ee54acefb7bb7f`；`mergedUpstream` = #46（head `ccd6a649f95e69adf6e210afe55891c3c692597f`，2026-10-18T00:32:10Z），note 写明它叠在 #45、#44、#43、#42 之上；`dirty: false`，`patches: []`；`build`：Node 24.14.0、pnpm 11.9.0、darwin arm64，四步（`git archive 94ee1ea4` → `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline` → `pnpm --filter @prologue/sdk run build` → `pnpm pack`），`reproducedFrom` = `94ee1ea4`，`reproducedByteIdentical: true` |
| 旧包 `prologue-sdk-0.0.0-rc.1-parked-run.tgz` 及它的 `.sha256`、`.provenance.json` | 删掉 |
| `patch-history.json` → `packagesWithoutPatch` | 加第 27 条：旧包 `parked-run.tgz`，1,211,301 字节，SHA-256 `6f551e02050f85bb431aca88ac76ed67f0495b2c606e5e60b3e1c2625a9e61e2`，git blob `da38441c019b12a2aa7ebf768be2c4ef32d8172c`，来源 `b541a8e62752fce23c83f959d55e549b3086557f`，说明被哪一份替换、怎样从 Git 历史取回 |
| `patch-history.json` → `upstream` | `mainHead` = `94ee1ea4`；`statement` 改成对 `94ee1ea4` 逐项复核（`git merge-base --is-ancestor`，除三个已知的过渡包来源外都是祖先）；`commitsChecked` 加 `94ee1ea4`（36 → 37） |
| `README.md` | 「当前依赖：after-write-check」一节：字节数、SHA-256、上游提交，多的五项，对 Molis 的三条影响，验证；上一份降为「上一份：parked-run」；计数 26 → 27、36 → 37 |

`tests/vendor-provenance.test.ts` 跟着改：当前包名、`source.commit`、`mergedUpstream.pullRequest` 46、`packagesWithoutPatch` 27 条且最后一条是 parked-run、`commitsChecked` 37 条。`horizontal/agent-host/package.json`、`scripts/workspace-packages.mjs`、`pnpm-lock.yaml` 指向新文件；SECURITY-INVARIANTS 里 S-13 那条写的当前包名和上游提交跟着改。

## 四个问题

- **取消与迟到的结果**：Molis 没有新的等待或提交路径。写后检查在 Molis 里不触发（影响 3）；#45 里写后检查的取消（解析时、答完后、命令跑着时）由 SDK 自己的用例钉住。
- **半提交的状态**：这一片不产生。
- **哪个用例会变红**：
  - S-34 的两条：上表五种变体，每种至少红一条；退回 #44 之前的行为（上表第一种），两条都红。
  - `tests/vendor-provenance.test.ts`：包和它的记录有任何不符就红。
  - S-13 的 `prologue-memory-boundary` 在新包上再过一次，伪标记中和若在新包里丢了就红。
- **公共面**：合同、动作、MCP 工具名、页面资源都没变；`tooling/gates/actions/` 不变。

## 防腐复查

- 不加读取兜底，不加迁移；只有一份 vendored 包，旧包删掉并记录。
- 不改门禁、limits、例外和基线。SECURITY-INVARIANTS 只加一行，测试文件按 `tests/security-invariants-*.test.ts` 命名，由 `test:security` 现有的 glob 收进去，不改脚本。
- 新用例只用 agent-host 的公开出口，不新开对 `@prologue/sdk` 的依赖。
- Molis 代码不改，所以没有第二份 PATH 规则：规则只在 SDK 的两台 Host 里。

## 验证

- SDK 在 `94ee1ea4`（干净归档）上：
  - `tsc -p tsconfig.typecheck.json` 和 build 通过；
  - 不含 live 的 SDK 用例 208 个文件、2849 条通过、无类型错误；live 只单独跑了 `coding-diagnose-after-write.live`（1 条过，只用本机 node，不出网、不要密钥），别的 live 没跑；
  - 13 个消费者脚本在干净安装里对这个包全过；
  - 打两次，字节数与 SHA-256 相同；
  - 没有付费的模型请求，没有操作真实桌面。
- Molis（合过 main `6505378e8` 之后）：
  - `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline`、`pnpm build` 通过；
  - 相关的非浏览器文件 238/238，5.1 分钟：`prologue-*`、`agent-*`、`assistant-*`、`coding-*`、`interaction-*`、`security-invariants-*`、创作台的非浏览器部分、`vendor-provenance`，`affected-tests` 另选的，加上 #695 改过的非浏览器用例；
  - `pnpm test:security` 63/63（含 S-34 与 #695 的 S-33），`pnpm test:contracts` 44/44（动作合同快照没有变化）；
  - S-34 的五种变体见上表（在合 main 之前跑的；#695 在 `prologue-node.ts` 只给 `answerPending` 多传一个参数，没动起 Host 和起命令的路径，合后 S-34 两条照旧过）；
  - `check-health-gates --base origin/main`、`page-assets --base origin/main`、`boundary:check`、`verify-release-versions`、`secrets:check` 都过。
- 没跑：浏览器用例和全量（交统筹排）。

prs.title: feat(context): a side panel plugin tab reports what is in hand, as a split pane does (W3-C, AC-S04)
prs.body:
W3-C of the context program (specs/context-program §21.4, §21.6; specs/side-shelf AC-S04): a plugin's tab in the side panel reports what is in hand, as a split pane does. 统筹 approved the plan on 10-18 and set the conditions: reuse the existing side-frame check, add no new message type, put the S-30 row and its refusal test in this PR, and name AC-S04.

## What changes

1. **The side tab's document runs the pane half of the context actions.**
   - `context-actions.ts` splits its factory into the part a surface's own document runs (`PANE_PART`: the DOM selection reader, the naming of an opened item, and, embedded, the toolbar it draws for the top document) and the top document's part (bar, bus, landing).
   - The workbench page's factory is the same text as before: `PANE_PART`, then the top part.
   - `CONTEXT_PANE_FACTORY_SCRIPT` is `PANE_PART` alone. `side-view-document.ts` runs it inside its existing S-30 block, with the same `PANE_MESSAGES_SCRIPT` it already makes.
   - `embedded` now also covers `[data-side-view]` (the side document's body), so a side tab draws its own toolbar and posts `workbench-surface-focus` up, exactly as a split pane.
2. **The page's context bus takes these messages only from a side panel plugin frame.**
   - The side-frame check is pulled out of `SIDE_FORWARD_SCRIPT` into `SIDE_FRAME_FROM_SCRIPT`, unchanged. `SIDE_FORWARD_SCRIPT.from` is now that expression, and the bus uses the same one. There is no second check.
   - The bus's message handler accepts a split pane frame (as before) or a side panel plugin frame. Everything else is dropped as before: other origins, the page itself, other frames, and popups.
   - For a frame's focus, the top marks where it is with `landing.place(frame)`: `place: "side"` and `side_tab` (the same rule as for a surface in the top document's side panel). A `place` the frame reports is overwritten. `pane_id` is `side`.
   - Choices, hold, dismiss, summon, ✦ and unhandled choices use the split pane's existing messages. No message type is added.
3. **What follows from that (AC-S04):**
   - The left's landing applies to a passage in the side tab: the bar offers 「插入到光标处」.
   - A selection on the left takes the bar back to the left.
   - Closing the panel hides the frame; the bus drops what was in hand as it does for any surface that went out of sight, and the tab's bar goes.

**Not done (follow-up):** hovering 「放进去」 on a frame's bar does not flash the landing on the left. A split pane's bar does not either today: the hold message a pane sends carries only the bar's keys, not its menu's.

## S-30

- **Row:** the S-30 row in `docs/system/SECURITY-INVARIANTS.md` now covers the side tab's in-hand messages. It names `SIDE_FRAME_FROM_SCRIPT` as the one side-frame check, says the place is marked by the page and not read from the frame, and lists the new test and e2e.
- **Refusal test:** `tests/security-invariants-pane-messages.test.ts` 「S-30 AC-S04 a workbench-surface-focus that is not from a side panel plugin frame (or a split pane) is dropped: nothing is asked, no toolbar」.
  - It runs the shipped `CONTEXT_ACTIONS_FACTORY_SCRIPT` on a small page port.
  - A focus from these sources is dropped: a same-origin frame that is not a side tab, the page itself, a window that is not a frame here, and the Shelf frame from four other origins. For each, no `/api/contextual/` call is made, no frame is told to draw, and the page draws no toolbar.
  - From the Shelf frame, the request carries `pane_id: "side"`, `place: "side"` and `side_tab: "plugin:shelf/side"`, and only that frame is told to draw.
  - Mutation check: with the handler loosened to accept any frame, the test fails on the first refused case.
- **Export:** `CONTEXT_ACTIONS_FACTORY_SCRIPT` (and `SIDE_FRAME_FROM_SCRIPT`) are exported from `@molis-ai/molis-work-app-workbench` for that test, as `PANE_MESSAGES_SCRIPT` is. This is an app package, not a contract or SDK export.
- `pnpm test:security`: 63 of 63 files pass.

## Tests

- **New browser test:** `tests/side-shelf-in-hand.e2e.test.ts` (W3-C AC-S04), with Pages open on the left with its cursor placed, and a text material opened in Shelf's side tab. It checks:
  - A passage selected in the tab gets the bar in the tab's own document. The bar is beside the passage and inside the tab; the top document draws none.
  - The top document's request marks it `side` / `plugin:shelf/side` / `shelf_item`.
  - 「插入到光标处」 is offered.
  - Selecting on the left takes the bar there.
  - Selecting in the tab again takes it back. Closing the panel hides both.
- **Updated:**
  - `tests/pages-surface-naming.test.ts`: its page stub's `body` gains `matches()`, because the factory now asks `body.matches(...)`. No assertion changed.
  - `tests/page-assets-budget.test.ts`: the allowance test follows the new entry (see above).
- **Affected set (`affected-tests` against main), plus the split-pane, landing and Shelf-side e2e:**
  - Unit: 95 files. 94 passed on the first run. `page-assets-budget` pinned receipts 3d-4's ceiling entry, which this PR replaces. Its bounded-allowance test now covers W3-C's entry (+273 from 1,110,187, one byte more fails, other assets frozen), and 1109913 joins the spent list. It passes 72/72.
  - Browser: 30 files, five at a time. 26 passed. Four failed with "Navigation did not finish" under load: `assistant-send-intent`, `model-first-setup`, `request-failure-call-id` and `workbench-browser-targets`. All four pass when run one at a time. None of them reads the files this PR changes.
- **Screenshots** (`.impeccable/qa/review/side-shelf-in-hand/`, not committed): 1440, 1024, 800, 390 and 1440 dark. At every width the bar sits under the selected passage inside the Shelf tab; at 390 the panel is the lower sheet and the bar fits in it.
- **Gates:** `check-health-gates --base origin/main`, `boundary:check`, `dom-events`, `security-invariants-doc` and `secrets:check` pass. `page-assets --base origin/main` passes with the entry below.
- Full suite: 统筹 decides (`full-suite`).

## Bytes

| Asset | main 4bea52c84 | This PR |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| `/assets/molis-work-workbench.js` | 1,110,187 | 1,110,460 (+273) |

- **Why it grows.** The page's bus now ships the side-frame check, the second copy in this script (the side panel's own listener has the first). It also marks the focus's place. The side tab's own half runs in the side document (inline HTML, not a measured asset), not in `workbench.js`.
- **What I tried.** Shortening the shared check's names saves about 40 bytes, but makes a security check read less plainly, so I did not do it.
- **Approval needed.** Admitted once in `APPROVED_CEILINGS` (`scripts/gates/page-assets.mjs`) for exactly this merge-base budget. It replaces receipts 3d-4's spent entry. **This needs your review (统筹).**
- Nothing else changed size.

## Effects on callers

- **`@molis-ai/molis-work-app-workbench` exports:** `CONTEXT_ACTIONS_FACTORY_SCRIPT` and `SIDE_FRAME_FROM_SCRIPT` are added, for tests. These are not contract or SDK exports, so they are not in the API snapshot.
- **Messages:** the bus's handling of the existing split-pane messages now also accepts a side panel plugin frame. No message type, DOM event or stored value is added or changed.
- **Plugins:** a plugin's side view that declares `data-assistant-context` now gets the toolbar for a DOM selection, like its other views. Shelf already declares it.

## 防腐复查 (§3)

- **One place for each rule.**
  - The side-frame check exists once (`SIDE_FRAME_FROM_SCRIPT`), used by `molis:side-forward` and the bus.
  - The pane half of the context actions exists once (`PANE_PART`), run by split panes and side tabs.
  - The side-panel place is marked by one rule (`landing.place`).
- **Security boundary.** S-30 is widened only by naming one more kind of frame, through the existing check. The row and a refusal test on the shipped code are in this PR, with a mutation check. The page marks the place itself and does not trust the frame's.
- **No compatibility kept.** Nothing was renamed.
- **DOM events.** None added; `dom-events` passes.
- **Numbers that only fall.** Health passes against main. `context-bus.ts` changed one line's content and no lines were added. Page assets: +273 once, explained above for review.
- **No assertion loosened.** The only edit to an existing test adds a missing DOM method to a stub.

prs.title: 统一输入与本地语音：补齐草稿、录音及桌面验收路径
prs.body:
## 解决的问题

首页、助手和 Coding 采用一致的多行输入、本地语音、键盘发送和状态反馈。Enter 换行，Command/Ctrl+Enter 发送；草稿、上下文和迟到结果始终归原入口与工作，确认接收后才清空，未知回执保留待确认且不重复提交。

- 修复刷新空值覆盖草稿、切工作后迟到回执清错内容、Coding 配置恢复与可用状态不同步；失败重试恢复原回合的完整附件及多行原文，读取迟到不覆盖另一工作的新草稿。
- 输入框随正文增长并内部滚动，材料与下一步行实际占位；窄窗口中的面板标题、录音、发送和键盘焦点可用，同时修复相关侧栏、ToDo、成果预览和 Jelly 提示遮挡。
- 本地识别支持真实浏览器 AAC；修复默认英语提示干扰短中文、原生日志污染 JSON、取消后 helper 残留，以及构建沿软链接覆盖其他检出。下载后明确显示模型准备阶段，支持取消和重试，不静默改用云端。
- 修复侧栏浏览器异步绑定项目时丢弃导航；绑定按顺序完成，导航和停止仍可并发。

## 验证

- 当前提交 `2a5371d0a2c772f74dc7d41b959cc2d0fae817c0`：[普通 CI](https://github.com/molis-ai/molis-work/actions/runs/39065654952)、[Full suite](https://github.com/molis-ai/molis-work/actions/runs/39065891367) 全部通过。Full suite 16 分片及汇总成功，1041 个 Linux 文件均纳入，没有失败后重试；条件跳过仍按平台、外部凭据和 opt-in 分开记录。
- 缺陷回归先在旧实现失败，再在修复后通过；保持原有业务断言、重试次数与门禁。最后一处仅调整 Coding 回执测试的模型夹具：核对中间送达提示后才结束回复，避免正常完成状态抢先替换提示；仍核对唯一输入、持久化回执、打断标记、撤回与更正。
- 29 个 macOS 专项已由本机集成批次覆盖；语音另用系统禁网的最终 helper 补验。最新工作台相关 20/20 文件、健康门禁、类型与逐提交密钥扫描通过。页面资源 25 项、7,478,823 字节，未提高预算。
- 最终 macOS App 核对生产源码指纹、实际运行程序与独立 Home 后实操：失败后恢复四行原文及完整附件，窄窗键盘路径，A/B 草稿隔离，退出重启后的 owner 数据，双按唯一发送，Coding 503 后继续，侧栏网页导航和点击。首页未知回执重启后保留且重复检查不重发；另一多行消息只被指定会话接收一次，成功后清空。模型回复和 Codex 接收端使用本机夹具。
- 停止点击到文字插入后绘制帧：固定中文合成样本、真实 AAC、正式 HTTP、禁网 helper，新模型路径首次 **46.796 秒**，同路径重复 **1.631 / 1.632 秒**。正常首次准备含下载与预热为 106.47 秒，之后三次为 1.682 / 1.683 / 1.732 秒。约 47 秒主要是首次模型加载/编译；冷热差异不作为同条件提速或真人体验证明。

## 合同与完成边界

新增受现有本机鉴权保护的 `/api/local-voice` 入口（根与项目路径），仅在明确确认后下载模型；识别复用本机材料 helper，取消终止该次进程并清理临时音频。安全不变量及拒绝断言同步维护。

材料预览 HTTP 读口新增可选 `run` 参数，读取同一 owner 指定原回合的完整已保存正文；默认预览、鉴权和材料大小限制不变。未改动作 schema、Manifest 格式或 MCP 工具名。

尚不判定 spec 的“内部完整”：系统中文候选窗、原生麦克风授权与真实录音/拔插、代表性中英混说和技术词等识别质量、VoiceOver 听感及主观体验仍为 UNVERIFIED。准确性、可接受等待与单次时长阈值须经代表性实测确认。

保持草稿 PR；未合并、公证或发布。候选 App、测试 Home 和运行日志仅保留本地。

prs.title: feat(connectors): 让助理统一接入服务并按最新任务续办
prs.body:
## 行为

个人助理可复用已有连接，或从对话准备远程 MCP、受管本地 MCP、API 和 CLI 接入。需要本人登录或填凭据时给出受保护入口；原任务由 SDK 持久等待，连接就绪后按最新要求继续业务操作。取消、改为只读、换目标、撤权、停用和重启均沿原事实 owner 处理。

连接管理分别显示配置、最近技术检查、当前授权、业务能力与使用位置。Coding 添加的连接可由有权限的助理复用；Home 与项目范围隔离。安装使用固定来源与受管目录，失败保留已有连接和业务成果。

唯一需求与证据：[spec](https://github.com/molis-ai/molis-work/blob/1ab2f29f385ef2ccdec92ba1f3eca280dc9a12d2/specs/assistant-service-connections/spec.md)、[coverage](https://github.com/molis-ai/molis-work/blob/1ab2f29f385ef2ccdec92ba1f3eca280dc9a12d2/specs/assistant-service-connections/coverage.md)、[真实模型诊断](https://github.com/molis-ai/molis-work/blob/1ab2f29f385ef2ccdec92ba1f3eca280dc9a12d2/specs/assistant-service-connections/model-diagnosis.md)。

## 当前集成与评审修订

最新 head：`1ab2f29f385ef2ccdec92ba1f3eca280dc9a12d2`，已同步 main `a19524f58185d1fe4afc085d3fec36931115a102`，包含 #634、#709 及 #711。安全表保留主线 S-35，本功能安装/跨入口 MCP 顺延为 S-36、接入意图为 S-37，文档与测试同步。

- 移除 HubSpot 的受管安装和下载源许可：官方安装脚本忽略指定版本、只取 `latest`，版本页没有二进制附件。已有 CLI 登录、账号检查和业务读取保留；准备受管安装在下载前明确拒绝。
- 旧 HTTP MCP 的 Prologue `credential_ref` 登记到防腐 spec §4.1，归维护八与 connectors 库 1→2 同次处理。用户接受 Images MCP v1→v2 改名，影响见下。
- 补充 Java/Ruby/Perl loader 环境变量拒绝项、无权限重连错误码断言，并说明 Graph 模块仅固定版本、没有额外摘要校验。
- 保留 Gmail/Notion 旧回调、通用 API/Gmail/Notion/MCP 迟到刷新修复：授权开始时固定连接修订，写入前同步复查。主线回执、重启回答和被拒移动的恢复规则保持当前语义。

## 验证

- 本轮审查修订在合 main 前完成 **66 个文件、526 项通过，无跳过**，包含 Local Host 必跑、HubSpot 零下载拒绝、既有 CLI、stdio 环境拒绝、外部 MCP 撤权及安装安全。它不替代以下新基线回归。
- 新基线 **110 文件、836 项全部通过，0 跳过、0 失败**：107 个非浏览器文件、824 项；3 个 Chrome 文件、12 项（Coding 首次读取 4、交互隔离 3、助理发送意图 5）。不与合 main 前批次重复相加。
- 新基线整体构建、API/动作快照、包边界、基于 `a19524f58` 的健康快查更新均通过。25 项资源实测 **7,475,502 字节**；`workbench.js` **1,110,116**，比 main 的 **1,110,187** 少 71 字节；没有提高预算或加门禁例外。
- 推送前差异格式及密钥扫描通过（10,081 行）。**当前 head 的[常规 CI](https://github.com/molis-ai/molis-work/actions/runs/39101469929) 已全部通过。** 上一 head `1d1a44944` 的[常规 CI](https://github.com/molis-ai/molis-work/actions/runs/39098989048) 13 个执行作业全部通过、产品子集 393/393；该结果只作历史证据。
- 先前集成批次去重 93 文件、775 项（含 13 个 Chrome 文件、25 项）通过；旧结果按覆盖表保留。真实 MiniMax-M3 已验证远程 MCP 读取/保存 Pages、等待中改只读且零写入、Token/CLI、官方 npm/Python、本机 HTTP 及 Coding 复用，模型累计 **663/680**，本轮未新增调用。
- 统筹已复核这个 head 并启动 [chain51 full-suite](https://github.com/molis-ai/molis-work/actions/runs/39101618084)。分片 3 的真实 Python 安装用例因 runner 缺少 uv 失败，已复现并提交独立 [CI 修复 #715](https://github.com/molis-ai/molis-work/pull/715)；本 PR head 不变，补齐依赖后的全量仍待统筹安排。整体不宣称内部完整。

## 合同与数据维护

- Connector 增加状态、使用位置、CLI 接入与环境字段；Agent Host 增加 MCP 刷新/派出观察及 owner 只读等待端口。卡片增加结果展示，停止工作可明确保留连接。
- 新增 19 项 Host 动作，共同目录一次登记；`images.connections.list` 从 v1 升 v2，所有消费者、Skill、手册与快照同步。公开类型新增字段无单独版本号；外部 MCP 工具名由 `images.connections.list__v1` 改为 `images.connections.list__v2`，旧名停用，用户已于 10-18 接受，外部调用方须改用新名。
- Gmail 协议包保存刷新令牌前同步调用宿主 `beforePersist`，连接事实仍归 Host。
- connectors 库基线 1→2 已在[维护清单](https://github.com/molis-ai/molis-work/blob/1ab2f29f385ef2ccdec92ba1f3eca280dc9a12d2/specs/repository-anti-corruption/spec.md)登记；隔离副本维护与恢复已演练。真实 Home 归维护八，随安装新构建另取当次授权；不先用新构建开旧库，不给旧构建开维护后的库，不加入运行时迁移或读取兼容。
- `CONNECTOR_TOOLS_HOME_STORE` 归 Local Host 受管工具安装器。[HOME-DATA §6.3](https://github.com/molis-ai/molis-work/blob/1ab2f29f385ef2ccdec92ba1f3eca280dc9a12d2/docs/system/HOME-DATA.md)写明安装清单/锁文件与连接引用同一时点备份、原路径恢复、共享运行时与缓存、引用/所有权检查后清理，以及普通卸载保留、purge 清除。

## 对用户的影响

- 已通过 `replace-secret` 保存、仍引用 Prologue `credential_ref` 的 HTTP MCP 配置，在升级时须归维护八迁成 Host 连接；无法恢复凭据的，由用户升级后重新填写或选择已有连接。维护与 connectors 库 1→2 同次进行，真实 Home 尚未核对或修改。
- HubSpot 官方只提供可变 `latest` 下载，已移除受管安装；已有 `hubspot` CLI 仍可登录、检测账号与读取业务数据。原安装实操保留为历史证据，不算现行固定版本安装通过。
- Graph 模块经 PSGallery 固定版本，未另核文件摘要；这与原生发行物的摘要校验保证不同。

## 防腐复查

按评论引用的 ANTI-CORRUPTION-REVIEW §3，对 `a19524f58...1ab2f29f385ef2ccdec92ba1f3eca280dc9a12d2` 的差异自查；这是主代理自查，独立评审待统筹。逐项依据在 spec §11「PR #661 评论复查」。

| 条目 | 结论 |
| --- | --- |
| 1、15 | 仅现行 schema，表由原 owner 读写；连接库副本维护已演练，旧 HTTP MCP 凭据维护登记待执行，真实 Home 未动。 |
| 2、3、4 | 动作只登记一次，各入口走共同目录与调用编号；可信身份来自上下文，外部等待 concurrent，提交前检查权限、修订与最新意图。取消/撤权/迟到结果有拒绝回归。 |
| 5、6、7 | 包边界通过；模型与 SDK 只在 agent-host，未改 kernel，未新增插件实现互相依赖。 |
| 8、9 | 连接、协议、安装、等待分别归原 owner；合并引入的 152 行函数已拆分，巨大单元总数和相关大小下降。 |
| 10、11、12 | 未新增插件专用宿主路径或整页；新增合同同次有真实调用方与用例，形状变化的已版本化动作升版。 |
| 13、19 | API、动作、健康快查、页面预算从合并后的构建重新生成；资源相对新 main 只降。 |
| 14、16 | 新错误沿 owner 工厂和 SDK 状态映射；沿现行命名，无新 Error 子类或旧名。 |
| 17 | S-27 同时保留 owner 等待与工作授权；保留 main S-31—S-35，安装/接入意图顺延 S-36/S-37，安全测试同步。 |
| 18、20、21 | 沿现有登记事件、所属词典和设置请求助手；门禁无缺译、无新增原始 fetch。 |
| 22、23 | 新测试用公开入口、保留原断言，ASC 编号与验收对应，产品子集加入快用例；full-suite 由统筹安排。 |
| 24、25 | 使用 main 当前唯一统一 SDK，vendor/锁文件相对 main 无差异；冲突保留双方语义并重跑门禁。 |
| 26、27 | 仅本功能分支；未改 CI、门禁脚本、阈值、允许/例外/隔离名单。安全命令只增加 OAuth 拒绝回归。 |

## 评审范围

用户 10-18 已决定保留 #661 为一个集成 PR，不拆分。统筹按三组完整行为审查：① 连接生命周期、协议状态与凭据竞争；② 受管安装及本人操作入口；③ 助理接入、最新意图及跨入口接续。修订最终 head 后由统筹复核并安排一次 full-suite，后续入队由统筹管理。

## 尚未验证

prs.title: feat(runtime): stream plugin route progress with cancellation (W5-01)
prs.body:
## 做了什么

Runtime 插件可在 POST 路由声明 `stream: "ndjson"`，经共同动作服务实时报告进度，Host 写唯一的结果或错误末行。Home 与项目共用传输；HTTP 断开、停用、撤权、升级后结束等待，迟到的处理器、模型文字和结果均不能继续交付或写业务记录。对应唯一 spec 的 RAC-20–24。

前置为 #684（Todo Runtime）。本草稿暂以 `feature/w5-01-todo-runtime` 为基线，只展示流式路由这一片，供先行审阅。#684 合入后移到实际 main、改基线并启动正式 CI；不加全量标签、不自行合并。当前目标分支不匹配仓库 CI 的 main 过滤条件，草稿上的本地验证不能代替正式 CI。

## 验证

- [x] 在 Todo `8738385e395f229a72ef473fa67f6bbf757c9f69` 上重放本片四个提交，检查最终差异；业务实现无冲突，需求书状态句保留最新状态。
- [x] `pnpm build`、`pnpm workspace:build`、`pnpm boundary:check`、`node scripts/check-health-gates.mjs --base origin/main` 通过。
- [x] 页面资源同时对 main merge-base `8fcff0442` 与 Todo 候选检查通过：25 项共 7,479,372 B，本片增量 0 B。
- [x] 当前组合的包要求与安全回归：162 个非浏览器文件、1,538 条通过、1 条原有沙箱环境条件跳过；`tests/plugin-sample.e2e.test.ts` 经真实 Chrome 通过 1 条。合计 163 文件、1,539 条通过、1 条跳过、0 失败。
- [x] `pnpm secrets:check` 通过；推送时复查。
- [ ] 共享核心全量：交统筹在 CI 排，本机不跑全量。
- 先前切片的 150 文件、安全拒绝、真实 HTTP 及 Chrome 结果保留在 spec 中；不将旧基点结果称为当前组合通过。

## 公开合同与 API 影响

三份公开快照随源码更新：`contracts/platform/actions`、`contracts/platform/plugin`、`plugin-sdk/index`。新增可选路由 `stream`、请求 `emit`、共同 NDJSON 行类型、动作客户端第四个 `transport` 参数、模型 `onText` 与 SDK 进度上限常量；现有 JSON 路由与未传新参数的调用保持现行行为。Host、Runtime 与 SDK 同片接通，可信 execution 对象身份保持；无动作 schema、版本或 MCP 工具名变化。浏览器统一读流器在后续灵光迁移片接入。

进度每行至多 65,536 B、最多 10,000 行且总计 1,048,576 B；超限取消并返回 `actions.output_invalid`，插件不能伪造最终结果。按用户已批准决定，只有显式声明 `max_body_bytes` 的路由可用至多 36,000,000 B，未声明的默认上限不变，超一字节先拒绝为 JSON 413。S-03、S-18、插件 Skill 与手册同步。

## 只许减少的数字与基本合同

健康门禁无增长；Runtime 停止请求同步撤销当前 activation 的授权和动作注册，原队列负责清理，巨大类少一行。身份取自 Host 上下文；能力仍只注册一次；等待后的业务写入仍经原 `beforeEffect()`；模型调用沿现有 Agent Host 端口。没有新增页面资源、包、依赖、存储结构或安全编号。

同途 #701 也改 `platform/plugin.ts`、PluginRuntime、SDK Manifest 与 API 快照，但当前改动位置不同。后合一方按实际 main 整合并重建快照；不带入 #701 的功能。最终完整 head 与验证结果在本聊天交用户转达统筹。

prs.body:
Todo 现在由 Home Plugin Runtime 启动，所有项目共用同一个个人待办库。项目页面的「转为待办」、待办整理与生成后的应用都走插件公开动作；停用或取消时，等待模型的调用不会写入整理结果。旧原生路由和提供方接线已删除。

## 行为与调用方

- `createTodoPlugin` 使用 `services.database` 和 `services.model`，写入先检查 `beforeEffect`。库仍在 `{home}/todo/todo.db`，schema/version 1 保持，不需要维护真实 Home。
- 16 条路由改用 `/api/plugins/io.molis.work.todo/…`，仓库内调用方已同步。项目身份来自页面路径的可信上下文，忽略 body 中的项目字段。旧 `/api/todo` 与短别名已移除。
- Home Runtime 视图获得当前页面的转义和翻译入口，Todo 舞台只挂载一次。声明的 `max_body_bytes` 生效：Todo 维持 1,000,000 B，未声明的 Home 路由维持 12 MiB。
- 动作输入输出、版本、提供方、MCP 工具名、工作流程步骤和 Skill 保持；动作合同快照通过。相对 main 没有 contracts/SDK 公开 API 快照变化。

## 整合与资源

通过 merge 纳入 main `4bea52c84`，未变基，合并提交 `dfcb0439f`。本轮冲突仅为资源许可、对应测试及资源派生表，Todo 业务源码与此前冻结的 `f7fffda2e` 相同。主线 Shelf、回执和放置变更保留。

| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| workbench.js | 1,110,187 B | 1,110,215 B | +28 B |
| todo.js | 62,081 B | 62,036 B | −45 B |

+28 B 来自「转为待办」的完整插件路由，用户已批准；按当前 merge-base 定为 `[1110187, 1110215]`。#706 的既有许可和 Todo 都使用同一个资源键；#706 已合 main，故其旧起点和上限转为再次增长拒绝回归，全部旧拒绝保留，活动许可仅 Todo 这一条。多一字节、其他资源增长、再次使用均拒绝。25 项资源总计 7,475,589 B，比 main 少 17 B。

## 验证

- 本轮整体/workspace 构建、边界、正式资源实测及更新、完整 merge-base health/API（64 份快照、2,506 项声明）全部通过；推送前重新 fetch main，提交密钥扫描 915 行通过。

本片只完成 W5-01 的 Todo 样板，整条防腐任务仍在推进。#703 是依赖本片的流式路由草稿，Todo 合入后直接接实际 main；其余候选保持本地准备，在途至多两片。

prs.title: fix(coding)+test(interaction): two tabs answer one question; Coding's late answer is refused with a code (AC-08); AC-11 row
prs.body:
AC-08 (specs/ai-interaction-experience): two browser tabs answer the same question at once, in the Assistant and in Coding. The AC-11 row is also rewritten to match how things stand now. **The AC-08 test found a product defect in Coding, fixed in its own commit (1ae3b907f).** Because of that fix, this PR needs the full suite, not merge-only.

## The defect (commit 1ae3b907f)

Once the first tab's answer was taken and its round had ended, the second tab's answer came back as a **400 with no code**. `coding.control-run` (`plugins/native/coding/src/routes-sessions.ts`) threw a plain `new Error("这一轮已经结束，请开始新一轮")`. The same went for 「找不到属于这个会话的执行」.

- **New codes.** `defineErrorCodes("coding", { run_not_found: "not_found", round_ended: "conflict" })`.
  - The status comes from the plugin SDK's `errors.ts` by kind (409, 404); none is written by hand.
  - The declaration sits beside the route rather than in the card errors (`action-cards.ts`) or re-ask errors (`reask.ts`); both of those are about something else. The owner name is `coding`, the same as theirs.
- **The page decides by code.** The page's request helper now keeps `code`. When an answer is refused with `coding.round_ended` or `agent.pending_not_open`, the page:
  - puts the Host's own words on the status line;
  - reads the session again, so the card goes away and the thread shows the round.

  Before, the message went into the card's note and the card still looked answerable.
- **What the refused tab says.** Neither side says 「已由另一处回答」. At that point the Host only knows the question is closed or the round has ended, not who answered: it could be the other tab, or the question expired or was asked again. So the Assistant says 「这个问题已经结束或被替换」 and Coding says 「这一轮已经结束」. The spec's AC-08 row says this.
- **English.** The Coding page has no English catalog, so these two lines are Chinese only, like the rest of that page.

## The tests (commit c58f573fb)

**How the order is fixed.** The second tab's answer is held inside its own page (a wrapper around `fetch`). It is released only after the first tab's answer was taken and the round had ended. The order is fixed, not left to timing.

**The second tab:**
- Assistant: opened behind the first tab.
- Coding: brought to the front only while it picks the session and submits, because Coding reads a session only in a tab that's in front.

**What each test asserts:**

1. **One answer is taken.** The round goes on and the model's second request carries it.
2. **The other is refused with a code.**
   - Assistant: 409 `assistant.stale`, and its problem box shows the reason.
   - Coding: 409 `coding.round_ended`; the status line shows the reason, and the card is gone.
3. **The model hears once.** The request count stays the same after the release. The tool results carry the taken answer and not the refused one.
4. **Nothing is written twice.** Every file under `agent-runtime` has the same hash before and after the refused answer.

**Where the tests live:**
- Assistant: `tests/assistant-typed-questions.e2e.test.ts` 「AC-08」.
- Coding: `tests/interaction-no-crosstalk.e2e.test.ts` 「AC-08」, because that file has the Coding round that asks a question.

**Proof the test catches the defect:** on main's code, the Coding test fails with `[400, undefined]` vs `[409, "coding.round_ended"]`.

**Not added to `tests/ci-product-subset.txt`:** the browser-smoke list there already has 5 entries, the most it may hold.

## Spec

- **AC-08 → 已实现.** The row covers how the order is fixed, the codes, and why the refused tab doesn't say 「已由另一处回答」.
- **AC-11 → 已实现**, checked 2026-10-18:
  - the package is built from upstream main `b541a8e6`;
  - the six question types reach it via `askUserQuestionTypes`;
  - the model is offered those six under the real Runtime (AC-27-5).
- §18 has a progress entry.

## 防腐复查

- **M1 边界.** Only Coding's own route and page, plus tests. The new test code imports only what the files already imported.
- **M2 健康门禁** pass against merge-base `a56a2763`.
  - `client.ts` is a giant unit and went from 1638 to 1637 lines. The session-state label table was written twice (the session list and the command palette); one copy is kept.
  - No lines were merged to make room.
- **M6 页面资源:** `coding.js` is 131 bytes smaller, and its budget was lowered.
- **Unchanged:**
  - M4 API snapshots;
  - M5 action snapshots;
  - M8 DOM events;
  - M9 translations (0 missing English);
  - the error model's numbers. `error-scan` and `error-owners` are unchanged: the new codes are in `defineErrorCodes` and carry their owner's name.
- **不打补丁:** no prompt changes and no regexes; the page branches on codes.
- **不留兼容:** no fallback reads.

## Run on this machine

- Both AC-08 tests pass, before and after merging main `a56a2763`, with the whole of both files and `page-assets-budget`.
- `affected-tests`:
  - 45 non-browser files: all passed.
  - 12 browser files: 11 passed.
  - The one failure was AC-05 test 1 in `interaction-no-crosstalk`. That is the known intermittent red on main (the Coding new-session race the adoption line is fixing), and it passed on the rerun after the merge.
- `pnpm secrets:check` clean.
- One mistake: an earlier run took a bare `AC-08` argument as a file pattern and ran far more than intended, about 1,100 tests over 20 minutes. Nothing else was affected.

The full suite is the coordinator's call.

prs.title: feat(receipts): 3e-0 — business roles may state how they handle a supplement (acknowledge-inputs)
prs.body:
Receipts 3e-0 (`specs/ai-input-receipts`, the precondition for 3e; RCPT-362, RCPT-363). The coordinator chose option A on 10-18.

## The gap

The Prologue SDK only shows the model each supplement's id, and only takes its handling statement, when the round's tool list names `acknowledge-inputs` (`offersAcknowledgement`). The Assistant's two work roles may list only `BUSINESS_HOST_TOOLS`, which did not include it. So the Assistant never gave a handling statement: the receipt's 「AI 说」 line and 3e-1's 「当前约定」 stayed empty in real use.

## The change

- `acknowledge-inputs` joins `BUSINESS_HOST_TOOLS` (`packages/contracts/src/platform/plugin-agent.ts`). There is still one list. The four checks (agent-host `index.ts`, `prologue.ts`, `prologue-run.ts`, plugin-sdk `agent-declarations.ts`) all read this constant and are unchanged.
- **Why it fits a business role:** the tool touches no directory and runs no command. It only adds an entry, marked as the AI's own claim, to the SDK's own input ledger.
- **No prompt change.** How to use the tool is the SDK's tool description.

## For plugin authors (API snapshots `plugin-agent`, `plugin`)

- Every business role that spreads `BUSINESS_HOST_TOOLS` now sees one more tool. Today that is the Assistant's two work roles and Todo's organizer.
- A Character's tool allowance also accepts it.
- A role that should not state handling can list its tools without it; nothing else changes for it.

## @AI handbook line

Please check whether the SDK's tool description is enough for business roles to use the tool well. This PR deliberately changes no prompt.

## Found along the way (not in this PR)

Coding's roles (`plugins/native/coding/src/roles.ts`) do not list `acknowledge-inputs` either, so real Coding rounds also give no handling statements. That is not about the business list and needs its own slice; reported to the coordinator.

## Tests

- **RCPT-362** (`tests/assistant-business-gateway.test.ts`):
  - the Assistant's work round, run through the real AssistantService and Prologue adapter, lists `acknowledge-inputs`, and the model sees the supplement's id as the runtime gave it;
  - its statement lands on the receipt as `model_claim`, while the ledger's `state` stays the ledger's;
  - with the constant reverted, this test fails.
- **RCPT-363** (`tests/prologue-start-refusal.test.ts`):
  - a business role naming `read-file`, `list`, `search`, `write`, `edit-file` or `run-command` alongside it is still refused before any run, and the model is never called;
  - the business set alone starts.

## Checks

- `pnpm build`, `pnpm api:update`, `pnpm boundary:check`
- `node scripts/check-health-gates.mjs --base origin/main`: passed; the API note lists the two snapshot files above.
- `pnpm secrets:check`: clean.
- Affected tests (`affected-tests --base origin/main`) plus `prologue-start-refusal`, `plugin-declaration-rules` and `todo-plugin`: 31/31. Two existing tests list the business tools in their expected values (`plugin-declaration-rules`, `assistant-business-gateway`); those lists now include `acknowledge-inputs`, with the assertions otherwise unchanged.
- Contracts and the SDK changed, so this needs the full suite (coordinator's call).

## 防腐复查

- **One list, one owner.** The business tool set stays a single constant in contracts. No second list, and no Assistant-only branch in the checks.
- **No widening of reach.** The new tool touches no directory and runs no command. RCPT-363 asserts that directory and command tools are still refused before any model call.
- **Claims stay claims.** What the model says lands only as `model_claim` on the SDK's ledger. The receipt's facts are untouched (RCPT-362 asserts `state`).
- **No prompt patch for model behaviour.** Prompts are unchanged; whether the tool description is enough goes to the AI handbook line.
- **Contract change written down.** API snapshots are refreshed, and the impact on plugin authors is stated above.

prs.title: feat(receipts): 3e-1 — 当前约定 in the Assistant's side pane, as the AI's word
prs.body:
Receipts 3e-1 (`specs/ai-input-receipts` §9.2 「当前约定」; RCPT-358–361). The coordinator approved the plan on 10-18.

**Stacked on #713 (3e-0).** The base is `receipts/3e0-acknowledge`: without `acknowledge-inputs` in the business roles, the Assistant gives no handling statements and this block stays empty in real use. Once #713 merges, this PR's base becomes main.

## What it does

- **Where:** a 「当前约定」 block in the Assistant's side pane, after the path block. It is hidden when there is nothing to list.
- **Source:** it is derived from the thread's receipts for the rounds this work shows now (the shared receipt's `latest(owner)`, filtered by `run_id`). Nothing is stored apart.
- **What it lists:** supplements whose handling statement says they are taken as a constraint, objective or acceptance condition (or whose kind is constraint), in the order sent. Each item has:
  - the person's own words, which open that receipt (where 更正… is);
  - 「AI 说采纳为…」 on the receipt's dashed AI-claim line.
- **Left out:** not adopted, answered, needs clarification, withdrawn, other impacts only, and no statement.
- **Corrections:** if a later correction points at an item, the item says only 「后来有一条更正指向它」, not what the correction changed.
- **The AI's word, apart from facts (统筹 10-18 定):**
  - It uses the same dashed style as the receipt's AI line, with no colour or icon that implies a check.
  - One note: 「AI 自己说的，Molis 没有核对；要改，打开那条发更正。只看了最近 N 轮」. The Host keeps 30 rounds, so beyond that it honestly says 30, with no extra reading.
  - Nothing reads as in force. Editing means sending a correction, which is §9.2's 「本人编辑等于纠正输入」.
- **Code:**
  - `createAgreements` lives in the shared receipt and reaches the page script like the tray and the correction form.
  - The Assistant calls it after drawing the rounds (the factory's `tray()` is renamed `after()`) and redraws only when the text changes, so focus in the side pane stays.
  - `assistant-island.ts` (a giant file) keeps its line count: the block lookups became one `data-assistant-block` collection.
  - All words go through `L`, with English in the receipt's own dictionary.
- **Spec:** the 3e-1 record. It also records **3e-0b**: Coding's `roles.ts` lists `acknowledge-inputs` itself, after #713 merges (统筹 10-18 定).

## Page assets (needs a one-time approval)

`molis-work-workbench.js` grows by **+1,413 B** against merge-base 4bea52c8. That covers the list, the side block and their English.
- Offset within the slice: the two notes were merged into one.
- The rest is a new block and can't be saved back. It is under 10 KB and is not a new asset, so per the 10-18 rule I'm asking the coordinator to review it and add the `APPROVED_CEILINGS` entry.
- No other asset changes.

## Contracts and callers

No contract, action or API snapshot changes beyond #713's. The two API notes in health come from #713 underneath.

## Tests

- **RCPT-358** (`tests/input-receipts-client.test.ts`):
  - lists only constraint, objective or acceptance claims, in order, with the person's words first and the AI's claim second;
  - leaves out the excluded cases;
  - says unchecked and how many rounds were looked at;
  - says nothing like 已生效.
- **RCPT-359** (same file): only the rounds shown count; a later correction is noted beside the item it names; each item opens its own receipt.
- **RCPT-360** (`tests/assistant-receipts-client.test.ts`):
  - after the rounds, the side block gets the agreements, with the thread as the surface and only this work's run ids;
  - unchanged text is not redrawn;
  - no work, no block.
- **RCPT-361** (`tests/assistant-input-receipts.e2e.test.ts`, browser): the person sends 「别直接发邮件给客户，我自己发」 as a supplement, and the model acknowledges it as a constraint. The side pane then shows the item, the AI's claim and a single note, and the item opens the receipt in the thread.

## Checks

- `pnpm build`, `pnpm workspace:build`
- The three test files above: 3/3.
- `node scripts/check-health-gates.mjs --base origin/main`: passed.
- `node scripts/gates/page-assets.mjs --base origin/main`: workbench.js +1,413, as above.
- `pnpm secrets:check`: clean.

## 防腐复查

- **One owner per fact.** The ledger and the claims are the runtime's. The block is derived from what the receipts already drew, with no copy, no store and no new field.
- **Claims stay claims.** 「AI 说」 is visibly apart from board facts and said to be unchecked. No colour or icon implies a check, and nothing says in force.
- **Honest about scope.** It always says how many rounds were looked at, and the Host's 30-round cap is stated, not hidden by a second read.
- **One copy of the rule.** The list is one function in the shared receipt. The Assistant only places it, and there is no Assistant-only receipt code.
- **Giant units do not grow, with no line squeezing.** `assistant-island.ts` keeps its count by replacing hand-listed lookups with one collection; `createInputReceipts` stays under 150 lines because the list is its own function.
- **No prompt patch.** Prompts are unchanged.
- **Byte growth stated.** See Page assets above.

open_prs.title: feat(connectors): 让助理统一接入服务并按最新任务续办
open_prs.body:
## 行为

个人助理可复用已有连接，或从对话准备远程 MCP、受管本地 MCP、API 和 CLI 接入。需要本人登录或填凭据时给出受保护入口；原任务由 SDK 持久等待，连接就绪后按最新要求继续业务操作。取消、改为只读、换目标、撤权、停用和重启均沿原事实 owner 处理。

连接管理分别显示配置、最近技术检查、当前授权、业务能力与使用位置。Coding 添加的连接可由有权限的助理复用；Home 与项目范围隔离。安装使用固定来源与受管目录，失败保留已有连接和业务成果。

唯一需求与证据：[spec](https://github.com/molis-ai/molis-work/blob/1ab2f29f385ef2ccdec92ba1f3eca280dc9a12d2/specs/assistant-service-connections/spec.md)、[coverage](https://github.com/molis-ai/molis-work/blob/1ab2f29f385ef2ccdec92ba1f3eca280dc9a12d2/specs/assistant-service-connections/coverage.md)、[真实模型诊断](https://github.com/molis-ai/molis-work/blob/1ab2f29f385ef2ccdec92ba1f3eca280dc9a12d2/specs/assistant-service-connections/model-diagnosis.md)。

## 当前集成与评审修订

最新 head：`1ab2f29f385ef2ccdec92ba1f3eca280dc9a12d2`，已同步 main `a19524f58185d1fe4afc085d3fec36931115a102`，包含 #634、#709 及 #711。安全表保留主线 S-35，本功能安装/跨入口 MCP 顺延为 S-36、接入意图为 S-37，文档与测试同步。

- 移除 HubSpot 的受管安装和下载源许可：官方安装脚本忽略指定版本、只取 `latest`，版本页没有二进制附件。已有 CLI 登录、账号检查和业务读取保留；准备受管安装在下载前明确拒绝。
- 旧 HTTP MCP 的 Prologue `credential_ref` 登记到防腐 spec §4.1，归维护八与 connectors 库 1→2 同次处理。用户接受 Images MCP v1→v2 改名，影响见下。
- 补充 Java/Ruby/Perl loader 环境变量拒绝项、无权限重连错误码断言，并说明 Graph 模块仅固定版本、没有额外摘要校验。
- 保留 Gmail/Notion 旧回调、通用 API/Gmail/Notion/MCP 迟到刷新修复：授权开始时固定连接修订，写入前同步复查。主线回执、重启回答和被拒移动的恢复规则保持当前语义。

## 验证

- 本轮审查修订在合 main 前完成 **66 个文件、526 项通过，无跳过**，包含 Local Host 必跑、HubSpot 零下载拒绝、既有 CLI、stdio 环境拒绝、外部 MCP 撤权及安装安全。它不替代以下新基线回归。
- 新基线 **110 文件、836 项全部通过，0 跳过、0 失败**：107 个非浏览器文件、824 项；3 个 Chrome 文件、12 项（Coding 首次读取 4、交互隔离 3、助理发送意图 5）。不与合 main 前批次重复相加。
- 新基线整体构建、API/动作快照、包边界、基于 `a19524f58` 的健康快查更新均通过。25 项资源实测 **7,475,502 字节**；`workbench.js` **1,110,116**，比 main 的 **1,110,187** 少 71 字节；没有提高预算或加门禁例外。
- 推送前差异格式及密钥扫描通过（10,081 行）。**当前 head 的[常规 CI](https://github.com/molis-ai/molis-work/actions/runs/39101469929) 已全部通过。** 上一 head `1d1a44944` 的[常规 CI](https://github.com/molis-ai/molis-work/actions/runs/39098989048) 13 个执行作业全部通过、产品子集 393/393；该结果只作历史证据。
- 先前集成批次去重 93 文件、775 项（含 13 个 Chrome 文件、25 项）通过；旧结果按覆盖表保留。真实 MiniMax-M3 已验证远程 MCP 读取/保存 Pages、等待中改只读且零写入、Token/CLI、官方 npm/Python、本机 HTTP 及 Coding 复用，模型累计 **663/680**，本轮未新增调用。
- 统筹已复核这个 head 并启动 [chain51 full-suite](https://github.com/molis-ai/molis-work/actions/runs/39101618084)。分片 3 的真实 Python 安装用例因 runner 缺少 uv 失败，已复现并提交独立 [CI 修复 #715](https://github.com/molis-ai/molis-work/pull/715)；本 PR head 不变，补齐依赖后的全量仍待统筹安排。整体不宣称内部完整。

## 合同与数据维护

- Connector 增加状态、使用位置、CLI 接入与环境字段；Agent Host 增加 MCP 刷新/派出观察及 owner 只读等待端口。卡片增加结果展示，停止工作可明确保留连接。
- 新增 19 项 Host 动作，共同目录一次登记；`images.connections.list` 从 v1 升 v2，所有消费者、Skill、手册与快照同步。公开类型新增字段无单独版本号；外部 MCP 工具名由 `images.connections.list__v1` 改为 `images.connections.list__v2`，旧名停用，用户已于 10-18 接受，外部调用方须改用新名。
- Gmail 协议包保存刷新令牌前同步调用宿主 `beforePersist`，连接事实仍归 Host。
- connectors 库基线 1→2 已在[维护清单](https://github.com/molis-ai/molis-work/blob/1ab2f29f385ef2ccdec92ba1f3eca280dc9a12d2/specs/repository-anti-corruption/spec.md)登记；隔离副本维护与恢复已演练。真实 Home 归维护八，随安装新构建另取当次授权；不先用新构建开旧库，不给旧构建开维护后的库，不加入运行时迁移或读取兼容。
- `CONNECTOR_TOOLS_HOME_STORE` 归 Local Host 受管工具安装器。[HOME-DATA §6.3](https://github.com/molis-ai/molis-work/blob/1ab2f29f385ef2ccdec92ba1f3eca280dc9a12d2/docs/system/HOME-DATA.md)写明安装清单/锁文件与连接引用同一时点备份、原路径恢复、共享运行时与缓存、引用/所有权检查后清理，以及普通卸载保留、purge 清除。

## 对用户的影响

- 已通过 `replace-secret` 保存、仍引用 Prologue `credential_ref` 的 HTTP MCP 配置，在升级时须归维护八迁成 Host 连接；无法恢复凭据的，由用户升级后重新填写或选择已有连接。维护与 connectors 库 1→2 同次进行，真实 Home 尚未核对或修改。
- HubSpot 官方只提供可变 `latest` 下载，已移除受管安装；已有 `hubspot` CLI 仍可登录、检测账号与读取业务数据。原安装实操保留为历史证据，不算现行固定版本安装通过。
- Graph 模块经 PSGallery 固定版本，未另核文件摘要；这与原生发行物的摘要校验保证不同。

## 防腐复查

按评论引用的 ANTI-CORRUPTION-REVIEW §3，对 `a19524f58...1ab2f29f385ef2ccdec92ba1f3eca280dc9a12d2` 的差异自查；这是主代理自查，独立评审待统筹。逐项依据在 spec §11「PR #661 评论复查」。

| 条目 | 结论 |
| --- | --- |
| 1、15 | 仅现行 schema，表由原 owner 读写；连接库副本维护已演练，旧 HTTP MCP 凭据维护登记待执行，真实 Home 未动。 |
| 2、3、4 | 动作只登记一次，各入口走共同目录与调用编号；可信身份来自上下文，外部等待 concurrent，提交前检查权限、修订与最新意图。取消/撤权/迟到结果有拒绝回归。 |
| 5、6、7 | 包边界通过；模型与 SDK 只在 agent-host，未改 kernel，未新增插件实现互相依赖。 |
| 8、9 | 连接、协议、安装、等待分别归原 owner；合并引入的 152 行函数已拆分，巨大单元总数和相关大小下降。 |
| 10、11、12 | 未新增插件专用宿主路径或整页；新增合同同次有真实调用方与用例，形状变化的已版本化动作升版。 |
| 13、19 | API、动作、健康快查、页面预算从合并后的构建重新生成；资源相对新 main 只降。 |
| 14、16 | 新错误沿 owner 工厂和 SDK 状态映射；沿现行命名，无新 Error 子类或旧名。 |
| 17 | S-27 同时保留 owner 等待与工作授权；保留 main S-31—S-35，安装/接入意图顺延 S-36/S-37，安全测试同步。 |
| 18、20、21 | 沿现有登记事件、所属词典和设置请求助手；门禁无缺译、无新增原始 fetch。 |
| 22、23 | 新测试用公开入口、保留原断言，ASC 编号与验收对应，产品子集加入快用例；full-suite 由统筹安排。 |
| 24、25 | 使用 main 当前唯一统一 SDK，vendor/锁文件相对 main 无差异；冲突保留双方语义并重跑门禁。 |
| 26、27 | 仅本功能分支；未改 CI、门禁脚本、阈值、允许/例外/隔离名单。安全命令只增加 OAuth 拒绝回归。 |

## 评审范围

用户 10-18 已决定保留 #661 为一个集成 PR，不拆分。统筹按三组完整行为审查：① 连接生命周期、协议状态与凭据竞争；② 受管安装及本人操作入口；③ 助理接入、最新意图及跨入口接续。修订最终 head 后由统筹复核并安排一次 full-suite，后续入队由统筹管理。

## 尚未验证

- OAuth 本人应用配置、真实服务商登录及保留身份的重新授权按一骏决定暂缓；协议测试不能替代真实账号验收。
- 三处模型附加说明错误仍保留在诊断：Token 的“最近 100 条”、CLI 对 50 条的解释、本机 HTTP 将 `/mcp` 写成 `/mp`。真实调用证据成立，整份回复尚不能宣称完全可靠。
- 一骏本人本轮验收、整功能 full-suite 尚未完成；本 PR 不执行发布或真实 Home 维护。

open_prs.title: feat(receipts): 3e-0 — business roles may state how they handle a supplement (acknowledge-inputs)
open_prs.body:
Receipts 3e-0 (`specs/ai-input-receipts`, the precondition for 3e; RCPT-362, RCPT-363). The coordinator chose option A on 10-18.

## The gap

The Prologue SDK only shows the model each supplement's id, and only takes its handling statement, when the round's tool list names `acknowledge-inputs` (`offersAcknowledgement`). The Assistant's two work roles may list only `BUSINESS_HOST_TOOLS`, which did not include it. So the Assistant never gave a handling statement: the receipt's 「AI 说」 line and 3e-1's 「当前约定」 stayed empty in real use.

## The change

- `acknowledge-inputs` joins `BUSINESS_HOST_TOOLS` (`packages/contracts/src/platform/plugin-agent.ts`). There is still one list. The four checks (agent-host `index.ts`, `prologue.ts`, `prologue-run.ts`, plugin-sdk `agent-declarations.ts`) all read this constant and are unchanged.
- **Why it fits a business role:** the tool touches no directory and runs no command. It only adds an entry, marked as the AI's own claim, to the SDK's own input ledger.
- **No prompt change.** How to use the tool is the SDK's tool description.

## For plugin authors (API snapshots `plugin-agent`, `plugin`)

- Every business role that spreads `BUSINESS_HOST_TOOLS` now sees one more tool. Today that is the Assistant's two work roles and Todo's organizer.
- A Character's tool allowance also accepts it.
- A role that should not state handling can list its tools without it; nothing else changes for it.

## @AI handbook line

Please check whether the SDK's tool description is enough for business roles to use the tool well. This PR deliberately changes no prompt.

## Found along the way (not in this PR)

Coding's roles (`plugins/native/coding/src/roles.ts`) do not list `acknowledge-inputs` either, so real Coding rounds also give no handling statements. That is not about the business list and needs its own slice; reported to the coordinator.

## Tests

- **RCPT-362** (`tests/assistant-business-gateway.test.ts`):
  - the Assistant's work round, run through the real AssistantService and Prologue adapter, lists `acknowledge-inputs`, and the model sees the supplement's id as the runtime gave it;
  - its statement lands on the receipt as `model_claim`, while the ledger's `state` stays the ledger's;
  - with the constant reverted, this test fails.
- **RCPT-363** (`tests/prologue-start-refusal.test.ts`):
  - a business role naming `read-file`, `list`, `search`, `write`, `edit-file` or `run-command` alongside it is still refused before any run, and the model is never called;
  - the business set alone starts.

## Checks

- `pnpm build`, `pnpm api:update`, `pnpm boundary:check`
- `node scripts/check-health-gates.mjs --base origin/main`: passed; the API note lists the two snapshot files above.
- `pnpm secrets:check`: clean.
- Affected tests (`affected-tests --base origin/main`) plus `prologue-start-refusal`, `plugin-declaration-rules` and `todo-plugin`: 31/31. Two existing tests list the business tools in their expected values (`plugin-declaration-rules`, `assistant-business-gateway`); those lists now include `acknowledge-inputs`, with the assertions otherwise unchanged.
- Contracts and the SDK changed, so this needs the full suite (coordinator's call).

## 防腐复查

- **One list, one owner.** The business tool set stays a single constant in contracts. No second list, and no Assistant-only branch in the checks.
- **No widening of reach.** The new tool touches no directory and runs no command. RCPT-363 asserts that directory and command tools are still refused before any model call.
- **Claims stay claims.** What the model says lands only as `model_claim` on the SDK's ledger. The receipt's facts are untouched (RCPT-362 asserts `state`).
- **No prompt patch for model behaviour.** Prompts are unchanged; whether the tool description is enough goes to the AI handbook line.
- **Contract change written down.** API snapshots are refreshed, and the impact on plugin authors is stated above.

open_prs.title: feat(receipts): 3e-1 — 当前约定 in the Assistant's side pane, as the AI's word
open_prs.body:
Receipts 3e-1 (`specs/ai-input-receipts` §9.2 「当前约定」; RCPT-358–361). The coordinator approved the plan on 10-18.

**Stacked on #713 (3e-0).** The base is `receipts/3e0-acknowledge`: without `acknowledge-inputs` in the business roles, the Assistant gives no handling statements and this block stays empty in real use. Once #713 merges, this PR's base becomes main.

## What it does

- **Where:** a 「当前约定」 block in the Assistant's side pane, after the path block. It is hidden when there is nothing to list.
- **Source:** it is derived from the thread's receipts for the rounds this work shows now (the shared receipt's `latest(owner)`, filtered by `run_id`). Nothing is stored apart.
- **What it lists:** supplements whose handling statement says they are taken as a constraint, objective or acceptance condition (or whose kind is constraint), in the order sent. Each item has:
  - the person's own words, which open that receipt (where 更正… is);
  - 「AI 说采纳为…」 on the receipt's dashed AI-claim line.
- **Left out:** not adopted, answered, needs clarification, withdrawn, other impacts only, and no statement.
- **Corrections:** if a later correction points at an item, the item says only 「后来有一条更正指向它」, not what the correction changed.
- **The AI's word, apart from facts (统筹 10-18 定):**
  - It uses the same dashed style as the receipt's AI line, with no colour or icon that implies a check.
  - One note: 「AI 自己说的，Molis 没有核对；要改，打开那条发更正。只看了最近 N 轮」. The Host keeps 30 rounds, so beyond that it honestly says 30, with no extra reading.
  - Nothing reads as in force. Editing means sending a correction, which is §9.2's 「本人编辑等于纠正输入」.
- **Code:**
  - `createAgreements` lives in the shared receipt and reaches the page script like the tray and the correction form.
  - The Assistant calls it after drawing the rounds (the factory's `tray()` is renamed `after()`) and redraws only when the text changes, so focus in the side pane stays.
  - `assistant-island.ts` (a giant file) keeps its line count: the block lookups became one `data-assistant-block` collection.
  - All words go through `L`, with English in the receipt's own dictionary.
- **Spec:** the 3e-1 record. It also records **3e-0b**: Coding's `roles.ts` lists `acknowledge-inputs` itself, after #713 merges (统筹 10-18 定).

## Page assets (needs a one-time approval)

`molis-work-workbench.js` grows by **+1,413 B** against merge-base 4bea52c8. That covers the list, the side block and their English.
- Offset within the slice: the two notes were merged into one.
- The rest is a new block and can't be saved back. It is under 10 KB and is not a new asset, so per the 10-18 rule I'm asking the coordinator to review it and add the `APPROVED_CEILINGS` entry.
- No other asset changes.

## Contracts and callers

No contract, action or API snapshot changes beyond #713's. The two API notes in health come from #713 underneath.

## Tests

- **RCPT-358** (`tests/input-receipts-client.test.ts`):
  - lists only constraint, objective or acceptance claims, in order, with the person's words first and the AI's claim second;
  - leaves out the excluded cases;
  - says unchecked and how many rounds were looked at;
  - says nothing like 已生效.
- **RCPT-359** (same file): only the rounds shown count; a later correction is noted beside the item it names; each item opens its own receipt.
- **RCPT-360** (`tests/assistant-receipts-client.test.ts`):
  - after the rounds, the side block gets the agreements, with the thread as the surface and only this work's run ids;
  - unchanged text is not redrawn;
  - no work, no block.
- **RCPT-361** (`tests/assistant-input-receipts.e2e.test.ts`, browser): the person sends 「别直接发邮件给客户，我自己发」 as a supplement, and the model acknowledges it as a constraint. The side pane then shows the item, the AI's claim and a single note, and the item opens the receipt in the thread.

## Checks

- `pnpm build`, `pnpm workspace:build`
- The three test files above: 3/3.
- `node scripts/check-health-gates.mjs --base origin/main`: passed.
- `node scripts/gates/page-assets.mjs --base origin/main`: workbench.js +1,413, as above.
- `pnpm secrets:check`: clean.

## 防腐复查

- **One owner per fact.** The ledger and the claims are the runtime's. The block is derived from what the receipts already drew, with no copy, no store and no new field.
- **Claims stay claims.** 「AI 说」 is visibly apart from board facts and said to be unchecked. No colour or icon implies a check, and nothing says in force.
- **Honest about scope.** It always says how many rounds were looked at, and the Host's 30-round cap is stated, not hidden by a second read.
- **One copy of the rule.** The list is one function in the shared receipt. The Assistant only places it, and there is no Assistant-only receipt code.
- **Giant units do not grow, with no line squeezing.** `assistant-island.ts` keeps its count by replacing hand-listed lookups with one collection; `createInputReceipts` stays under 150 lines because the list is its own function.
- **No prompt patch.** Prompts are unchanged.
- **Byte growth stated.** See Page assets above.

open_prs.title: feat(todo): run Todo through the Home Plugin Runtime (W5-01)
open_prs.body:
Todo 现在由 Home Plugin Runtime 启动，所有项目共用同一个个人待办库。项目页面的「转为待办」、待办整理与生成后的应用都走插件公开动作；停用或取消时，等待模型的调用不会写入整理结果。旧原生路由和提供方接线已删除。

## 行为与调用方

- `createTodoPlugin` 使用 `services.database` 和 `services.model`，写入先检查 `beforeEffect`。库仍在 `{home}/todo/todo.db`，schema/version 1 保持，不需要维护真实 Home。
- 16 条路由改用 `/api/plugins/io.molis.work.todo/…`，仓库内调用方已同步。项目身份来自页面路径的可信上下文，忽略 body 中的项目字段。旧 `/api/todo` 与短别名已移除。
- Home Runtime 视图获得当前页面的转义和翻译入口，Todo 舞台只挂载一次。声明的 `max_body_bytes` 生效：Todo 维持 1,000,000 B，未声明的 Home 路由维持 12 MiB。
- 动作输入输出、版本、提供方、MCP 工具名、工作流程步骤和 Skill 保持；动作合同快照通过。相对 main 没有 contracts/SDK 公开 API 快照变化。

## 整合与资源

通过 merge 纳入 main `4bea52c84`，未变基，合并提交 `dfcb0439f`。本轮冲突仅为资源许可、对应测试及资源派生表，Todo 业务源码与此前冻结的 `f7fffda2e` 相同。主线 Shelf、回执和放置变更保留。

| 资源 | main | 本片实测 | 变化 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| workbench.js | 1,110,187 B | 1,110,215 B | +28 B |
| todo.js | 62,081 B | 62,036 B | −45 B |

+28 B 来自「转为待办」的完整插件路由，用户已批准；按当前 merge-base 定为 `[1110187, 1110215]`。#706 的既有许可和 Todo 都使用同一个资源键；#706 已合 main，故其旧起点和上限转为再次增长拒绝回归，全部旧拒绝保留，活动许可仅 Todo 这一条。多一字节、其他资源增长、再次使用均拒绝。25 项资源总计 7,475,589 B，比 main 少 17 B。

## 验证

- 本轮整体/workspace 构建、边界、正式资源实测及更新、完整 merge-base health/API（64 份快照、2,506 项声明）全部通过；推送前重新 fetch main，提交密钥扫描 915 行通过。
- 当前合并代码定向去重 20 文件、227 条通过，0 跳过：17 个非浏览器文件 223 条，3 个真实 Chrome 文件 4 条。覆盖 Todo、Home Runtime、动作合同、路由/正文权限、资源门禁、放置/回执及转待办/草稿恢复/移动动线。
- 资源用例首次在合并和预算落定前读到旧预算而失败；预算落定后该文件 73 条全部通过，断言未改。另 3 个业务文件在这次重跑中重复通过，不重复计数。
- 上一轮 `a56a2763d` 整合的 109 个非浏览器文件 1,111 条、1 条公网 npm 条件跳过，以及 7 个 Chrome 文件 14 条，仍作为对应版本的既有证据。上一轮灵光转待办提示超时后无改动重跑和干净 main 对照均通过；本轮该文件两条首次通过，不据此声称已找出原时序原因。
- 未跑本机全量；共享核心全量交统筹审最终 head 后在 CI 排，本 PR 不自行加标签或合并。

本片只完成 W5-01 的 Todo 样板，整条防腐任务仍在推进。#703 是依赖本片的流式路由草稿，Todo 合入后直接接实际 main；其余候选保持本地准备，在途至多两片。

open_prs.title: feat(context): a side panel plugin tab reports what is in hand, as a split pane does (W3-C, AC-S04)
open_prs.body:
W3-C of the context program (specs/context-program §21.4, §21.6; specs/side-shelf AC-S04): a plugin's tab in the side panel reports what is in hand, as a split pane does. 统筹 approved the plan on 10-18 and set the conditions: reuse the existing side-frame check, add no new message type, put the S-30 row and its refusal test in this PR, and name AC-S04.

## What changes

1. **The side tab's document runs the pane half of the context actions.**
   - `context-actions.ts` splits its factory into the part a surface's own document runs (`PANE_PART`: the DOM selection reader, the naming of an opened item, and, embedded, the toolbar it draws for the top document) and the top document's part (bar, bus, landing).
   - The workbench page's factory is the same text as before: `PANE_PART`, then the top part.
   - `CONTEXT_PANE_FACTORY_SCRIPT` is `PANE_PART` alone. `side-view-document.ts` runs it inside its existing S-30 block, with the same `PANE_MESSAGES_SCRIPT` it already makes.
   - `embedded` now also covers `[data-side-view]` (the side document's body), so a side tab draws its own toolbar and posts `workbench-surface-focus` up, exactly as a split pane.
2. **The page's context bus takes these messages only from a side panel plugin frame.**
   - The side-frame check is pulled out of `SIDE_FORWARD_SCRIPT` into `SIDE_FRAME_FROM_SCRIPT`, unchanged. `SIDE_FORWARD_SCRIPT.from` is now that expression, and the bus uses the same one. There is no second check.
   - The bus's message handler accepts a split pane frame (as before) or a side panel plugin frame. Everything else is dropped as before: other origins, the page itself, other frames, and popups.
   - For a frame's focus, the top marks where it is with `landing.place(frame)`: `place: "side"` and `side_tab` (the same rule as for a surface in the top document's side panel). A `place` the frame reports is overwritten. `pane_id` is `side`.
   - Choices, hold, dismiss, summon, ✦ and unhandled choices use the split pane's existing messages. No message type is added.
3. **What follows from that (AC-S04):**
   - The left's landing applies to a passage in the side tab: the bar offers 「插入到光标处」.
   - A selection on the left takes the bar back to the left.
   - Closing the panel hides the frame; the bus drops what was in hand as it does for any surface that went out of sight, and the tab's bar goes.

**Not done (follow-up):** hovering 「放进去」 on a frame's bar does not flash the landing on the left. A split pane's bar does not either today: the hold message a pane sends carries only the bar's keys, not its menu's.

## S-30

- **Row:** the S-30 row in `docs/system/SECURITY-INVARIANTS.md` now covers the side tab's in-hand messages. It names `SIDE_FRAME_FROM_SCRIPT` as the one side-frame check, says the place is marked by the page and not read from the frame, and lists the new test and e2e.
- **Refusal test:** `tests/security-invariants-pane-messages.test.ts` 「S-30 AC-S04 a workbench-surface-focus that is not from a side panel plugin frame (or a split pane) is dropped: nothing is asked, no toolbar」.
  - It runs the shipped `CONTEXT_ACTIONS_FACTORY_SCRIPT` on a small page port.
  - A focus from these sources is dropped: a same-origin frame that is not a side tab, the page itself, a window that is not a frame here, and the Shelf frame from four other origins. For each, no `/api/contextual/` call is made, no frame is told to draw, and the page draws no toolbar.
  - From the Shelf frame, the request carries `pane_id: "side"`, `place: "side"` and `side_tab: "plugin:shelf/side"`, and only that frame is told to draw.
  - Mutation check: with the handler loosened to accept any frame, the test fails on the first refused case.
- **Export:** `CONTEXT_ACTIONS_FACTORY_SCRIPT` (and `SIDE_FRAME_FROM_SCRIPT`) are exported from `@molis-ai/molis-work-app-workbench` for that test, as `PANE_MESSAGES_SCRIPT` is. This is an app package, not a contract or SDK export.
- `pnpm test:security`: 63 of 63 files pass.

## Tests

- **New browser test:** `tests/side-shelf-in-hand.e2e.test.ts` (W3-C AC-S04), with Pages open on the left with its cursor placed, and a text material opened in Shelf's side tab. It checks:
  - A passage selected in the tab gets the bar in the tab's own document. The bar is beside the passage and inside the tab; the top document draws none.
  - The top document's request marks it `side` / `plugin:shelf/side` / `shelf_item`.

open_prs.title: fix(coding)+test(interaction): two tabs answer one question; Coding's late answer is refused with a code (AC-08); AC-11 row
open_prs.body:
AC-08 (specs/ai-interaction-experience): two browser tabs answer the same question at once, in the Assistant and in Coding. The AC-11 row is also rewritten to match how things stand now. **The AC-08 test found a product defect in Coding, fixed in its own commit (1ae3b907f).** Because of that fix, this PR needs the full suite, not merge-only.

## The defect (commit 1ae3b907f)

Once the first tab's answer was taken and its round had ended, the second tab's answer came back as a **400 with no code**. `coding.control-run` (`plugins/native/coding/src/routes-sessions.ts`) threw a plain `new Error("这一轮已经结束，请开始新一轮")`. The same went for 「找不到属于这个会话的执行」.

- **New codes.** `defineErrorCodes("coding", { run_not_found: "not_found", round_ended: "conflict" })`.
  - The status comes from the plugin SDK's `errors.ts` by kind (409, 404); none is written by hand.
  - The declaration sits beside the route rather than in the card errors (`action-cards.ts`) or re-ask errors (`reask.ts`); both of those are about something else. The owner name is `coding`, the same as theirs.
- **The page decides by code.** The page's request helper now keeps `code`. When an answer is refused with `coding.round_ended` or `agent.pending_not_open`, the page:
  - puts the Host's own words on the status line;
  - reads the session again, so the card goes away and the thread shows the round.

  Before, the message went into the card's note and the card still looked answerable.
- **What the refused tab says.** Neither side says 「已由另一处回答」. At that point the Host only knows the question is closed or the round has ended, not who answered: it could be the other tab, or the question expired or was asked again. So the Assistant says 「这个问题已经结束或被替换」 and Coding says 「这一轮已经结束」. The spec's AC-08 row says this.
- **English.** The Coding page has no English catalog, so these two lines are Chinese only, like the rest of that page.

## The tests (commit c58f573fb)

**How the order is fixed.** The second tab's answer is held inside its own page (a wrapper around `fetch`). It is released only after the first tab's answer was taken and the round had ended. The order is fixed, not left to timing.

**The second tab:**
- Assistant: opened behind the first tab.
- Coding: brought to the front only while it picks the session and submits, because Coding reads a session only in a tab that's in front.

**What each test asserts:**

1. **One answer is taken.** The round goes on and the model's second request carries it.
2. **The other is refused with a code.**
   - Assistant: 409 `assistant.stale`, and its problem box shows the reason.
   - Coding: 409 `coding.round_ended`; the status line shows the reason, and the card is gone.
3. **The model hears once.** The request count stays the same after the release. The tool results carry the taken answer and not the refused one.
4. **Nothing is written twice.** Every file under `agent-runtime` has the same hash before and after the refused answer.

**Where the tests live:**
- Assistant: `tests/assistant-typed-questions.e2e.test.ts` 「AC-08」.
- Coding: `tests/interaction-no-crosstalk.e2e.test.ts` 「AC-08」, because that file has the Coding round that asks a question.

**Proof the test catches the defect:** on main's code, the Coding test fails with `[400, undefined]` vs `[409, "coding.round_ended"]`.

**Not added to `tests/ci-product-subset.txt`:** the browser-smoke list there already has 5 entries, the most it may hold.

## Spec

- **AC-08 → 已实现.** The row covers how the order is fixed, the codes, and why the refused tab doesn't say 「已由另一处回答」.
- **AC-11 → 已实现**, checked 2026-10-18:
  - the package is built from upstream main `b541a8e6`;
  - the six question types reach it via `askUserQuestionTypes`;
  - the model is offered those six under the real Runtime (AC-27-5).
- §18 has a progress entry.

## 防腐复查

- **M1 边界.** Only Coding's own route and page, plus tests. The new test code imports only what the files already imported.
- **M2 健康门禁** pass against merge-base `a56a2763`.
  - `client.ts` is a giant unit and went from 1638 to 1637 lines. The session-state label table was written twice (the session list and the command palette); one copy is kept.
  - No lines were merged to make room.
- **M6 页面资源:** `coding.js` is 131 bytes smaller, and its budget was lowered.
- **Unchanged:**
  - M4 API snapshots;
  - M5 action snapshots;
  - M8 DOM events;
  - M9 translations (0 missing English);
  - the error model's numbers. `error-scan` and `error-owners` are unchanged: the new codes are in `defineErrorCodes` and carry their owner's name.
- **不打补丁:** no prompt changes and no regexes; the page branches on codes.
- **不留兼容:** no fallback reads.

## Run on this machine

- Both AC-08 tests pass, before and after merging main `a56a2763`, with the whole of both files and `page-assets-budget`.
- `affected-tests`:
  - 45 non-browser files: all passed.
  - 12 browser files: 11 passed.
  - The one failure was AC-05 test 1 in `interaction-no-crosstalk`. That is the known intermittent red on main (the Coding new-session race the adoption line is fixing), and it passed on the rerun after the merge.
- `pnpm secrets:check` clean.
- One mistake: an earlier run took a bare `AC-08` argument as a file pattern and ran far more than intended, about 1,100 tests over 20 minutes. Nothing else was affected.

The full suite is the coordinator's call.

open_prs.title: feat(runtime): stream plugin route progress with cancellation (W5-01)
open_prs.body:
## 做了什么

Runtime 插件可在 POST 路由声明 `stream: "ndjson"`，经共同动作服务实时报告进度，Host 写唯一的结果或错误末行。Home 与项目共用传输；HTTP 断开、停用、撤权、升级后结束等待，迟到的处理器、模型文字和结果均不能继续交付或写业务记录。对应唯一 spec 的 RAC-20–24。

前置为 #684（Todo Runtime）。本草稿暂以 `feature/w5-01-todo-runtime` 为基线，只展示流式路由这一片，供先行审阅。#684 合入后移到实际 main、改基线并启动正式 CI；不加全量标签、不自行合并。当前目标分支不匹配仓库 CI 的 main 过滤条件，草稿上的本地验证不能代替正式 CI。

## 验证

- [x] 在 Todo `8738385e395f229a72ef473fa67f6bbf757c9f69` 上重放本片四个提交，检查最终差异；业务实现无冲突，需求书状态句保留最新状态。
- [x] `pnpm build`、`pnpm workspace:build`、`pnpm boundary:check`、`node scripts/check-health-gates.mjs --base origin/main` 通过。
- [x] 页面资源同时对 main merge-base `8fcff0442` 与 Todo 候选检查通过：25 项共 7,479,372 B，本片增量 0 B。
- [x] 当前组合的包要求与安全回归：162 个非浏览器文件、1,538 条通过、1 条原有沙箱环境条件跳过；`tests/plugin-sample.e2e.test.ts` 经真实 Chrome 通过 1 条。合计 163 文件、1,539 条通过、1 条跳过、0 失败。
- [x] `pnpm secrets:check` 通过；推送时复查。
- [ ] 共享核心全量：交统筹在 CI 排，本机不跑全量。
- 先前切片的 150 文件、安全拒绝、真实 HTTP 及 Chrome 结果保留在 spec 中；不将旧基点结果称为当前组合通过。

## 公开合同与 API 影响

三份公开快照随源码更新：`contracts/platform/actions`、`contracts/platform/plugin`、`plugin-sdk/index`。新增可选路由 `stream`、请求 `emit`、共同 NDJSON 行类型、动作客户端第四个 `transport` 参数、模型 `onText` 与 SDK 进度上限常量；现有 JSON 路由与未传新参数的调用保持现行行为。Host、Runtime 与 SDK 同片接通，可信 execution 对象身份保持；无动作 schema、版本或 MCP 工具名变化。浏览器统一读流器在后续灵光迁移片接入。

进度每行至多 65,536 B、最多 10,000 行且总计 1,048,576 B；超限取消并返回 `actions.output_invalid`，插件不能伪造最终结果。按用户已批准决定，只有显式声明 `max_body_bytes` 的路由可用至多 36,000,000 B，未声明的默认上限不变，超一字节先拒绝为 JSON 413。S-03、S-18、插件 Skill 与手册同步。

## 只许减少的数字与基本合同

健康门禁无增长；Runtime 停止请求同步撤销当前 activation 的授权和动作注册，原队列负责清理，巨大类少一行。身份取自 Host 上下文；能力仍只注册一次；等待后的业务写入仍经原 `beforeEffect()`；模型调用沿现有 Agent Host 端口。没有新增页面资源、包、依赖、存储结构或安全编号。

同途 #701 也改 `platform/plugin.ts`、PluginRuntime、SDK Manifest 与 API 快照，但当前改动位置不同。后合一方按实际 main 整合并重建快照；不带入 #701 的功能。最终完整 head 与验证结果在本聊天交用户转达统筹。

open_prs.title: chore(vendor): Prologue SDK 换到 main 94ee1ea4（#42–#46：写后检查交回命令、命令 PATH 只用根外绝对项）；S-34 命令只在授权根之外找
open_prs.body:
换 Prologue 包：从上游 main `94ee1ea4` 打包（[Prologue #42](https://github.com/molis-ai/prologue/pull/42)–[#46](https://github.com/molis-ai/prologue/pull/46)），加 S-34：Agent 的命令只按裸名、只在授权根之外找，Molis 自己有断言拒绝的用例。只换包和加这一行，Molis 的代码不改；写后检查的 Molis 实现（采用 spec §6.0p）和手册线 C4 的 Molis 半边排在这之后。

分支 `adoption/sdk-after-write-check`，从 main `877dc7626` 开，合过 main `6505378e8`（#695）。

## 比上一份多的五项

| PR | 合并 / head | 改了什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| #42 | `3766ed52` / `67098790` | `dispatch-subagent` 的说明写清点名的角色和子任务的步骤对它能用的工具有什么影响。只改说明文字 |
| #43 | `68545af6` / `c4b1652b` | `search` 的说明写清它按文件内容找，不按文件名找。只改说明文字 |
| #44 | `1110049c` / `17436096` | 两台 Host 起命令时，`PATH` 只留授权根之外的绝对项（见下面 S-34） |
| #45 | `7b201ed5` / `f29a0ec5` | 写后检查改成执行器只回一条命令（JSON），SDK 核过、经命令审查去跑，事实拼进写入的观察；删全局开关 `config.workspace.diagnoseAfterWrite` |
| #46 | `94ee1ea4` / `ccd6a649` | `ask-user` 题目 `id` 的说明写出校验接受的格式。只改说明文字 |

## 对 Molis 的影响

1. **开发时根里的 `node_modules/.bin` 找不到了。** 起 Host 的进程，`PATH` 里的相对项和落在授权根里的目录都不再用：前台命令回 `exitCode` 为空的回执，后台和交互进程报 `COMMAND_FAILED`。用 pnpm 脚本起 Host 时，pnpm 会在 `PATH` 前面加 `node_modules/.bin`；授权根里若有它（例如 Coding 打开的就是本仓库），`tsc`、`vitest` 这类只装在仓库里的工具，Agent 的命令就找不到了。要用，就把工具装在授权根之外，再把那个绝对目录放进 Host 进程的 `PATH`。
2. **`config.workspace.diagnoseAfterWrite` 没有了。** Molis 从没设过它，`git grep` 只在 2026-10-02 的评审文档里找到。
3. **写后检查只在会话的包声明了它、又有执行器时才有。** Molis 没有一条会话的包声明 `coding.diagnose-after-write`，也没给 `coding.diagnostics` 执行器（创作台的编码 Agent 用自己的 `checkPack()`），所以写入的观察和换包前一样，一个字不加。Molis 自己的写后检查（[采用 spec](https://github.com/molis-ai/molis-work/blob/main/specs/prologue-adoption/spec.md) §6.0p）随后单独做。

## S-34：命令的 `PATH` 只用授权根之外的绝对项

`docs/system/SECURITY-INVARIANTS.md` 表里新加一行（统筹 10-17 定为正式一行，不放 §4）：Coding 在用户的机器上跑命令，这条边界 Molis 自己要有断言拒绝的用例，下次换包时 Prologue 那边若退回去，Molis 的 CI 要能红。

- **被拒绝的**：`.`、空项、相对项，以及落在任何一个已授权根里的绝对项（根本身、根里的目录、指进根的链接，按真实路径判断）；一项不剩时不给 `PATH`（给空串等于给一个空项，空项就是根）。模型写得进授权根，留着这些项，人批的 `fakecheck` 跑的就可能是根里模型改过的那一个。根外的绝对项照常找。
- **守在哪**：SDK 的两台 Host（[Prologue #44](https://github.com/molis-ai/prologue/pull/44)）：Node 的 `packages/sdk/src/host/plugin/node-command-env.ts`（`commandEnv`）与 Tauri 的 `crates/prologue-host-tauri/src/processes.rs`（`path_outside_roots`）；SDK 自己的拒绝用例是 `packages/sdk/test/host-command-path.test.ts` 与 `crates/prologue-host-tauri/tests/command_path.rs`。Molis 的 Agent 命令由 `horizontal/agent-host/src/adapters/prologue-node.ts` 起的 Node Host 跑，Tauri 那一台 Molis 不用。
- **用例**：`tests/security-invariants-command-path.test.ts`，照 S-13（`prologue-memory-boundary`）的写法：只经 `@molis-ai/molis-work-service-agent-host` 的公开出口（`createPrologueNodeAdapter`、`AgentReviewQueue`），不新开对 `@prologue/sdk` 的依赖；模型请求用 `fetch` 的替身，不出网。临时根里有 `project/fakecheck`、`project/bin/fakecheck`，根外有 `outside/fakecheck` 和指进 `project/bin` 的链接 `outside/linked-bin`。Agent 发 `run-command {executable: "fakecheck"}`，人在命令审查里批准，再看命令的结果回给模型的是谁：
  - 「S-34 a command finds its bare name in an absolute directory outside the root…」：`PATH` 是 `.:bin:<根>:<根>/bin:<根外>/linked-bin:<根外>:/usr/bin:/bin`，跑的是根外那个，根里的一个都没跑。
  - 「S-34 when every PATH entry leads into the root, the command gets no PATH…」：`PATH` 里只有 `.`、空项、`bin`、根、根里的目录、指进根的链接，命令找不到，根里的一个都没跑。
- **用例确实会红**：把装进来的包里 `commandEnv` 改成五种变体各跑一次（改完换回、核对 SHA-256 一致），每种都至少红一条：

  | 变体 | 结果 |
  | --- | --- |
  | 不过滤，`PATH` 原样给（#44 之前的行为） | 2 条都红 |
  | 只丢相对项，不查是否落在根里 | 2 条都红 |
  | 按字面比，不取真实路径（链接漏掉） | 2 条都红 |
  | 相对项也留着 | 2 条都红 |
  | 一项不剩时给空 `PATH` | 第 2 条红 |

  最后一种先活着：第一版用例总在后面加 `/usr/bin:/bin`，「一项不剩」从没发生。第 2 条改成只给落进根的项之后才红。
- 编号：#695 先合入、占了 S-33，这一行取 S-34，用例标题同号（统筹 10-17 定：谁后合入谁顺延，表里编号连续）。merge main 时表里只有这一处冲突，两行都留，S-33 在前。

## vendored 的记录（`vendor/prologue-sdk/`）

| 文件 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `prologue-sdk-0.0.0-rc.1-after-write-check.tgz` | 1,218,580 字节，SHA-256 `ba2507c9e02a11c4768d0234e67f9eb8b3ee3e93b9ce4ca026e05054f5a7448d`，integrity `sha512-wd9dSJiJGj86+LHcK59/rKmC7IcM+XWP/XWrnXe12arnZMjO1cNw8ZEIrOwOJBH47yFax92qRAl+g7A2FgKdBw==` |
| `….tgz.sha256` | `ba2507c9…  prologue-sdk-0.0.0-rc.1-after-write-check.tgz` |
| `….tgz.provenance.json` | `source.commit` = `94ee1ea4f48baf529b2ce624b8ee54acefb7bb7f`；`mergedUpstream` = #46（head `ccd6a649f95e69adf6e210afe55891c3c692597f`，2026-10-18T00:32:10Z），note 写明它叠在 #45、#44、#43、#42 之上；`dirty: false`，`patches: []`；`build`：Node 24.14.0、pnpm 11.9.0、darwin arm64，四步（`git archive 94ee1ea4` → `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline` → `pnpm --filter @prologue/sdk run build` → `pnpm pack`），`reproducedFrom` = `94ee1ea4`，`reproducedByteIdentical: true` |
| 旧包 `prologue-sdk-0.0.0-rc.1-parked-run.tgz` 及它的 `.sha256`、`.provenance.json` | 删掉 |
| `patch-history.json` → `packagesWithoutPatch` | 加第 27 条：旧包 `parked-run.tgz`，1,211,301 字节，SHA-256 `6f551e02050f85bb431aca88ac76ed67f0495b2c606e5e60b3e1c2625a9e61e2`，git blob `da38441c019b12a2aa7ebf768be2c4ef32d8172c`，来源 `b541a8e62752fce23c83f959d55e549b3086557f`，说明被哪一份替换、怎样从 Git 历史取回 |
| `patch-history.json` → `upstream` | `mainHead` = `94ee1ea4`；`statement` 改成对 `94ee1ea4` 逐项复核（`git merge-base --is-ancestor`，除三个已知的过渡包来源外都是祖先）；`commitsChecked` 加 `94ee1ea4`（36 → 37） |

open_prs.title: 统一输入与本地语音：补齐草稿、录音及桌面验收路径
open_prs.body:
## 解决的问题

首页、助手和 Coding 采用一致的多行输入、本地语音、键盘发送和状态反馈。Enter 换行，Command/Ctrl+Enter 发送；草稿、上下文和迟到结果始终归原入口与工作，确认接收后才清空，未知回执保留待确认且不重复提交。

- 修复刷新空值覆盖草稿、切工作后迟到回执清错内容、Coding 配置恢复与可用状态不同步；失败重试恢复原回合的完整附件及多行原文，读取迟到不覆盖另一工作的新草稿。
- 输入框随正文增长并内部滚动，材料与下一步行实际占位；窄窗口中的面板标题、录音、发送和键盘焦点可用，同时修复相关侧栏、ToDo、成果预览和 Jelly 提示遮挡。
- 本地识别支持真实浏览器 AAC；修复默认英语提示干扰短中文、原生日志污染 JSON、取消后 helper 残留，以及构建沿软链接覆盖其他检出。下载后明确显示模型准备阶段，支持取消和重试，不静默改用云端。
- 修复侧栏浏览器异步绑定项目时丢弃导航；绑定按顺序完成，导航和停止仍可并发。

## 验证

- 当前提交 `2a5371d0a2c772f74dc7d41b959cc2d0fae817c0`：[普通 CI](https://github.com/molis-ai/molis-work/actions/runs/39065654952)、[Full suite](https://github.com/molis-ai/molis-work/actions/runs/39065891367) 全部通过。Full suite 16 分片及汇总成功，1041 个 Linux 文件均纳入，没有失败后重试；条件跳过仍按平台、外部凭据和 opt-in 分开记录。
- 缺陷回归先在旧实现失败，再在修复后通过；保持原有业务断言、重试次数与门禁。最后一处仅调整 Coding 回执测试的模型夹具：核对中间送达提示后才结束回复，避免正常完成状态抢先替换提示；仍核对唯一输入、持久化回执、打断标记、撤回与更正。
- 29 个 macOS 专项已由本机集成批次覆盖；语音另用系统禁网的最终 helper 补验。最新工作台相关 20/20 文件、健康门禁、类型与逐提交密钥扫描通过。页面资源 25 项、7,478,823 字节，未提高预算。
- 最终 macOS App 核对生产源码指纹、实际运行程序与独立 Home 后实操：失败后恢复四行原文及完整附件，窄窗键盘路径，A/B 草稿隔离，退出重启后的 owner 数据，双按唯一发送，Coding 503 后继续，侧栏网页导航和点击。首页未知回执重启后保留且重复检查不重发；另一多行消息只被指定会话接收一次，成功后清空。模型回复和 Codex 接收端使用本机夹具。
- 停止点击到文字插入后绘制帧：固定中文合成样本、真实 AAC、正式 HTTP、禁网 helper，新模型路径首次 **46.796 秒**，同路径重复 **1.631 / 1.632 秒**。正常首次准备含下载与预热为 106.47 秒，之后三次为 1.682 / 1.683 / 1.732 秒。约 47 秒主要是首次模型加载/编译；冷热差异不作为同条件提速或真人体验证明。

## 合同与完成边界

新增受现有本机鉴权保护的 `/api/local-voice` 入口（根与项目路径），仅在明确确认后下载模型；识别复用本机材料 helper，取消终止该次进程并清理临时音频。安全不变量及拒绝断言同步维护。

材料预览 HTTP 读口新增可选 `run` 参数，读取同一 owner 指定原回合的完整已保存正文；默认预览、鉴权和材料大小限制不变。未改动作 schema、Manifest 格式或 MCP 工具名。

尚不判定 spec 的“内部完整”：系统中文候选窗、原生麦克风授权与真实录音/拔插、代表性中英混说和技术词等识别质量、VoiceOver 听感及主观体验仍为 UNVERIFIED。准确性、可接受等待与单次时长阈值须经代表性实测确认。

保持草稿 PR；未合并、公证或发布。候选 App、测试 Home 和运行日志仅保留本地。
