merged_since_previous.title: fix(assistant): a round in a sub-task that does not start ends the step placed for it
merged_since_previous.body:
Fixes a regression from #637, found in the anti-corruption review and confirmed by the coordinator on main.

## The bug

`AssistantService`'s send path places the round's step on the delegating work's graph before it starts the round. When a person sends a round inside a finished sub-task, that step is `<part>.rN`, held by the sub-task's session.

If the start then failed, the catch cleared only the memory receipt, and the step stayed open. A start fails when:
- a later send replaced this one;
- the Character version was refused;
- there was no model;
- `host.start` threw for another reason.

With the step open, the graph says the part is still working:
- the delegating work is never handed back to, because `settle` finds the part still owed;
- the part keeps one of the three active places;
- `follow_up` is refused.

All of this lasts until a round in that sub-task actually starts. Before #637, "working" was read from the run's state, so a round that never started didn't count.

The delegation path, where a part's first round can't start, was already right: `delegate`'s catch ends the step.

## The fix

`AssistantDelegations.startPlaced(work, start)` wraps the start:
- If the start throws, a step added for this round is ended by the session that holds it, with the note 「这一轮没有开始」.
- A step that was reused as it was is left alone.

The send path calls it in place of `place` + `host.start`. The placing itself moves to a module function, `placeOn`, so the class stays under the 300-line limit (293 → 290).

What a round asks the Host for (project, session, role, materials, images, budget, browser, Character) moves out of `AssistantService` into `roundStartInput` in the new `assistant-round-start.ts`, with `ownerOf` and `ROUND_TURNS`. It is built only from the Work and the round's inputs, so it doesn't need the class. Moving it lets the wrapped start keep the normal shape instead of being squeezed onto one line. `AssistantService` goes from 1640 to 1629 lines, and the file from 2054 to 2041.

## Cancellation, late results, half-commits

- **Cancellation:** a send replaced by a later one fails `assertSendCurrent` inside the wrapped start, so its step is ended like any other failed start.
- **Late results:** no late result path is involved.
- **Half-commits:** this PR removes one, the open step. If ending the step fails too, it stays open as before; the failure is swallowed so the original error reaches the caller.

## Which test turns red without the change

`W2-18-DELEGATION-PLACED-01` (`tests/assistant-delegation.test.ts`):
1. A part is handed out, finishes, and is handed back.
2. The person sends a round in it with no model. The send is refused.
3. The test then asserts:
   - no non-root step is open, and `.r1` is `cancelled`;
   - three new parts can be handed out, the full limit, all held running;
   - once they are back, the delegating work is handed back to again.

With the end call removed it goes red at "no step of the part is left open". With that assertion also removed, it goes red at the third hand-out (「已有 3 个子任务在进行」).

## Public surface

None. No contract, action, Manifest, MCP tool name or page asset changes. `place` was used only by the send path; it is replaced by `startPlaced`. `roundStartInput` builds the same request as before: the same fields, under the same conditions.

## Verification (on main `3abb5b01`)

- [x] `pnpm build`.
- [x] 106 non-browser files pass after a full `pnpm build`: the 85 that `affected-tests` selects plus every `assistant-*` file.
- [x] `pnpm test:security` 58/58, `pnpm test:contracts` 44/44.
- [x] `check-health-gates --base origin/main` (`baseline.json`: the `AssistantService` class and file entries lowered), `boundary:check`, `secrets:check`.
- [ ] Full suite: not run here. The coordinator runs it, since the assistant is shared core.

## 防腐复查

merged_since_previous.title: refactor(agent-host): a round that changed nothing has its ending checked against its facts, not wording lists; internal ids are the ones the Host gave (D1②)
merged_since_previous.body:
AI 手册线 D1②：说法守卫从「按措辞表认」改成「按这一轮的事实核对」。用户 2026-10-16 弹窗定了两项（事实交给模型核对；只认宿主给出的标识）。

## 做了什么

- **收尾核对**（`horizontal/agent-host/src/adapters/ending-review.ts`、`prologue-stop-guard.ts`）：可写的一轮没有任何成功的改动就要结束时，宿主把这一轮的事实（调用过的工具和每次的结果、记忆能不能用、随附了哪些材料）连同最后的话交给这一轮的模型核对一次。指令是这一轮的主人登记的「收尾核对」提示词（见下一条），没有工具，材料按不可信数据围起来，问两件事：最后一段在做什么；哪一句说这一轮已经保存、记住、忘掉或做好了按钮。答出的每种说法每轮拦一次、续做一次（用户 09-28 的「只说不做时自动接着做一次」不变）。核对出错、超时或答得不是要的 JSON 就放过。
- **核对的指令是主人登记的提示词**（统筹 10-17 评审，照上下文整理的先例）：Manifest 的 `ending_review: { prompt_id }` 指向自己 prompts 里的一条；agent-host 不带提示词文字，开跑时按声明的版本取用户改过的正文交给适配器，冻结记录里写 `ending_review: { prompt_id, version, user_revision? }`。Assistant 登记 `assistant-ending-review` v1（定稿正文），Coding 登记 `coding-ending-review` v1（只问最后一段在做什么和改了或跑了什么）；两条都在「设置 › 提示词」里叫「收尾核对」。没有声明的 Agent 不核对。原来的适配器开关 `endingReview` 删掉。
- 删掉四张措辞表（`announcesWithoutActing`、`claimsMemoryChange`、`claimsButton`、`claimsSavedChange`）和按词数的操作卡计数。
- **内部标识**只认宿主这一轮给过模型的（工具名、能力标识、字段名、工具结果里的 id 与错误码），不再按形状猜（带下划线的词、编号形状）。子任务交回给派它的那项工作的报告不查标识。
- 把调用写成文字仍由宿主自己看出（那是我们自己的调用语法）。
- 停止钩子从 `prologue-run.ts` 搬进 `prologue-stop-guard.ts`；`prologue-run.ts` 少 61 行。

## 评测（详见手册需求书 §9.5「D1②」）

- Coding 的指令（10 条自编 Coding 结尾 × 3）：27/30，如实的误拦 0/15，只说下一步 6/6，说改了或跑了的 6/9（漏的记为模型能力）。
- 核对本身（单次调用，三组自编结尾，判断标准在跑之前写下，120 次）：定稿 104/120，如实的结尾误拦 1/54，只说下一步认出 20/21。旧措辞表在同样 40 条上 28/40、如实的误拦 4/18。草稿一（一个问题找「对不上的说法」）只有 30/57、误拦 13/27，是写法问题；草稿二到四的变化与理由都在记录里。
- 实走（8 任务 × 3 次，改前 / 草稿一 / 定稿共 72 次）：子任务的误拦 7 → 0；主工作拦下 1 → 2，都是汇总里贴了文档 id（对的）；定稿核对 7 次，都在没改动的轮次，都答没有、都对；核对每次约 1.3k 字符入、20 token 出。改前基线是 main 769d11797（带着 #614、#621，旧守卫两版相同），所以拦下的比较成立，用量与耗时只作参考。
- 已知的漏：做了改动的轮次不核对（选定方案的取舍）；核对的用量不进这一轮的预算显示；核对用这一轮开始时的模型。

## 合同变化与对插件、调用方的影响

- `contracts/services/agent-host`：`AgentActionClient` 加可选字段 `reader?: "work"`（这一轮的回复由谁读：省略是人，`"work"` 是派它的那项工作）。只由助理的委派入口（`assistant-authority.ts`）给；别的调用方不用改，插件 SDK、动作、MCP 工具名都没变。API 快照已刷新。
- `contracts/platform/plugin`（`AgentManifest`）：加可选字段 `ending_review?: { prompt_id }`。插件可以声明一条收尾核对的提示词；声明了就必须在 `prompts` 里有这一条（SDK 的 `inspectAgentDeclaration` 查），不声明就不核对，现有插件不用改。
- `contracts/services/agent-host`：`AgentStartRequest.role` 加 `ending_review?: { prompt: AgentPromptText }`（宿主按 Manifest 解析后给适配器）；冻结记录加 `ending_review?: { prompt_id, version, user_revision? }`。自己拼 start 请求的调用方不给就不核对。
- 行为：Assistant 和 Coding 的可写一轮如果没有成功的改动就结束，会多一次核对调用；写死模型回复、跑 Assistant 或 Coding 一轮的测试，把核对答成「没有」、不占脚本的一步也不进请求计数：fetch 替身用 `tests/fixtures/ending-review.ts` 的 `answeringEndingReviews` 包住，本机模型服务（含共用的 `issue-model`、`model-stand-in`、`recording-text-model`、`assistant-text-model`）先用 `endingReviewReply` 认出核对请求。30 个测试文件，断言都没动。上一版（a62398366）在应用组合里给所有一轮都开了核对，而全量没跑过，这一版把这些按脚本走的浏览器用例一并补上。
- `skills/molis-plugin-dev/elements.md`：Agent 合同的可选字段里加上 `ending_review` 一句。

## 测试

- `pnpm build` 后，`affected-tests.mjs` 选出的文件，加上所有手写模型替身的测试（共 258 个非浏览器文件）和 6 个浏览器文件。它建议跑全量（contracts 变了），全量交统筹。
- 新增与改写：`announce-guard`（事实来自事件、标识只认给过的、答案只按问的读）、`assistant-business-gateway`（核对请求没有工具、围起来的事实、拦一次与放过）、`assistant-delegation`（子任务报告不查标识）、`assistant-memory`（记忆说法经核对）、`agent-definitions`（核对用用户改过的版本、冻结记录带版本、登记在「收尾核对」下）、`coding-history-requirements`（核对请求单独计数）。验收编号 ADH-16～18。
- `node scripts/check-health-gates.mjs --base origin/main` 通过；`pnpm secrets:check` 通过。

## 防腐复查

- 不加措辞禁令、正则或特例开关：删掉了四张措辞表和一个形状猜测，判断交给有事实的核对。模型认不出的几种说法照「不打补丁」记成模型能力，不加措辞。
- 没有新的超限单元（三处挤一行避开 `composeAgentHost`、`AgentHost`、`start` 变长）；没有新的兼容标记、空 catch、`as unknown as`、显式 `any`；测试引用包内部的数没涨。
- 动了 `plugins/native/coding/src/roles.ts`（Coding 登记自己的核对提示词）和 `packages/contracts/src/platform/plugin-agent.ts`（Manifest 的可选声明），是统筹 10-17 的要求所需；没动 `start-round.ts`、网关工具描述、动作、vendored SDK。
- 一件事一个主人：停止钩子只在 `prologue-stop-guard.ts`，事实只在 `RoundFacts`，核对指令归这一轮的主人（Assistant、Coding 各一条登记的提示词），agent-host 只读回答里约定的那一行 JSON。
- 合同兼容：加的是可选字段，不留旧读法；核对的答案只认现行形状（草稿的 `claims` 形状读成没有）。
- 和在途工作的重叠：开着的 PR 都不碰这些文件。

merged_since_previous.title: feat(receipts): D1 — the remember tool tells the model only the outcome; the card says 「你刚才让我记住」 (RC-19, D32)
merged_since_previous.body:
This is specs/ai-input-receipts walk-through finding D, option D1 (D32, RC-19). The coordinator chose D1 on 2026-10-16. Merge-base: main `be534a1a`.

## The problem

A person writes 「……。另外请记住：X」. The write gate (`horizontal/memory/src/spoken.ts`) counts as 「你说过」 only the whole of one message, so X becomes a suggestion. That rule stays; it was settled by six rounds of review by memory's owner.

What went wrong was the wording around it:
- **The model.** The `remember` tool threw the gate's whole reason back to it (「要把整条消息原样照抄才记作你说的，改写、删减、拼接都不算…」), and the model read that rule out to the person.
- **The card.** The Assistant's card said 「要记住吗：X」 with the same rule as its subtitle, although the person had just asked for it.

## What changes

**The tool tells the model only the outcome.** When the gate holds a `remember`, the error is now 「没有直接记住，已作为建议放在工作面板，等用户认可」.
- It is still an error, so the model cannot claim the text was kept.
- A refusal (for example a secret) still says why. Only the held-as-suggestion case changes.

**The card says what the person asked.** For a suggestion the gate held from a `remember`:
- the title is 「你刚才让我记住：X」;
- the line under it shows only the scope;
- the primary button 「记住」 keeps it with one press, as before;
- why it was not kept directly (the memory service's own `hold_reason`) is in the card's details (its `title`).

The work's own suggestions (`propose`) keep 「要记住吗：X」 and their reasons.

**Unchanged:** the gate, its wording, and the settings page's memory list, which still shows `hold_reason` in full.

**Spec.** RC-19 is added.

**Backlog.** BL-153, at the coordinator's request: `affected-tests` did not pick `tests/prologue-recovery.test.ts` when B changed `AgentTurnSteer`. A contract field changed, and the tests that read that field were not selected. Owned by the anti-corruption line (tooling).

## Contract change (`api:update`)

`contracts/services/assistant`: `AssistantMemoryCandidate` gains `held?: string`.
- **What it is:** the gate's reason, present only when the person asked to keep the text and the gate held it back.
- **Callers that read the Assistant's work view:** the field is optional and additive. Only the Assistant's card reads it.
- **Plugins:** none read this type.
- **Actions and MCP tools:** unchanged.

One field instead of two (`asked` + `hold_reason`): `contracts/services/assistant.ts` is 799 lines, one short of a new giant unit.

## Bytes: offset in this slice, no allowance (D33)

On its own, D1 adds 90 bytes to `workbench.js`: one translated title and the card's branch. The offset is in the same PR:
- The tab menu's item helper (`add(label, icon, key, action)`) was written twice in `tab-workspace.ts`: once for a tab's menu and once for a group's. They differed only in that a tab's menu puts focus back on the active tab.
- It is now one `menuItem(paneId, refocus)`. The behaviour is the same, and the file is 4 lines shorter.

| Asset | main → D1 |
| --- | --- |
| `workbench.js` | 1101126 → 1100802 (**−324**) |

No other asset moves, and the gate is not changed.

## Checks

- `pnpm build` passed on the merge with main `be534a1a`.
- page-assets and health gates pass against `origin/main`. No giant unit grew; `assistant-island.ts` keeps its line count.
- API snapshot: only the change above.
- Affected tests (`affected-tests --base origin/main`): 128 non-browser files, plus the browser files for the card and the tab menu (`assistant-input-receipts`, `workbench-tab-workspace`, `workbench-current-tabs`, `assistant-page-cards`, `issue-clarification-page`).
  - A first run at load average 24 failed 11 files. All of them pass when re-run 2 at a time, apart from the note below.
- **Not shown to be from D1: `issue-capture-page.e2e`.** It failed one test on each of two local runs: ISSUE-38 the first time, ISSUE-37 the second. Neither test touches the memory card or the tab menu. The fixture's paths for them are unchanged, because `remember` is a new branch that only RC-19 sets. Main + C1 passed it 6/6 once. Left to the full suite.
- After merging main `be534a1a`: `assistant-memory`, `assistant-memory-error-model`, `assistant-island-script`, `page-assets-budget` and `health-gates-api-snapshot` pass (5/5).
- **Expected change, `tests/assistant-memory.test.ts`.** 14 assertions matched `/原话/` on the tool error, which proved the gate held the text because it was not the person's words. The model no longer gets that reason, so the same proof now has two parts, both strict, in one helper (`heldAsNotTheirs`):
  - the error is the outcome sentence, with no rule in it;
  - the stored suggestion for that exact text carries the 「原话」 reason.
  - Nothing was dropped, and every message string is kept.
- **New tests (RC-19):**
  - `assistant-memory`, a full round: the request the model sees after a held `remember` says 「没有直接记住」 and contains none of the rule. The work view's suggestion has `held`.
  - `assistant-input-receipts.e2e`, with the model fixture's new `remember` behaviour:
    - the person sends 「帮我整理这周的周报。另外请记住：周报先写风险」;
    - the card reads 「你刚才让我记住：周报先写风险」 with 「个人」 under it, and its primary button is 「记住」;
    - the details equal the memory service's reason;
    - the conversation never shows the rule, and one press settles it.
    - Screenshot `assistant-remember-asked.png` (ignored folder).

## 防腐复查

**Pass.**

Machine checks:
- M1 health: pass.
- M2 page assets: pass, and smaller.
- M4 secrets: pass.
- M5 affected tests: pass (see above).
- M13: the API snapshot is regenerated; actions are unchanged.
- M6 (gate change) does not apply: no gate change.

Items:
1. **No compatibility.** `held` is optional because the work's own suggestions have no gate reason. Nothing reads old shapes.
2. **Registered once.** No new capability or action.
3. **Call chains.** Memory service candidate → `assistantCandidate` → work view → card. The tool's error goes back to the model only through the existing gateway.
4. **Identity.** Whether the person asked comes from the candidate's own `from: "gate"`, never from the page or the model.
5–6. **Layers and model calls.** No new import. No model call is added. **No prompt patch:** we removed words we fed the model ourselves, and added none.
7–8. **Kernel and placement.** The reason stays memory's fact, shown in its own words. The card stays in the Assistant's work panel.
9. **Giant units.** None grew; `tab-workspace.ts` is shorter.
11. **Contracts.** One optional field.
12–13. **Contract change and snapshots.** Impact stated above.
14. **Error model.** No new codes; the existing `assistantErrors.invalid`.
15. **Data.** No tables.
16. **Names.** Follow the spec.
17. **Security.** Untouched. A held text still never becomes 「你说过」.
18. **Pages.** None.
19. **Assets.** Smaller.
20. **Wording.** One new title, with English in `assistant-en.ts`.
21. **Requests.** None added.
22. **Tests.** Ids are in the test names. The changed assertions keep their proof, as stated above.
23. **Acceptance ids.** RC-19.
24. **Prologue SDK.** Unchanged.
25. **Hub files.** `contracts/services/assistant.ts` (+1 line), `assistant-island.ts` (2 lines), `tooling/gates/page-assets.json`, `tooling/gates/baseline.json`, `specs/BACKLOG.md`; also `tab-workspace.ts`. #631 also edits `assistant-island.ts` near the card; whichever lands second merges.
26. **Branch hygiene.** Own paths only. Main is merged in, not rebased.
27. **Gates.** Untouched.

merged_since_previous.title: feat(receipts): C1 — what waits for the next round shows at the end of Coding's conversation (RC-18, D31)
merged_since_previous.body:
This is specs/ai-input-receipts walk-through finding C, option C1 (D31, RC-18). It is its own slice after 3c (D33) and follows B (#628, merged). Merge-base: main `5239a371`.

## What changes

**Coding shows what waits for the next round.** A supplement sent 「下一轮再做」, or one a finished round never read, used to wait in the runtime's queue with nothing on the page saying so.
- While the session has queued supplements and no round is live (the round ended, or stopped for 「核对并继续」), the end of the conversation shows one line: 「排着 N 条补充，下一轮开始时带上」.
- It is drawn like the Host's own notes (`.coding-turn[data-kind=notice]`), not like the person's words. It opens in place to show each supplement's text.
- Redrawing the same queue keeps the same node, so an opened strip stays open. It goes once the next round takes the supplements.
- While a round is live, nothing is shown. What a live round takes belongs to it, and its receipts already say so.

**Where the data comes from.** The runtime's own queue (`session.inputQueue()`), read by agent-host only between rounds. Molis keeps no second copy.
- `prologue-recovery.ts`: `queued(sessionId)`. A session that cannot be opened reads as unknown (`undefined`), never as an empty queue.
- `PrologueAgentAdapter.readSession` adds `queued_inputs` only when no round is live, counting `reconcile-required` as not live. It is absent when nothing waits.
- Coding's timeline route passes it through, and the shared receipt client draws it (`inputReceipts.waiting(list)`).

**Spec.** RC-18 is added.

## Contract change (`api:update`)

`contracts/services/agent-host`: `AgentSessionView` gains `queued_inputs?: AgentQueuedInput[]`.
- **Readers of `readSession`** (Coding, the Assistant, recovery): the field is optional and additive. Only Coding reads it.
- **Plugins:** none read `AgentSessionView`.
- **Actions and MCP tools:** unchanged; the action contract snapshot passes.

## Bytes: offset in this slice, no allowance (D33)

On its own, C1 adds 758 bytes to `coding.js`. The offset is in the same PR, found the same way as B's:
- Coding's bundle inlined the Git and Files client factories twice each: once in Coding's setup and again in the companions.

merged_since_previous.title: feat(interaction): T2 — reference questions find objects by name; the run hears each pick under its owner's title (AC-28, D36)
merged_since_previous.body:
## What this does

The Assistant and Coding can now ask a **reference question**: pick a Goal, a document, a material or another object that this project already has (specs/ai-interaction-experience T2, D36, AC-28).

- **The model knows which kinds exist.** The Host works out the kinds the built-in manifests both list for search and read back (`hostReferenceKinds()`, 22 today, each with its owner's Chinese name). It hands them to Prologue as `tool.askUserReferenceKinds` (prologue#33, which came in with #632). In the `ask-user` schema, `refKinds` becomes an enum of these kinds. If the model asks for a kind outside the list, Prologue refuses it before anything is shown to the person, and the model is told which kinds exist. The prompt version is not bumped (D32, 统筹 10-17).
- **The card lists no candidates.** It shows a search box, and the page calls `search.references` (route `/api/search/references`, the same one on the workbench and the project chooser) only while the person types: 250 ms after typing stops, and only the latest answer counts. Results are a combobox and listbox: arrow keys, Enter, Escape. A single pick replaces the previous one; multiple picks stop at `max_count`. Each pick is a chip the person can remove. Drawing the card, the read view and Coding's polling never search.
- **The run hears each pick under its owner's title.** Before the Runtime sees the answer, the Host reads every pick again from its owner (`readReferences` from #618) and writes that title in. The title the page sent is never used. A pick that can no longer be read is refused as `reference-unavailable` on its own question (S-26).
- **Coding:** `coding.runs.control` goes to **v5**: `value` may be a list of `{kind, id, label}`, and versions 1–4 are refused. The Assistant's call into Coding moves to v5 in the same change. Coding uses the workbench's shared interaction client, so `coding.js` does not change.
- **Plugin SDK:** `questionAnswer` reads `r<n>` fields and returns `Array<{kind, id, label}>` for them; `label` is a placeholder that the Host replaces. This is an API snapshot change: plugin callers get one more possible shape for `value`.

## Page assets: one-time allowance (user-approved)

用户 10-17 弹窗批，上限 +1,344 / +1,344 / +4,090，另加 settings.css +19（同一次弹窗批的第四项）。

| `molis-work-arrival.css` | +1,344 | **+1,326** (744,923 → 746,249) |
| `molis-work-workbench.js` | +4,090 | **+4,037** (1,101,126 → 1,105,163) |
| `molis-work-settings.css` | +19 | **+19** (1,034,948 → 1,034,967) |
| `coding.js` | none | 0 |

These are one-time `APPROVED_CEILINGS` entries pinned to the exact merge-base budgets, the same way 3c did it. They replace 3c's three spent entries. A bounded test in `tests/page-assets-budget.test.ts` checks that:
- the approved size passes;
- one byte more fails, for each of the four assets;
- another asset still fails;
- the frozen baseline gives no further allowance.

The next change to this gate deletes the entries.

What offset the growth:
- the results list and the search box reuse `mw-menu` and `mw-input-group`;
- ARIA state is set through reflection (`ariaSelected`/`ariaExpanded`) instead of `setAttribute`;
- the redundant `flex: 1` and coarse-pointer rules are gone;
- the old candidate list and its toggle code are removed;
- the search wrapper is written into the two existing page scripts instead of a new `*_SCRIPT` constant.

## The double focus ring

The screenshots showed a focused `mw-input-group` drawing the copper edge and halo twice: once on the group and once on the input inside it. craft-finish's focus rule, `body:is(…) :is(.mw-input, …):not([data-plain-field]):focus-visible`, has specificity (0,4,1) and so beat the primitives' in-group reset. This affected every grouped input: for example the project chooser's search, the plugin picker's search and the new reference search.

**Fix:** the rule now excludes inputs inside a group (`:not([data-plain-field], .mw-input-group *)`), so the ring is drawn once, on the group. That costs 19 bytes on each sheet that carries craft-finish. The workbench and arrival sheets absorb it within their limits; settings.css is the approved +19.

**Assertion:** `tests/assistant-typed-questions.e2e.test.ts` (AC-28) focuses the search box in the real workbench and checks computed styles: the input matches `:focus-visible`, the inner input has no `box-shadow` and a 0px border, and the group has a non-`none` `box-shadow`. This is in addition to the screenshots.

## Tests

| Kind | Files |
| --- | --- |
| New or changed unit tests | `agent-reference-questions` (new), `agent-question-types` (**AC-28-1**: `refKinds` is an enum of exactly the Home's kinds, and a guessed kind never opens a wait — green on #632's package), `agent-typed-questions`, `interaction-components`, `interaction-sdk-mapping`, `assistant-interaction-html`, `coding-actions`, `coding-run-control-contract`, `security-invariants-object-references`, `page-assets-budget`, `action-contract-snapshot` |
| Browser | `interaction-client.e2e` (AC-28-2/6: debounce, listbox, arrows/Enter, cap, Escape, unpick, empty, failed, stale), `assistant-typed-questions.e2e` (a Goal found by name, picked by keyboard, heard under its owner's title, screenshots, single ring), `ai-interaction-slice.e2e`, `coding-question-card.e2e` |
| S-26: tests that assert the refusal itself | 「S-26 a search for a question's objects never offers a kind the question did not ask for」 · the page's title (页面写的标题) never reaches the run (it hears the owner's 内部试用上线) · a kind outside the question is refused with `kind-not-allowed` |
| Added to the CI product subset | `tests/agent-reference-questions.test.ts` |

## Screenshots

`.impeccable/qa/review/ai-interaction/assistant-reference-question-{empty,results,picked}-{light,dark,390}.png`. These are local only (in the ignored directory), not committed.

## 防腐复查

Recorded in spec §18 (2026-10-17 entry).

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| M1 boundaries | `boundary:check` passes. The design system imports neither contracts nor the SDK. The Host reads only built-in manifests for the kinds. No plugin imports another. |
| M2 health gate against merge-base `aabf597d` | Passes. 0 new `*_SCRIPT` text constants. `craft-finish.ts`'s giant-unit line count is unchanged. 0 new `as unknown as`, empty `catch` or compatibility markers. |
| Contracts | API snapshot: `plugin-sdk` `questionAnswer` return type (`pnpm api:update`). Action snapshot: `coding.runs.control@5`, older versions refused, all callers updated in this change. `search.references@1` unchanged. |
| DOM events, error codes, translations | 0 new DOM events. 0 new error codes: `kind-not-allowed`, `too-many` and `reference-unavailable` already exist in the contract. 9 new Chinese strings, each with English; 「没有找到」 reuses Todo's "No matches", so no new translation conflict. |
| Security | The S-26 row in `docs/system/SECURITY-INVARIANTS.md` names the new code and tests. Trusted identity comes from the session owner, not from input. |
| Model weakness (user rule 10-16) | No prompt prohibitions, regexes or special cases. The kind list comes from the manifests and is enforced by the upstream enum. |
| Left over | External plugins' kinds aren't on the list, because Prologue fixes it when the Runtime is made (BL-152). |

merged_since_previous.title: test(ci): the Linux probe test waits for the pid itself, not just the pid file
merged_since_previous.body:
A race in `tests/ci-linux-probe.test.ts`. It turned #643's Gates job red (job 117353732619); #643 itself did not cause it. This PR changes only the test. The user approved it through the coordinator on 2026-10-17.

## Why

- `cutOff()` waited only for the `hang-pid` file to **exist**.
- The fixture writes it with `writeFileSync`, which creates the file before it fills it. So the test could read an empty file.
- `Number("")` is `0`, and `ps -o pgid= -p 0` fails: "process ID out of range".

## The change

`pidIn(file)` returns the pid only once the file holds a positive integer, and `0` before that.
- `cutOff` waits until `pidIn(hangPid) > 0`, then reads the pid through it.
- **The same read in `after()`.** Before, a `0` there would have been `process.kill(0, "SIGKILL")`, which signals the test's own process group. Now it kills only a real pid.
- **The leftover test.** It reads through `pidIn` and now also asserts that the pid was written. Before, a `0` would have made `alive(0)` true and failed with a misleading message.

No assertion is relaxed or removed, and no time limit changed. The coordinator offered two fixes: (a) in the test, or (b) rename in the fixture. I picked (a), which also covers the two other reads.

## Checks

- `node scripts/run-tests.mjs tests/ci-linux-probe.test.ts`, run 5 times on main `aabf597de`: 23/23 each time.
- `check-health-gates --base origin/main`: pass.
- Secrets: pass.
- Test file only: no product code, gate, or snapshot changes.

## 防腐复查

**Pass.**
- 22. **Tests.** Nothing relaxed; one assertion added.
- 27. **Gates.** Untouched.
- M4 secrets: pass.

merged_since_previous.title: test(memory): upkeep's fake clock moves on from the entries' own dates — a date bomb from 2026-10-17 08:00Z
merged_since_previous.body:
A date bomb in `tests/memory-upkeep.test.ts`. Since 2026-10-17 08:00 UTC, the upkeep test fails on every tree, main included. This PR changes only the test.

## What fails

The test is 「upkeep switches off expired and long-unused automatic memories, …」 (memory-system §6.4: automatic memories unused for 90 days are switched off). It fails at:

```
assert.equal(report.unused, 2, "automatic ones unused for 90 days (the older survivor of the merge and the e-mail one)")
0 !== 2
```

It first showed in #643's Product subset (run 39015389677, 07:56Z start). Main's run at 07:51Z had passed.

## Why

- The test writes its memories through the real Prologue runtime, which dates each entry by the real clock (`created_at_ms`). In the product, `MemoryService`'s `now` is that same real clock, so the product has no defect. A memory's creation time has one owner, the runtime's entry.
- The test then set the fake clock to a fixed day, `2027-01-15T08:00Z`, to stand for "more than 90 days later".
- That day is exactly 90 days after 2026-10-17T08:00Z. Once real time passed it, the entries were less than 90 days old on the fake clock, and nothing counted as unused.

## The change

The fake clock now moves on from the entries' own creation times. It is set 91 days after the latest `created_at` among the memories written.
- Before setting it, the test asserts that the two automatic memories in question are listed, so the base cannot come from the wrong entries.
- Every assertion is unchanged and keeps its meaning.

The coordinator decided (2026-10-17) to fix the test and leave the product alone. Making `MemoryService` write its own `created_at` would give that time two owners.

## Checks

- Run 5 times at 08:42Z real time, after the 08:00Z cutoff: 5 out of 5 green, all 6 tests in the file.
- `check-health-gates --base origin/main`: pass.
- Before the change, it failed 5 times out of 5 on main `aabf597de` + C1 and on #643's head (`0 !== 2`).
- Test file only: no product code, gate, or snapshot changes.

## 防腐复查

**Pass.**
- 1, 22. **No assertion relaxed, skipped, or deleted.** Only the fake clock's starting point changes.
- 3–8. **One owner for the fact.** No product change.
- 27. **Gates.** Untouched.
- M4 secrets: pass.

merged_since_previous.title: refactor(design-system): W5-05 slice 4 — delete the personal-workbench-v3 skin; live rules move to their owners, checked in browser and desktop mode
merged_since_previous.body:
W5-05 slice 4 removes `packages/design-system/src/styles/personal-workbench-v3.ts`: 433 rules and 1,641 declarations. It was a giant unit, so the giant-unit count falls from 141 to 140 and `baseline.json` is lowered.

**Base is `main`** now that #619 and #624 have merged. Main was merged in with a merge commit (no rebase), and the page budgets were re-measured on the merged tree.

This slice also carries the **desktop-mode pass** the coordinator asked for. It covers slices 1–4; see "Equivalence evidence" below.

## What changes

Deleting the layer outright changes a lot:
- the state probe finds 173,546 differences in 837,542 values;
- 12 pictures change: goals-list and goal-work at 1024 and 1440, by 3%–5%.

So the rules that still decide a computed value move to the stylesheets that own their elements, not to a fallback file. Each group goes at the head of its owner file, so its place in the cascade is unchanged.

The layers between v3 and each owner were checked statically for flips: a later rule with the same selector and the same property would take over once the order changes.

| What | Moves to |
| --- | --- |
| The whole Feed and Source group, in v3's order (see below) | `source-feed.ts` |
| Directory pane: `.tree-pane`, resizer, directory heading, row radius and hover | `directory-ledger.ts` |
| Desktop shell frame: safe-area variables and the native window's 88px inset, the `.app` grid, project menu, drag regions, `.document-pane` padding and background, work surface, TUI pane hidden on non-Goal surfaces | `desktop-titlebar.ts` |
| Read-only Runtime pane (`.tui-pane[data-tui-read-only]`): only the parent guard shows; no tabs, chrome, terminal or menu | `navigation-ownership.ts` |
| Trash Goal document at desktop widths: width, gaps, padding, status chip, title tracking, workspace min-height | Goals `trash-document-styles.ts`, its existing `@media (min-width: 761px)` block, under `.trash-goal-document` |

**The Feed and Source group:**
- v3 has 207 Feed rules. The 120 whose elements exist in markup move as one group.
- The other 87 have no element in any template, so they are deleted.
- After the move, four properties were taken over by later rules in the same layer, so I dropped them from the moved rules:
  - `.feed-source-list` gap;
  - the detail title's size, tracking and line height;
  - narrow `.feed-directory-tools` padding;
  - the narrow detail title size.
- Computed values are the same as before.

All owner files stay under 800 lines: 562, 464, 285, 306 and 105.

**Two dead groups kept for now.** The first full suite found two files that assert v3 rules by their text, which the affected-test selection had missed:
- `tests/web.test.ts`, the two "desktop work tabs…" tests;
- `tests/chrome-inner-scroll.test.ts`, the settings page's two-column content.

Both groups go back to their owners unchanged, and no assertion changes:
- The work tabs (111 lines, plus the `max-width` under 1180px) go at the head of `desktop-titlebar.ts`, which already owns the tabs' drag and motion rules.
- The `body.settings-page[data-desktop-shell="true"]:has(.settings-navigation) .settings-content` rule goes in a new `apps/workbench/src/styles/settings-desktop-shell.ts`, interpolated into `settings.ts` where its sibling rule is. It is a separate module because adding the rule to `settings.ts` would push that file past 800 lines.

Both groups are dead style, so computed values do not change:
- nothing sets `data-desktop-shell="true"` at runtime;
- both settings bodies render `"false"`;
- no page draws `.desktop-work-tabs`.

Slice 5 deletes them together with `renderInitialGoalTab` and these tests, giving the reason for each. The lesson for slices that delete styles: besides `affected-tests`, grep the tests for every deleted selector.

**Page assets:**

| Asset | Change |
| --- | --- |
| arrival.css | −43,623 B |
| settings.css | −43,339 B |
| workbench.css | −42,551 B |

`page-assets.json` is lowered to match.

## How the live rules were found, and what the first pass missed

1. **Declaration-removal probe.** I removed each declaration in turn and kept those whose removal changed a value. This finds most live rules. It misses a value that two rules both set.
2. **Whole-layer state probe.** This caught 73 differences on the trash and archive pages at 1440. They are the trash group in the table above, plus the `.document-pane` padding and background.
3. **Desktop mode.** The probe had not run in desktop mode. The server only renders the desktop shell with `x-molis-work-desktop: 1` or `?desktop=1`.
   - The failures in `visual-foundation.test.ts` exposed this.
   - The probe now has a desktop pass: header on, 1440 and 1024, plus the 18 `/settings/*` paths.
   - It found the native window's safe-area rule.
4. **State the probe never reached.**
   - The probe had no Feed data and no read-only pane.
   - With one seeded source, one item with a material, and a read-only state added, it found the whole Feed group and the read-only TUI rules.

## Equivalence evidence

Before is #624's head, after is this slice on top of it. Both trees are measured with the same probe.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| State probe, browser mode | 907,601 values, 0 differences |
| State probe, desktop mode | 1,218,728 values, 0 differences |
| `pnpm visual:compare` | 66 pictures and 22 computed-style snapshots, 0 changed |

**Slices 1–3 in desktop mode.** I compared the tree before slice 1 (`ea396a276`, all old skins present) with this branch. The comparison used the union of the four deleted layers' 739 rules, in desktop mode, over 2,032,834 values. Two kinds of difference remain, and neither changes rendering:
- **The inert `small`** under the account name, as recorded in slice 3. It is `display: block` on both sides, so `align-items` and `gap` do not apply.
- **Feed detail directory tree, path shift.** The newer markup has one wrapper fewer, so the tree's path differs. After aligning the paths, all 1,652 values are identical.

So slices 1–3 left nothing behind in desktop mode, and #611, #619 and #624 need no fix.

## `tests/visual-foundation.test.ts`

37 assertion lines are removed or rewritten. They asserted v3's own text, so they go with the layer. None of them checks behaviour that still exists.

**Removed: selectors that no rendered page draws.** Some still have a production function with no caller, which slice 5 deletes: `renderInitialGoalTab` and `WORK_TAB_VISIBILITY_CLIENT_SCRIPT` for the work tabs.
- `.desktop-work-tab*`
- `.workspace…`: the workspace is `.immersive-workspace`.
- module items
- `.desktop-goal-directory .tree-search`
- `.desktop-utility-surface`, `.desktop-workbench-bar`, `.goal-brief-item`
- `.personal-sidebar-footer`: only drawn by `renderPluginRailAccountFooter`, which nothing calls.

**Removed: values a later layer overrides.**
- Titlebar heights 48px/34px: `immersive-navigation` and `linear-density` set them to 32px/26px.
- v3's `[hidden]` rules: `base.ts` has a global `[hidden] { display: none !important }`.
- Navigator popover, primary and selector rules.

**Removed: the `body.settings-page[data-desktop-shell="true"]` group.** The standalone settings page renders `data-desktop-shell="false"`, so those rules never applied.

**Rewritten, 4 assertions, each pointing at the current owner:**
- the settings page's `data-desktop-shell="false"` markup, with a comment explaining why the Diagnostics spacing went;
- the native window's project-button padding;
- the drag region;
- the trash workspace's min-height.

The read-only TUI assertion is kept, and it now passes from `navigation-ownership.ts`.

## Verification

- Affected tests: 66 files, 18 of them browser files, all pass. The first full suite then failed `web.test.ts` and `chrome-inner-scroll.test.ts`, which the selection missed. After the fix, those two pass, along with every other file that mentions `data-desktop-shell` or `desktop-work-tab` (`desktop-tui`, `visual-foundation`). They include `visual-foundation`, `touch-targets`, the Goals browser files (`goals-document`, `goals-tree`, `goals-navigation`, `goals-narrow-navigation`) and `plugin-composition`.
- Gates against `origin/main` pass:
  - health: 140 giant units, lower than the merge-base;
  - page assets;
  - boundary.
- Secrets are clean.
- The full suite is for the coordinator.

## 防腐复查

- **Numbers.** No number is raised: the stylesheets and the giant-unit count both fall.
- **Assertions.** Assertions do change. Each one listed above asserted the deleted file's text or a value no page computes; none is loosened to pass. The behaviour they stood for is either dead (no markup) or now asserted at its owner.
- **Compatibility.** There is no compatibility logic.
- **Owners.** The moved rules go to their elements' owners. Nothing goes to a fallback file.
- **Record.** `specs/repository-anti-corruption/spec.md`: the W5-05 slice 4 entry under W4-12 and the skin row (only `calm-desktop` remains). The v3 row in `docs/system/HUGE-CLASS-MIGRATION.md` is marked deleted.

merged_since_previous.title: feat(assistant): each Work has its own task graph and a sub-task is a step on it (P4 assistant half A1, §6.0k)
merged_since_previous.body:
P4, assistant half, slice A1. Each Assistant Work now gets its own standing task graph before its first round, and a delegated sub-task is a step on it. A round stands on the step its session holds. When a sub-task's round ends, its step ends the same way. Follow-ups are steps. `status`, take-back and the parallel limit all read the graph. Spec §6.0k; decisions in §7.7 (统筹 10-17, five points: 1 and 4 decided by the user in a popup, 2, 3 and 5 by the coordinator as recommended).

Hand-back and auto-continue (A2) and background jobs (A3) are not touched here. `handed_back_run`, `hand_back_held` and the result-key start are still there. The W5-10 shape holds: `AssistantDelegations` reaches the Host only through its ports, and `AssistantService` / `AssistantStore` only get smaller.

## What changes

**Contract** (`packages/contracts/src/services/agent-collaboration.ts`)
- `AgentCollaborationPort.works?: AgentWorkGraphPort` has five methods:
  - `open`: the same key gives the same standing graph, and the work's session holds its root;
  - `add`: a step under the root or under another step, held by a session; adding it again changes nothing;
  - `read` and `watch`;
  - `end`: ends a step that isn't done. With `actor_id`, it is recorded as that person's decision; without one, as its holder giving it up.
- `AgentWorkNode` gives the step id, its parent, title, SDK state, the session that holds it, and `ended_by_person` (when, and the note).
- The port sits on the existing collaboration port, not on `PrologueAgentAdapter`, which is a giant unit and must not grow.
- It sits next to §6.0j's `revise`. Both were kept when resolving the rebase.
- The assistant's public view is unchanged: `AssistantWork.delegated_by` is still `{ work_id, title, acceptance, taken_back_at? }`, and `work_id` is now read from the graph.

**Host** (`horizontal/agent-host`; new file `adapters/prologue-work-graphs.ts`, 98 lines)
- The graph:
  - admitted with the idempotency key `molis-work:assistant-work:<work_id>`;
  - standing, keeping the last 64 finished steps.
- Steps:
  - the root is `work`;
  - a sub-task is `p-<id>` under the root;
  - a follow-up is `<part>.f<n>`;
  - a round the person starts inside a child Work is `<part>.r<n>`.
- Which graph a session works on is stored in the session index (`work_graph`).
- Binding: a session on a work graph binds its round to the unfinished step it holds there (the first line of `roundBinding`). If that step was held for the person, `readyStep` makes it ready first.
- When a round ends, the sub-task's step ends the same way: completed → succeeded, failed and cancelled as they are.
  - It reports the generation that `attemptOf` found.
  - If the person ended the step meanwhile, or it changed generation, the round reports nothing.
  - The root stays open.
- `prologue-run.ts` gains those two lines and one type. `prologue-node.ts` and `prologue-node-port.ts` wire the port in.

**Assistant** (`apps/local-host/src/assistant/`)
- The parent Work stores `graph_id`, opened before its first round: `place()` runs in `dispatch`, before `host.start`.
- A child's `delegated_by` holds the graph, its step, the parent's title, the acceptance criteria, and `taken_back_at`.
  - The parent is found from the graph.
  - `follow_ups` is removed; it is counted from the graph.
- Each now reads the graph:
  - `delegatedBy(actor, parent)` finds children by graph;
  - the board's sub-task list (`parts`) reads the graph;
  - `status` waits for graph changes (up to 50 s) and returns when no requested part has an unfinished step; `watchWorks` / `waitForWorkChange` are no longer used for delegation;
  - hand-back fires when the part's step ends, not on the run's terminal state. The Host reports the step slightly after the run ends, so going by the run would count the part as unfinished and stall;
  - "don't go on while a sub-task is unfinished" (`owed`);
  - the limit of 3 in progress counts parts that still have an unfinished step.
- `closeInterrupted`: when the person closes a child's interrupted round after checking it, the person ends that part's open steps, so the parent can go on.

**Decisions** (§6.0k, rows in §7.7)
1. **Take-back does not hand the step to the parent's session.** The person ends the part's open steps (cancelled, recorded as theirs, generation +1, so the child's round can no longer report). "The parent finishes this part itself" is recorded on the child Work (`taken_back_at`). Reasons:
   - a step handed to the parent has no round standing on it, so it would never end;
   - a finished part has no step to hand over, yet the board lets you take back a finished part.
2. **A follow-up is refused while the part still has an unfinished step** (`assistant.state`). Before, the text went into the running round. One follow-up is one step (decision 3), and a message pushed into a running round has no step to count against the limit.
3. A round the person starts inside a child Work stands on a new step under the part. It doesn't count as a follow-up.
4. Every assistant Work has a graph, including reply Works. Coding-run Works don't: their rounds are in the Coding session.
5. **Existing data**: only the current shape is read. An old Work without `graph_id` opens its graph before its next round. Old-shape children (`delegated_by.work_id`) are not read; A4 converts them with a one-off script (user 10-17, point 4). The real Home is not touched without the user's approval.

## Public contract and API impact

Per `docs/system/CONTRACT-CHANGES.md` stage one:
- `contracts/services/agent-collaboration`:
  - `+ AgentCollaborationPort.works?`
  - `+ interface AgentWorkGraphPort`
  - `+ interface AgentWorkNode`
- Additive and optional. The only consumer is `assistant-delegation.ts`, changed in this PR. A runtime without the port makes delegation fail with `assistant.unsupported`.
- External plugins can't reach it: it is the Host runtime's port, not an action.
- No action snapshot, Manifest, MCP tool name, prompt, tool description or page asset changes.
- `AssistantWork` (the public assistant view) is unchanged.

## Hub files

- `apps/local-host/src/assistant/assistant-service.ts` (giant file): smaller only. `AssistantService` goes 1643 → 1640 lines, methods stay 98, and the file goes 2058 → 2054.
- `tooling/gates/baseline.json`: lowered with `--update --base origin/main`.

## Tests

`tests/assistant-delegation.test.ts` uses the fixture model and the real Prologue node adapter:

| ID | Proves |
| --- | --- |
| WG-01 | After delegating, the parent's graph has two steps: the root `work`, held by the parent session and `running`; and the part under it, held by the child session, which becomes `succeeded` with its round. The child Work has no graph of its own |
| WG-02 | Two follow-ups are each a step under the part (`.f1`, `.f2`), and a finished step is not reopened. The third is refused by the limit. The board's follow-up count comes from the graph |
| WG-03 | After take-back, the part's step is `cancelled`, recorded as ended by the person with the take-back note. The parent session holds only the root |
| WG-04 | Seven delegations that fail to start leave no unfinished step on the graph |

The existing assertions stay: boundaries, limits, stop, still counted after archive, hand-back, and the W2-18 races. Mutation check: removing the `ended()` call turns 7 of the file's 11 tests red.

## Verification (rebased on main `5239a371`)

- [x] `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline`, `pnpm build`; `pnpm api:update` (the snapshot above; resolving the rebase left it correct).
- [x] Health gates against merge-base: `node scripts/check-health-gates.mjs --base origin/main` passes. `baseline.json` lowered with `--update --base origin/main`.
- [x] `pnpm boundary:check`; `pnpm test:security` 58/58; `pnpm test:contracts` 44/44; `pnpm secrets:check` (after `git fetch origin main`).
- [x] 40 files, 39 passed at once: every non-browser assistant file, plus the §6.0j revise files (`agent-collaboration-revise`, `prologue-step-amend`, `prologue-project-board`, `coding-step-claims`, `coding-plan-amend-http`, `coding-runtime-regressions`) and `prologue-taskboard`.
  - The 40th, `system-search-lifecycle`, failed three times, each time in a batch while the machine was loaded (load 16–21): the search answered before the just-created goal was indexed.
  - Run alone, at the same time on this branch and on a clean baseline worktree (main `446c0521`), it passed 3/3 on each. Timing under load, not this change.
- [x] Before the rebase, `affected-tests` picked 193 files; 13 were red under load. On a rerun 10 passed.
  - The other 3 were `installed-plugin-host` (30 s limit), `prologue-documents` (120 s limit) and `system-search-lifecycle` (above).
  - All 3 pass on the baseline.
- [ ] Browser tests `assistant-handback.e2e` and `assistant-follow-live.e2e`: left to the full suite, which the coordinator runs. It isn't run here.
- Not verified:
  - a real model: the slice changes no prompt or tool description;
  - reconciling a part's step after a Host restart mid-round: the SDK's reopen reconciliation applies, but Molis has no unit test for it.

## Numbers that only go down

Against merge-base `5239a371` nothing goes up. Going down: `AssistantService` 1643 → 1640 lines; `assistant-service.ts` 2058 → 2054. `AssistantStore` (267 lines, 39 methods) and `PrologueAgentAdapter` are unchanged. `AssistantDelegations` is 293 lines, under the 300 limit.

## 防腐复查

Checklist `coordination/2026-10-13/ANTI-CORRUPTION-REVIEW.md`, against this PR's diff to main.

| Item | Result |
| --- | --- |
| M1 boundary, M2 health `--base` | pass; nothing goes up |
| M4 `api:update` | one snapshot file, impact above. M5 actions: unchanged |
| M6 page assets | not touched (no workbench or client file in the diff) |
| M10 test-imports | `assistant-delegation.test.ts` imports what it imported before; no new internal import |
| M14 `test:security`, M15 secrets | pass, none |
| 1 No compatibility | no read fallback for the old `delegated_by.work_id` or `follow_ups`. Old children are left to A4's one-off script, recorded in §6.0k |
| 2 Registered once, 3 call chain | no new capability or action. Delegation tools are the assistant's own, unchanged |
| 4 Identity | the person who ends a step is `ports.actorId` from the call context, never from input |
| 5, 6 Layers and models | `@prologue/sdk` is still only in agent-host. The assistant reaches the graph through the contract port |
| 8 Placement | the graph is the source of truth for states, holders and generations; the Work keeps only `graph_id`, and a part only its step |
| 9 Giant units | the new file is 98 lines and `AssistantDelegations` is 293. Existing giant units only shrink |
| 11 Contract purity | types only. The real consumer and the test are in this PR |
| 14 Errors | existing codes (`agent.collaboration_*`, `assistant.state`, `assistant.unsupported`); no new `Error` subclass |
| 22 Tests | no assertion removed or loosened. The orphan test now sends the parent first, so it has a graph, and asserts no unfinished non-root step is left |
| 25 Hub files | only my own lines. In the rebase, §6.0j's `revise` and this PR's `works` both stay in the port and the contract |

merged_since_previous.title: test(companion): the fake Host ends Coding's wake loop like a Host without a task graph (W2-18-DIFF-FILE-01)
merged_since_previous.body:
Fixes the local-only failure of `tests/companion-client-lifecycle.e2e.test.ts` W2-18-DIFF-FILE-01 (`5 !== 4`) that 统筹 asked about. It is not #618 or #627.

## Cause
- The test counts every Host capability call and expects none after the Coding output is captured (`readable = false`).
- Coding's wake loop (`plugins/native/coding/src/wake-loop.ts:111`, since #534) also calls `agent.collaboration.await.v1`. The fake Host threw "Unexpected capability" for it, so the loop backed off 5 s and called again.
- On a run slower than 5 s (local machines under load; 8 s here), that retry landed after the capture: a logged run showed calls 1–4 before it, and call 5 = `agent.collaboration.await.v1` from `wake-loop.ts:111` after it. CI runs the test in about 1 s, so it never saw the retry.

## Fix
- The fake now answers that call the way a Host whose runtime has no task graph does (`agent.capability_unavailable`, the same code `horizontal/agent-host/src/session-actions.ts` throws), and the wake loop ends there.
- The assertion is unchanged. The first call is still counted before the capture, and no call comes after it.
- No product change.

## Tests
`node scripts/run-tests.mjs tests/companion-client-lifecycle.e2e.test.ts`: 8/8, W2-18 in 1.2 s. The same file was 7/8 locally on main before the fix.

## 防腐复查
- **Changes:** one test fixture line. No assertion skipped, relaxed or deleted.
- **Untouched:** product code, gates, budgets, contracts.
- **Checks:** `secrets:check` passes.

merged_since_previous.title: fix(scripts): a slot waiter's place survives a reader that sees its ticket half-written
merged_since_previous.body:
A run that waited for a machine slot could wait forever with the slot free. The log then repeats:

```
machine-slot: waiting for the browser slot, held by nobody, -1 ahead in the queue; -1 other(s) queued
```

`-1 ahead` means the waiter's own ticket is no longer in the queue. A W5-05 `run-tests` batch hung this way while other sessions' browser runs took the slot one after another.

## Cause

- `acquireSlot` wrote its queue ticket with plain `writeFileSync`, which first creates an empty file and then fills it.
- Every waiter calls `slotState` once a second. A waiter that read the ticket in that window got an empty file. `readJson` returned `null`, so `slotState` treated the ticket as a dead process's and removed it.
- The owner then never reached the head of the queue (`waiting[0]?.pid === process.pid`), so it never took the slot.

## Fix (`scripts/machine-slot.mjs`)

1. **Whole tickets only.** A ticket is written into a sibling directory, `<kind>.queue.writing/`, then renamed into `<kind>.queue/`. A reader of the queue never sees a half-written ticket.
2. **Liveness from the name.** Whether a ticket is live comes from the pid in its file name (`<arrival>-<pid>.json`), not from its contents. A live waiter's ticket that cannot be read yet is skipped for that round, never removed.
3. **A lost place is retaken.** A waiter that finds its ticket missing (removed from outside) writes it again with its first arrival time, so it keeps its place in the queue rather than going to the back.
4. A dead writer's leftover file in `<kind>.queue.writing/` is removed, the same way as a dead waiter's ticket.

## Tests (`tests/machine-slot.test.ts`)

Two new tests, both of which fail against the old script:

| Test | Against the old script |
| --- | --- |
| `queue: a live waiter's ticket that another reader cannot parse yet is kept; a dead one's is removed` | Fails its first assertion: the empty ticket of a live process is removed. |
| `run: a waiter whose ticket is removed from outside takes its place again and still gets the slot` | Hangs: the second run never gets the slot. Under `--test-timeout=20000` it fails after 20 s. |

To reproduce on this branch:

```bash
git show origin/main:scripts/machine-slot.mjs > scripts/machine-slot.mjs
node --test --test-timeout=20000 tests/machine-slot.test.ts
git checkout scripts/machine-slot.mjs
```

With the fix, all 6 tests pass.

## Old and new scripts running at the same time

Every checkout runs its own copy of `scripts/machine-slot.mjs`, so for a while both versions share `<tmpdir>/molis-work-slots`.

- **The ticket format has not changed.** Main's script already names tickets `<since padded to 15>-<pid>.json` and writes the same JSON. There is no old format to read and no compatibility code.
- **A new reader and an old waiter's ticket.** The pid comes from the name, which old tickets also have. A live old waiter's ticket is never removed by the new script, even while it is half-written.
- **An old reader and a new waiter's ticket.** A new ticket arrives in the queue whole, through the rename, so an old reader always parses it. The unfinished copy lives in `<kind>.queue.writing/`, which the old script never reads, so an old reader cannot remove it mid-write.
- **What stays until every checkout has the fix.** Between two old processes, an old reader can still remove an old waiter's half-written ticket, and that old waiter can still starve. If a run on an old checkout hangs with `-1 ahead`, stop it by its pid and start it again, or update that checkout. Nothing on the new side needs to wait for the queue to drain.

## Verification

- `node --test tests/machine-slot.test.ts`: 6/6.
- Health gates against `origin/main` pass.
- `pnpm boundary:check` needs built packages, and this worktree has no build. The change has no package imports, so CI's run covers it.
- Secrets are clean.
- `run-tests` and `build-workspace` go through this file, so the full suite is for the coordinator.

## 防腐复查

- **Numbers.** No gate number rises.
- **Assertions.** Only new tests are added. No assertion is loosened or removed.
- **Compatibility.** There is none: the ticket format is unchanged. The table above covers both versions running at once.
- **Owners.** Only `scripts/machine-slot.mjs` changes; its callers (`run-tests.mjs`, `build-workspace.mjs`) do not.

## 做了什么

Molis Work 原先的 MIT 声明允许合作方直接再分发、销售或转授权，与合作源码模式不符。本 PR 改为 Molis AI Cooperation Source License：合法取得的软件可用于个人或内部工作，合作方可在授权范围内阅读和参与开发；对外销售软件及衍生版、提供收费服务、转授权或在合作范围外披露源码，须取得实际权利方事先明确的书面授权。

Molis AI 目前是项目/组织名称，主体公司尚未设立。文本由实际权利人及其合法代表授权，未来公司取得权利后才能授权；保留第三方许可、独立工作成果、贡献者权属及已合法授予的旧版许可。

- 先建立 `specs/commercial-source-license/spec.md`，再统一根 LICENSE、73 份包声明、中英文 README、Cargo 许可指向与未发布变更说明。
- 72 个包携带与根正文一致的普通 LICENSE 文件，独立 tarball 和运行时安装物都自包含。159 个文件的大部分是这项机械分发材料更新，需与元数据同时切换。
- 安装器生成运行时 package.json 时保留源包 license；无声明时不制造许可。现有路径/符号链接拒绝合同保持原样。
- 复查没有发现项目代码遗留 MIT 声明；README 去掉安装包不携带的 spec 相对链接。第三方、历史记录、依赖夹具和 MIT 新闻源中的 MIT 保留。

## 验证

merged_since_previous.title: feat(receipts): B — receipts carry their supplement's key, so Coding drops a lost bubble once the record shows it (RC-17, D30); the Agent Review client written once in Coding's bundle
merged_since_previous.body:
specs/ai-input-receipts finding B from the walk-through (D30, RC-17), after 3c (#622, merged as `bf33f5ef`). Merge-base: main `0a931c97` (after #618 and #627). The coordinator decided the approach on 2026-10-16.

## What changes

**The run view's receipt carries its supplement's key** (`AgentTurnSteer.key`). The key is taken from the runtime's input record by agent-host's `steerView`, and is present only when the record has one.

**Coding drops a lost bubble once the record shows it arrived.**
- Before this, when the answer to a supplement was lost, the page could show the same words twice with opposite claims: the round's record said 「已送达」 while the local bubble said 「没确认送到」.
- Now, when the round's record has a supplement under the lost bubble's key, the bubble goes. The status line says once 「之前已送到，没有重复发送。」, the same words as for a resend the runtime recognises.
- The composer is cleared only if it still holds those exact words (and the draft with them). If the person edited it, nothing is touched.
- After that, sending the same words again is a new supplement.

**Spec.** RC-17 is added.

## Contract change (`api:update`)

`contracts/services/agent-inputs`: `AgentTurnSteer` gains `key?: string`.
- **Callers that read the run view** (Coding's page, the Assistant, the shared receipt): the field is optional and additive. Only Coding's sending bubble reads it.
- **Plugins:** none read `AgentTurnSteer`.
- **Actions and MCP tools:** unchanged.

## Bytes: offset in this slice, no allowance (D33)

On its own, B adds 298 bytes to `coding.js`. The offset is in the same PR:
- Coding's bundle inlined `AGENT_REVIEW_CLIENT_FACTORY_SCRIPT` three times: Git's review list, Coding itself, and the companions.
- `coding-setup.ts` now binds it once and calls that one factory in all three places. Each call still makes its own instance, as before.

| Asset | main → B |
| --- | --- |
| `plugins/coding.js` | 432592 → 411234 (**−21358**) |

No other asset moves. No allowance is needed, and the gate is not changed: `APPROVED_CEILINGS` (3c's spent entries) is left for the next change to the gate to delete, as its comment says.

## Checks

- `pnpm build` passed.
- page-assets and health gates pass against main (`--base origin/main`). No giant unit grew: Coding's `client.ts` stays at 1637 lines, because the `landed` port is one line.
- API snapshot: only the change above.
- Affected tests: 88/88 pass (81 unit, plus the browser files for the review client and the receipts: `companion-client-lifecycle`, `coding-workbench`, `coding-client-lifecycle`, `workbench-deferred-clients`, `coding-input-receipts`).
- **New or changed tests:**
  - RC-17 in `tests/coding-input-receipts-client.test.ts`: the bubble goes only once the record has the same key; it is said once; the composer is cleared only while it holds the same words.
  - RCPT-304 in `tests/prologue-input-claims.test.ts` now also asserts `steer.key === receipt.key`.
  - **Expected change, RC-09** (`tests/prologue-recovery.test.ts`, real SDK): a supplement carried into the next round now shows its key, `steer: { id, key: "send.c1", state: "read" }`. The comparison stays whole, and a separate assertion checks that the key is the one it was sent under. RC-17's lost-bubble match reads this key. The first full run caught this; affected-tests had not listed the file.

## 防腐复查

**Pass.**

Machine checks:
- M1 health: pass.
- M2 page assets: pass, and smaller.
- M4 secrets: pass.
- M5 affected tests: pass.
- M13: the API snapshot is regenerated; actions are unchanged.
- M6 (gate change) does not apply: no gate change.

Items:
1. **No compatibility.** The key is optional because the runtime's record does not always carry one. It is not a fallback.
2. **Registered once.** No new capability or action.
3. **Call chains.** The run view is built only through `applyRunEvent` and the SDK projection.
4. **Identity.** The key comes from the runtime's input record. The page only compares against it.
5–6. **Layers and model calls.** Only agent-host imports the SDK. No model call is added.
7–8. **Kernel and placement.** The receipt fact stays the runtime's; there is no table and no second copy.
9. **Giant units.** None grew.
11. **Contracts.** Types only.
12–13. **Contract change and snapshots.** Impact stated above.
14. **Error model.** No new codes.
15. **Data.** No tables.
16. **Names.** Follow the spec.
17. **Security.** Untouched.
18. **Pages.** None.
19. **Assets.** Smaller.
20. **Wording.** Reuses an existing sentence.
21. **Requests.** None added.
22. **Tests.** Ids are in the test names; nothing was relaxed.
23. **Acceptance ids.** RC-17 and RCPT-304.
24. **Prologue SDK.** Unchanged.
25. **Hub files.** `coding-setup.ts` only.
26. **Branch hygiene.** Own paths only; main and 3c are merged in, not rebased.
27. **Gates.** Untouched.

merged_since_previous.title: feat(agent-host): a person's plan change is the action agent.collaboration.revise.v1, the typed step-board amend is gone; the SDK is packed from Prologue main c673238e with #33 (P4-C2, §6.0j)
merged_since_previous.body:
P4-C2: a person's change to a running plan now goes through the collaboration contract's action `agent.collaboration.revise.v1`. The typed capability `agent.run.step-board.amend.v1` is removed in the same change, with no compatibility path. The same PR swaps the vendored Prologue SDK to the package built from upstream main `c673238e`, which **includes [Prologue #33](https://github.com/molis-ai/prologue/pull/33)** (the coordinator merged it after the user approved in a popup). Spec §6.0j; decisions are in §7.7 (统筹 10-17 for the scope; 用户 10-17 for folding the swap in). ## What changes **Contract** (`packages/contracts/src/services/agent-collaboration.ts`) - New action `agent.collaboration.revise.v1`, version 1: - declared as `operation` / `command`, `effect: write`, `scheduling: concurrent`; - plugins only. - Input: `runtime_id`, `session_id`, `run_id`, `amendment`, `expected_version` (an integer ≥ 1). - `amendment` is a `oneOf` of the six existing kinds: skip, insert (optional `mine: true`), unblock, move, assign, resolve. - Each kind accepts only its own fields. - Step refs are `step-N` / `user-N`. Text fields must be non-blank and bounded, matching what the Coding page checks. - Output: `{ board }`. - Identity comes from the call context, never from the input: the actor is the calling plugin's actor, or the session owner when that isn't available, as before. - `AgentCollaborationPort` gains `revise(run, amendment, expectedVersion, actorId)`. - `AgentRuntimeAdapter.amendStepBoard?` and `agentHostCapabilities.amendStepBoard` are deleted. **Host** (`horizontal/agent-host`) - `session-actions.ts` registers the action, in this order: 1. checks that the run belongs to the session and the session to the caller's project and plugin; 2. calls `fresh(call)` before committing, so a cancelled or revoked call changes nothing; 3. returns `capability_unavailable` when the runtime has no collaboration port. - The adapter's `collaboration.revise` keeps the old checks: once a round has ended, it can only be changed while it is still the session's newest plan round and the board is not terminal. - In the Node composition, the plan-step part (`stepBoards.amend`) provides `revise`; the waits part doesn't handle it. - The typed registration in `capability-registration.ts` is gone. **Coding**: the `coding.plan-amendments` route now invokes the action through the action directory. The page's checks and the "tell the round that's running" behaviour are unchanged. **Left out on purpose** (spec §6.0j; the coordinator agreed to this scope): `control`'s `retry` and `resolve-reconciliation`, and cancel/retry-node in `revise`. No page flow calls them yet, so they would be contracts nobody uses. When a page needs one, it goes into these two actions with a `version` bump. **Package swap** (`vendor/prologue-sdk/README.md` steps) - New package `prologue-sdk-0.0.0-rc.1-reference-kinds.tgz`: 1,190,630 bytes, SHA-256 `585909b1e7fc243828927ff229069445a9056ce2ffb65c17d13c57f6b9372c0c`. - Built from a clean `git archive` of `c673238e`, the squash merge of #33. Its tree equals the reviewed head `a579bfea`. No patch, `dirty: false`. - **Packed twice the same way: byte-for-byte identical** (`reproducedByteIdentical: true`). - What #33 adds: an App may list the kinds a reference question can ask for, in `config.tool.askUserReferenceKinds`. - With the list set, `refKinds` is an enum of those names, and a kind outside the list fails before the question opens. - Without the list, ask-user is unchanged. Molis sets no list in this PR, so **behaviour doesn't change**. The interaction line's T2 adds the list. - Upstream verification on that tree: the SDK full suite passed, 355 files, 3949 passed, 21 skipped, 0 failed (`desktop-computer-use.live` not run because it drives the real desktop). The 13 consumer scripts pass on the new package. - The old parameter-branches package is removed together with its `.sha256` and `.provenance.json`. - **`patch-history.json` entry 21** in `packagesWithoutPatch`: the parameter-branches package (1,189,325 bytes, SHA-256 `c6f42129…`, git blob `36438baa`, source `4e8468dd`). - `upstream.mainHead` becomes `c673238e`, and `commitsChecked` grows to 31. - Each recorded commit was rechecked with `git merge-base --is-ancestor`. All are main ancestors except the three interim sources already on record (`08b84296`, `923e5a40`, `4007a93c`). - Also updated to the new package: `package.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml` (name and integrity only), `scripts/workspace-packages.mjs`, `tests/vendor-provenance.test.ts` (current package, PR number, counts), and the S-13 line in `SECURITY-INVARIANTS`. ## Public contract and API impact Following `docs/system/CONTRACT-CHANGES.md` stage one (no compatibility window yet): - **The old typed capability is deleted outright.** There's no alias, no compatibility exit and no read fallback. - **All callers change in this PR** (item 2). The only caller in the repo is Coding's plan-amendment route. No workflow step or binding, MCP tool name, Skill or handbook ever named `agent.run.step-board.amend.v1`. Coding's Manifest lists `agentCollaborationActions` as a whole, so it picks up the new action automatically. Tests that called the adapter directly now go through `adapter.collaboration.revise`. - **Version** (item 3): a new action id, so it starts at version 1. No pinned `capability_id@version` reference points at it, and nothing pinned the old typed capability: typed capabilities aren't in the action directory. - External plugin authors: `contracts/services/agent-host` loses `amendStepBoard` and `contracts/services/agent-collaboration` gains `revise`. Only plugins can call it. - Snapshots: - `tooling/gates/api/contracts/services/agent-collaboration.txt`: `+ AgentCollaborationReviseInput`, `+ agentCollaborationActions.revise`, `+ AgentCollaborationPort.revise`; - `tooling/gates/api/contracts/services/agent-host.txt`: `- AgentRuntimeAdapter.amendStepBoard?`, `- agentHostCapabilities.amendStepBoard`; - `tooling/gates/actions/host-actions.tsv`: `+ agent.collaboration.revise.v1@1 via platform` (command, operation, project, write, concurrent, plugin). - The swap changes no Molis contract or API snapshot. ## Tests | File | New or changed | What it proves | | --- | --- | --- | | `tests/agent-collaboration-revise.test.ts` | new (imports package names only) |
  • The schema refuses malformed changes before any handler runs: a bad step ref, a blank reason, an unknown kind, a wrong direction, `mine: false`, an extra field, version 0 or a fraction, an `actor_id` in the input, a missing version. All six kinds pass.
  • The typed amend is gone.
  • `revise` passes the person's change, the version they saw and the calling plugin's actor to the round.
  • Cancelled, revoked, or another session's round: nothing changes.
| | `tests/coding-plan-amend-http.test.ts` | changed | The route calls `revise` through the action directory. The fixture provider registers the action. | | `prologue-step-amend`, `prologue-project-board`, `coding-step-claims`, `coding-runtime-regressions` | changed | Same assertions; they go through `adapter.collaboration.revise` and name the `"user"` actor that used to be left out. | | `tests/vendor-provenance.test.ts` | changed | The current package, #33, 21 packages without a patch, 31 commits checked. | ## Verification - [x] `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline` and `pnpm build` after rebasing onto main `04ab0216` (#627). Main has since gained #618 (`0a931c978`); it merges cleanly (#618 adds BL-150, this PR adds BL-151). - [x] Health gates against merge-base: `node scripts/check-health-gates.mjs --base origin/main` passes (numbers below). `baseline.json` was lowered with `--update --base origin/main`. - [x] `pnpm api:update`, `pnpm actions:update`: the snapshot changes listed above. - [x] Page assets: `node scripts/gates/page-assets.mjs --base origin/main` passes. Every asset equals its frozen number, so C2 leaves the page-asset queue alone. - [x] Related tests: the non-browser files `node scripts/affected-tests.mjs --base origin/main` chose, plus vendor-provenance, S-13 `prologue-memory-boundary`, PA-12 `prologue-tool-declaration`, `agent-typed-questions`, `question-rules-consistency`, `action-contract-snapshot` and `coding-coordinator-board` → **146/146 files pass**. - It recommends the full suite (shared core: contracts; 3 packages). The coordinator runs it; I didn't. - [x] `pnpm test:security` 58/58. That includes S-13 on the new package, which `SECURITY-INVARIANTS` requires after every swap. - [x] `pnpm test:contracts`: 43 of 44 files passed first time. - In `action-gateway`, the test 'production stdio keeps context tools usable without a running system service' hit its 20 s limit while the machine was loaded (other sessions' runs were going; `install.test` took 224 s). - Rerun on its own, the file passes 13/13, and that test takes 1.8 s. Its path (MCP stdio, the context tools) is outside this change. - [x] `pnpm boundary:check`, `node scripts/verify-release-versions.mjs`, and `pnpm secrets:check` (after `git fetch origin main`). - [ ] Browser tests: left to the full suite (the coordinator decided, 10-17). ## Numbers that only go down Compared with merge-base `04ab0216`, nothing goes up. These go down: - typed capability sites 190 → 187 (`agent-host.ts` type-refs and without-action 39 → 38, `capability-registration.ts` register-calls 39 → 38); - `registerAgentHostCapabilities` 372 → 363 lines; - `adapters/prologue.ts` 968 → 967 lines (`PrologueAgentAdapter` stays at 603 lines and 18 methods); - explicit `any` 515 → 514. Vendored SDK copies stay at 1. `baseline.json` was lowered with `--update --base origin/main`. ## 防腐复查 Checklist `coordination/2026-10-13/ANTI-CORRUPTION-REVIEW.md`, against this PR's diff to main. | Item | Result | | --- | --- | | M1 boundary | passes | | M2 health `--base` | passes; giant units, typed capability sites and explicit `any` go down, nothing goes up | | M3 vendored provenance | the `vendored-provenance` gate and `tests/vendor-provenance.test.ts` pass. The tgz matches its `.sha256` and `.provenance.json`, and the old package is gone from the folder | | M4 `api:update`, M5 `actions:update` | two API snapshots and one action row, impact above | | M6 page assets | unchanged | | M10 test-imports | the new test imports package names only | | M14 `test:security` | passes | | M15 secrets | none | | 1 No compatibility | the old typed capability, its registration and the adapter method are all deleted. Nothing maps old to new. The old package is removed whole, with only the `patch-history` record left | | 2 Registered once | the action is declared once in contracts, registered once in `session-actions.ts`, and found through the shared directory. Coding names no second list | | 3 Identity from context | `actor_id` in the input is refused by the schema. The actor comes from the calling plugin, then the session owner | | 4 Concurrent, `beforeEffect` | `scheduling: concurrent`; `fresh(call)` before the write. The cancelled and revoked cases are asserted | | 5, 6 Layers and models | `@prologue/sdk` is still only in agent-host. W5-05 slice 2. The roadmap deletes the five old skin layers one at a time, each proven equivalent. This slice removes `packages/design-system/src/styles/personal-shell.ts`: 78 rules, 312 declarations.

Rebased onto main `958946e22` after #611 (slice 1) merged; re-measured on that tree.

## What changes

None of the layer's declarations still decides a computed value, so the whole layer goes and nothing moves to an owner.

- **What the probe reached.** Only `.app`, `.workspace` and `.tree-pane` under `body[data-desktop-shell="true"]`. Only the Goals page writes that flag as `"true"`; the settings pages write `"false"`. Later layers override the grid, border and row values these rules set.
- **The other 70 rules** target classes that no markup draws any more: `personal-sidebar`, `personal-nav-item`, `desktop-project-*` and others. Nothing has drawn them since the workbench moved to the unified bottom bar.
