merged_since_previous.title: W3-B2: the strip shows where it would go on the left; a round is told it once its owner reads the object; the toolbar waits under a covering panel (context-program §21.8 step 7)
merged_since_previous.body:
W3-B2 (specs/context-program §21.8 step 7): the context strip shows where something would be put on the left, and a Send carries it to the round. Also fixes the selection toolbar floating over the Assistant's panel (the 390px leftover from W3-A2). Decisions L-1 to L-3 and the overlap rule are in §21.5, marked 统筹 10-16 定.

## What the person sees
- **The landing chip.** Once the page's object is added (solid 「正在看」, or added with +), the strip ends with a copper-tinted chip, for example `→ 发布计划 · 「步骤」光标处`. It is named by the heading above the place and a position word (光标处 / 选中处 / 文末), not by counting paragraphs (L-3). Hover and screen readers get the whole sentence: 「放进去的位置：发布计划，「步骤」，光标处（「…第二步，」之后）」. The snippet stays inside the landing's own paragraph.
- **When it is absent.** If the object is not added, there is no chip (L-1). The landing carries text from the document, so showing it would hand content to the model without a +.
- **×.** It removes only the landing; the object still goes with the Send. The chip stays away until the landing moves to another object.
- **Toolbar under a panel.** Before the selection toolbar shows, it hit-tests the anchor's center. If that point is under the Assistant's panel or the side panel, and the selection is not inside that panel, the toolbar waits. It comes back when the panel closes. There is no width branch, so the same rule covers a phone's full-screen panel and a floating panel at 1440. The selection is still on the strip as 「选中的内容」.

## How it works
- **Contract (`contracts/services/assistant`).** `AssistantContextSnapshot` gets an optional `landing?: AssistantLanding`: plugin, object, position, heading path, text before and after, and the selected text. Snapshot refreshed with `pnpm api:update`.
  - **Impact on callers:** the field is optional. Existing senders and readers are unchanged. No action, MCP tool or Manifest changes. Nothing reads it except the Host's assistant round.
- **Host.** The page's landing is treated as a claim.
  - A new file, `apps/local-host/src/assistant/assistant-landing.ts`, bounds it (`checkLanding`).
  - Before the round, it re-reads the object from its owner with the person's authority in that project. This uses H3's owner read: `horizontal/search` now exports `readReferences`, and `confirmReferences` is derived from it, so it is the same read W3-B1 does before `attach.`. `search-actions.ts` exposes it on `SearchHost`.
  - If the object can't be read, nothing is said. If it can, the round gets one material of facts only: the object under its owner's label, the position, the selected text, and the text before and after. It contains no wording like 「请放到这里」 (A3② rule).
  - `assistant-service.ts` changes only on two existing lines, a net −1 line, so A3② can rebase over it.
- **Page.**
  - `assistant-context-strip.ts` listens to `molis:surface-landing` (one more listener; no new event).
  - The island adds the landing to `context` on Send.
  - Pages fills `surroundings.heading_path` using the `headingPath` that `focus.ts` already had.
- **Toolbar.** All changes are in `context-bar.ts`: the hit test, plus a `MutationObserver` on the two panels' `hidden` attribute that brings the toolbar back.

## Tests (`tests/assistant-context-strip.e2e.test.ts`)
- **STRIP-04:** without +, no landing. After +, the chip appears with the heading-and-position name and the full sentence for screen readers. × leaves the object chip, and the model is told the object but not the landing.
- **STRIP-05:** the round is told the landing's facts: object, 「「步骤」下，光标处」, the text before and after. After the owner deletes the document, a new round with the same chip is told nothing about it.
- **CTX-COVER-01:** at 390 the panel covers the passage, so the toolbar is not shown; after close it returns. At 1440 the toolbar follows the same hit test, and returns after close.
- **Results:**
  - This file is 6/6. `affected-tests` picked 165 unit and 45 browser files.
  - Unit: all pass. `action-gateway` hit a 20 s stdio timeout under load and passed alone.
  - Browser: 44/44 pass. `goals-tree` and `goals-planning` also failed on a baseline worktree at the merge-base. The `issue-*` failures were load timeouts that pass alone on both. Every one passes on this branch when run alone or in small batches.
  - After rebasing onto `c762a640`, these pass 8/8: the strip, toolbar and landing e2e files, `pages-surface-naming`, `pages-landing-actions`, `contextual-landing`, `security-invariants-object-references` and `goals-tree-ui`.
- `pages-surface-naming.test.ts` stubs the page APIs the toolbar program reads; it now also stubs `MutationObserver`. No assertion changed.

## Screenshots
In the coordinator's shared notes, `contextual-line/w3b2/`. `final-*` files are from this head, at 390 and 1440, light and dark:
- `final-1-strip-*`: the strip with the landing chip.
- `final-0-strip-not-added-*`: not added, so no landing.
- `final-2-selection-*`: a selection under the open panel, with no toolbar over the panel.
- `final-2b-panel-closed-*`: the toolbar back after the panel closes.

The proposal's `before-*` images show main.

## Page assets (only shrink)
Totals: `molis-work-workbench.js` −30 B, `molis-work-pages-editor.js` −27 B, the three stylesheets −9 B each. Budgets in `page-assets.json` are lowered to match (against merge-base `c762a640`).

The new code is offset by deleting client code for elements nothing renders any more. No source file produces these attributes, and `goals-tree-ui` / `goals-document-ui` already assert several of them are absent:
- **Goals tree search:** the `[data-tree-search]` listeners and composition state, `[data-personal-search]`, and the stored `query`.
- **Refresh:** replacing the archive and trash links (`[data-archive-link]`, `[data-trash-link]`).
- **Dead handlers:** `[data-close-work-planning]`, `[data-open-goal-tui]`, `[data-immersive-theme]`, `[data-feed-directory-title]`.
- **Selectors:** `[data-risk-*]` and `[data-artifact-select]`.
- **Strip CSS:**
  - The strip's own `[hidden]` rule. The element has no other `display`, so the browser's default rule hides it.
  - The work chip's hover and focus selectors, shortened while keeping the same specificity order.

## Out of scope (recorded)
Selecting in an Assistant reply is not yet "in hand": the page's DOM selection reader skips `[data-assistant-island]`. Putting a reply passage into the left cursor is therefore not wired. This is BL-149, after W3-B3 (统筹 10-16).

## 防腐复查
- **Contracts, events, actions:**
  - One optional contract field, with the API snapshot refreshed and the impact stated above.
  - No new DOM event; one more listener for the registered `molis:surface-landing`.
  - No action, MCP or Manifest change.
  - No compat path or read fallback.
- **Owners and authority:**
  - The landing is a claim. The Host re-reads the object from its owner with the caller's authority before telling the model, and drops it otherwise.
  - Trusted identity comes from the work's scope, not the input.
  - The read is H3's single function (`readReferences`, with `confirmReferences` derived from it), not a second reader.
- **Model weakness:** no prompt prohibitions, regexes or special cases. The material is facts only.
- **Hot files:**
  - `assistant-service.ts` has no line growth (−1); the logic is in `assistant-landing.ts`.
  - `assistant-island.ts` only shrinks.
  - `client.ts` and `context-bus.ts` are untouched.
- **Gates:**
  - `check-health-gates --base origin/main` passes. No giant-unit growth.
  - No limits, baseline, exception, biome or allowlist touched.
  - Page assets only go down.
  - `secrets:check` passes.
- **Assertions:** none skipped, relaxed or deleted.
- **Data:** the real Home was not touched; all walks and tests ran on isolated temporary Homes.

merged_since_previous.title: feat(coding): the coordinator holds board-read and board-report, so a child it yields to reports its step (P4-C1, 统筹 10-17 定 A)
merged_since_previous.body:
P4-C1. Coding's coordinator now holds `board-read` and `board-report`, so a child it yields to can report the step it was handed, and the parent's wait on that step is satisfied. Before this, the wait always failed. This was decision 统筹 10-17 定 A (spec §6.0i and §7.7).

## What changes

- `plugins/native/coding/src/roles.ts`: the coordinator role goes from v13 to v14 and gains `board-read` and `board-report`.
  - The child roles (`coding-reader`, `coding-reviewer`) and every prompt are unchanged. The SDK gives a bound child the board tools its parent holds (T12), so the Host's child tool list doesn't change.
  - The boundary is still the Host's board hook (`prologue-taskboard.ts`): a session reads only its own project's board and reports only the steps it holds.
- Behavior change the person sees: the `STEP_TOOLS` check now passes for the coordinator too. A person who picks 协作 with a confirmed plan used to be refused (「当前角色未开放计划回报工具」); that round now runs the plan. The second test asserts this (统筹 10-17).

## Tests

| File | New or changed | What it proves |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tests/coding-coordinator-board.test.ts`, test 1 | new (PA-11 slice; fixture model; imports package names only) | A yielded child reports its own step, the parent's wait is `satisfied` and the continuation `eligible`. Reporting that step again in the next round returns `TASKBOARD_CONFLICT`. Reading or reporting another project's board is refused by the hook. Reporting a step another session of the same project holds returns `TASKBOARD_NOT_ASSIGNED`, and that session's plan is unchanged. Red on main: the coordinator's round fails. |
| `tests/coding-coordinator-board.test.ts`, test 2 | new (PA-09, plan part) | 协作 started with a two-step confirmed plan is not refused; both steps are held by the round's session and reported `running` → `succeeded` in order. With the coordinator's board tools removed, it fails with that exact refusal. |
| `tests/prologue-adoption-guard.test.ts` | comment only | The PA-23 comment now points at the new test. Its assertions are unchanged: that child only answers and never reports, so its wait still fails. |

Run locally (all passed): the files `node scripts/affected-tests.mjs --base origin/main` selected, plus `coding-step-claims`, `agent-prompt-layers`, `prologue-writer-authority`, `prologue-review-child-command`, `prologue-subagent-turns`, `prologue-node-start-order`, `coding-continuation`, `coding-queued-round`, `coding-collab-handoff` and `prologue-project-board`.
Also passed: `check-health-gates --base origin/main`, `boundary:check` and `secrets:check`. I didn't run the full suite or the browser tests; the coordinator is running the full suite.

## What else this slice checked and left in place

Spec §4.6.9's Coding line listed several things to delete in P4. I checked each one; none goes in this slice. The reasons are in the §6.0i table:

- **`following` debounce steer**: the SDK doesn't pass board step changes to a live run. Its continuation passes only the wait's result, and a subtask's writeback passes only the final report. Deleting `following` needs a Prologue change first.
- **2-hour claim expiry**: plan steps carry no waits, so there is no generation or wait deadline to read. The rule only changes what's displayed, and the person set it.
- **`last-start:<session>`**: P3a decided that Coding starts continuations itself. The run's `AgentFrozenStart` has no intent, provider, workspace id, actor or `origin_task`.
- **`wake-note:<wait>`**: `control` has no place to record why a start failed. To be revisited in C2, when `control` gains `retry` and `resolve-reconciliation`.
- **`busy` / `waking`**: in-process concurrency gates, not facts.

## MiniMax walk (7 runs, a throwaway isolated Home each, deleted afterwards)

- Every answer was correct (7/7), and in all 7 runs the child called `board-report` on its own step.
- In the 2 runs where the coordinator yielded, the wait was satisfied and the next round answered from the child's result.
- In the other 5, the coordinator dispatched in the foreground even though the person asked it to yield. That's classified 拿不准: the coordinator prompt doesn't say when to yield. Per §11 I didn't change the prompt.

## Page assets

`tooling/gates/page-assets.json` is unchanged. `roles.ts` isn't imported by any Coding client file, so this PR doesn't need to wait in the page-asset queue.

## 防腐复查

- No compatibility path and no read fallback. No new typed capability and no new action.
- No giant unit grows. The new test file imports package names only, so test-internal imports stay at 0.
- The role version is bumped (v13 → v14); prompt versions are unchanged.
- No gate, baseline, limit or exception file is touched, and no assertion is loosened. The PA-23 test keeps its assertions.
- Files kept off-limits until #616 merged weren't touched.

merged_since_previous.title: test(adoption): PPT's pre-dispatch check and a change receipt that survives micro-compaction get their own assertions (A5, §6.0h)
merged_since_previous.body:
## 为什么

`specs/prologue-adoption` §6.0b 核对时，第 2 项（模型派出前授权）和第 5 项（修改回执不被微压缩）的实现都在 main 上，但各缺一条证据。这个 PR 是 A5 补这两条，只加用例，不改源码。

## 改了什么

- **第 2 项**：`tests/action-before-effect.test.ts` 的撤权、停用、取消循环加上 PPT（`ppt.outline_ai`）。断言和另外五个插件一样：模型请求一次都没发出（`dispatched === 0`），库没有变化，恢复授权后能写入。
- **第 5 项**：`tests/assistant-business-gateway.test.ts` 加一条请求级用例，用真实网关和助理：
  1. 先经审批做一次修改，回执 800 多字节；
  2. 再读五次，每次结果也是 800 多字节；
  3. 看最后一次请求：第一次读的结果已被压成 `[observation compacted: read-capability …]`，修改回执完整还在。
  - 回执在请求里的位置比第一次读还早，所以它没被压缩只能是因为效果种类（`mutate-external` 不能再读）。SDK 默认的压缩档（保留最近 4 轮工具调用、小于 512 字节的不压）Molis 没有改。
- spec 新增 §6.0h，记录这两条证据。

## 新用例在哪几个文件、CI 里谁跑

| 文件 | 新增的用例 | CI 里谁跑 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tests/action-before-effect.test.ts` | `ppt: revoked / disabled / cancelled during model wait …` 三条（循环里加 PPT） | 不在 `tests/ci-product-subset.txt` 里，要靠全量 |
| `tests/assistant-business-gateway.test.ts` | `a change's receipt survives micro-compaction in the next request; an older read's result is compacted (§6.0b item 5)` | 在产品子集里（第 26 行），`product-subset` 作业会跑 |

没有新建测试文件。

## 验证

- 在 main `6696a15be` 上两条都直接通过，说明实现本来就对。
- 两个文件整份跑过：`action-before-effect` 23/23，`assistant-business-gateway` 50/50。
- 变异检查：
  - 把构建产物里 PPT 交给模型口的 `beforeDispatch` 去掉，PPT 三条都变红；还原后通过。
  - 把 `change-capability` 改成 `safe-read` 的试法不算证明：那样连审批都被跳过，这一条是等审批超时才失败的，不是回执断言失败。能区分两种情况的是上面那组对照。
- `check-health-gates --base origin/main`、`boundary:check`、`secrets:check` 都通过。本机没跑全量；`action-before-effect` 只在全量里跑，所以需要 full-suite 标签（由统筹加）。

## 防腐复查

- 只改 `tests/` 和 spec，源码、合同、门禁、基线、例外文件都没动。
- 新的 PPT 断言沿用现有的循环，没有为它开特例。
- 压缩用例写在已有的测试文件里，测试引用包内部的计数不增加；没有新的 `any` 或 `as unknown as`。
- 没有放宽、跳过或删除任何断言。

merged_since_previous.title: feat(receipts): 3c — one supplement receipt for Coding and the Assistant, the AI's claim apart from the run's fact, said once on the status region (RCPT-311–313)
merged_since_previous.body:
This is stage 3c of specs/ai-input-receipts. It builds on 3a (#614).
- Merge-base: main `769d1179` (after #611 and #616).
- Plan: `receipts-3c-plan.md` in the coordination notes.
- The coordinator decided D24–D28 and D33 on 2026-10-16. The user approved D25 (bytes) the same day through the coordinator's popup.

## What changes

**Coding and the Assistant now use one supplement receipt** (RCPT-311–313).
- **The receipt.** `packages/design-system/src/input-receipts-client.ts` holds `createInputReceipts(L)`. It is a typed module, shipped as `INPUT_RECEIPTS_CLIENT_SCRIPT`.
- **One copy per page.** The workbench creates it once, the same way as `host.interaction`. The Assistant receives it as `receipts`, and plugins receive it through the deferred-client host (Coding takes `host.receipts`). The arrival chooser's Assistant gets its own copy.
- **What Coding and the Assistant drop.** Their own state-word tables, `receipt()`/`line()` and the `.coding-turn-receipt` / `.assistant-receipt` styles are deleted.

**What the receipt shows** (§3.3; the words are R0's reviewed labels):
- **Fact line.** Comes only from `steer.state`.
- **Question line.** Shows only when a question about this input waits or went unanswered.
- **Claim line.** Shows only when 3a projected a `model_claim`. It is prefixed 「AI 说」 and drawn with a dashed rule, with no success colour or check mark.
- **Detail.** It opens in place (D26: also at 390, no bottom drawer), in two groups:
  - **运行记录** (the run's record): the input id, and each question with its `pending_id`.
  - **「AI 自己说的，Molis 没有核对」** (what the AI said, unchecked by Molis): treatment, targets, impacts, the AI's own words, and where they came from.
- **Caveat.** 「读到不代表已遵循…」 is visible text in the detail, no longer a tooltip.
- **Notes the Host wrote.** They carry 「Molis 的说明，不是你发的话」 and no receipt. This is new in the Assistant (D27); Coding already did it.

**Screen readers** (RC-15, RCPT-312). This closes 1e's gap.
- Each receipt is `aria-live="off"`, so the Assistant's `role=log` does not read it.
- The component owns one visually hidden `role=status` per page. It says each change once and names the supplement, for example 「你的补充「…」：AI 已读到」.
- The first paint and an unchanged redraw say nothing, and focus never moves.
- A receipt is known by **its round and its input id** (D28).

**Scope** (D24). This PR covers the receipt bar and its in-place detail. The 「还没处理的」 tray and the correction menu ship with 3b, which brings their actions. Observed changes stay in 3d (D21).

**Catalog.** A new section on `/__ui/catalog`, 「补充的回执 / Input receipts」: every state in both layouts, plus a 「推进一步」 control that shows an in-place change and what the status region said.

**Spec.** D24–D28 and D33 are added to §14. D33: C1 is its own slice after 3c and can run alongside B.

## Behaviour that changes (expected, not relaxed)

- **RC-15, Assistant e2e.** 1e asserted 「a changed receipt is a new line」. The receipt now changes in place, so an open detail stays open. The test now asserts the node is still there with `aria-live=off`, and that the status region said 「你的补充「顺便看一下截图」：…」.
- **RC-12.** The caveat is read from `.mw-receipt__note` text instead of a `title`.
- **Tests moved, not deleted.** RC-12/RC-15's word and announcement checks moved from the two per-page unit tests to `tests/input-receipts-client.test.ts`, with the same expected words and the ids in the test names. That includes #605's two RC-15 cases (first paint silent; round + input id across rounds).
  - The per-page tests keep only what stays per page. The Assistant places one receipt per supplement and removes it. Coding keeps send modes, the sending bubble, same-key retry and the dropped reply.

## Gate change: one-time page-asset allowance (user approved 2026-10-16, 「用户 10-16 批准一次性放行」)

The approved increases were: workbench.js **+4,113**, workbench.css **+2,062**, arrival.css **+2,062**, coding.js **−558**.

Measured against merge-base `769d1179`:

| Asset | Merge-base budget → measured | Approved |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `workbench.js` | 1097095 → 1101205 (**+4110**) | +4,113 |
| `workbench.css` | 1688608 → 1690670 (**+2062**) | +2,062 |
| `arrival.css` | 810350 → 812412 (**+2062**) | +2,062 |
| `plugins/coding.js` | 433116 → 432592 (**−524**) | −558 |
| `settings.css` | 1102164 → 1102153 (**−11**) | not part of the approval (the old `.assistant-receipt` rules left craft-finish) |

- **Why coding.js shows −524 instead of −558.** Main moved under the branch (#605 and #613 changed Coding's bundle). The drop is what 3c removes, measured on today's base.
- **The allowance code** (`scripts/gates/page-assets.mjs` `APPROVED_CEILINGS`):
  - **Replaced:** #611 (W5-05 slice 1) had already deleted the object, `approvedCeiling` and 1e's five spent entries (#589: arrival.css, coding.js, settings.css, workbench.css, workbench.js). This PR brings back the same mechanism, unchanged: the object, `approvedCeiling`, and its two call sites (the head check and the base check).
  - **Now:** three 3c entries only (workbench.js, workbench.css, arrival.css). Each is keyed by the exact merge-base budget and capped at the measured size, which is at or under the approved amount.
  - **Deleted, no entry:** coding.js and settings.css both shrank, so their budgets were lowered with `--update --base origin/main`.
- **The test** (`tests/page-assets-budget.test.ts`):
  - **Added:** a 3c bounded-allowance test (#611 had already removed 1e's). Allowed sizes pass; one byte more fails; another asset fails; the frozen baseline has no allowance.
  - **Already done by #611:** 1e's five old sizes are on the 「spent increase」 list.
- **Commits.** As with 1e, the feature and the gate allowance are separate commits: `685df018e` (against `ea396a27`), then `fc3931994` re-keyed to `958946e2` after merging #611, then `371b58193` re-pinned workbench.js to `769d1179` after #616 lowered it (1097604 → 1097095; the CSS bases did not move).

## Checks

- `pnpm build` passed on the merge result.
- `node scripts/gates/page-assets.mjs --base origin/main` passed (25 assets), on the build of the merge with #611.
- `check-health-gates --base origin/main` passed. No giant unit grew:
  - `assistant-island.ts`: 2276 lines, unchanged.
  - `craft-finish.ts`: 2159 lines, unchanged.
  - Coding's `client.ts`: 1638 → 1637.
  - `assistant-send.ts`: 128 → 120.
  - The new component is 162 lines.
- API snapshots match; there is no contract change.
- Translations: 0 missing English. The receipt words moved from `assistant-en.ts` into the design-system dictionary `INPUT_RECEIPTS_EN`, so no translation conflict was added.
- `node scripts/affected-tests.mjs --base origin/main`:
  - After merging #611: all 114 files pass (108 unit, 6 browser). Before #611, on `ea396a27`: 110 unit and 4 browser, all passing.
  - Browser files, all pass: `assistant-input-receipts` 3/3, `coding-input-receipts` 1/1, `input-receipts-slice` 10/10, `coding-question-card` 3/3.

releases.name: GoalBoard v0.2.0 — 事件工作流与 Runtime 简化
releases.body:
# GoalBoard v0.2.0 — 事件工作流与 Runtime 简化

这一版让 GoalBoard 更专注于保存工作事实、呈现当前差距和承接下一步。AI 可以按任务选择推进方法，普通工作不再要求先领取角色、建立 Run 或填完固定拆解模板；正式修改承诺、人工验收和完成结论仍有明确边界。

## 目标阅读与导航

- Goal 详情从五个分类页签收敛为当前整体进展、时间线和事件阅读。查看历史时仍能看到当前要求与差距，成果、决定和材料保留来源与定位。
- 可以先保存一句目标意图，再逐步补充事实、结果与要求。Web、首次引导、Feed/Inbox、MCP 和树结构创建使用同一个新建入口。
- 修复窄窗口点击「目标」却被详情遮挡的问题；目录、目标列表、聚焦与运行之间往返保留当前上下文，刷新后恢复所选视图。
- 推进态势缩窄后继续显示，点击「目标」可返回完整列表；导航保持单一选中项，支持键盘切换，触区和焦点行为同步改善。

## Runtime 与 MCP

- Runtime 工具从 57 个收敛为 35 个，移除旧 Claim、Run、Evidence、Review、Draft Dialogue 等执行入口及其写入实现。
- 绑定项目后，普通工具由 Host 注入项目和操作者；Runtime 仍明确传入目标 ID，减少重复参数并避免误写另一个目标。
- 普通笔记无需预先定义事件类型。一次工作更新可提交多个事实和进展，回执直接给出当前状态与剩余差距。
- 非法报告批次整体回滚；原键重试和重启重放不会重复创建 Goal 或记录。连接刷新优先复用已有绑定。
- 工作发现、单 Goal 状态、目录和交接摘要读取一致的当前事实；已退休要求与旧执行状态不再制造当前待办。
- 切换页面上的 Goal 不会自动改绑终端或发送内容。已完成或已取消的 Goal 通过带原因的明确操作继续，普通无关笔记不自动重开。

## 约定、验收与历史

- 当前结果约定与要求共同决定完成是否成立；完成使用显式收尾，记录数量和材料存在不代表验收通过。
- 人工验收要求真实保存，Runtime 报告不能代替可信用户决定。仍然有效、适用范围相同的授权可以复用。
- 正式修改与收尾检查当前版本，过期请求在产生副作用前拒绝；普通日常记录不被扩大为审批流程。
- 事件类型可以演化，旧记录继续按原版本阅读。要求可以修订或退休，原始要求、报告和决定保留历史。

## 架构与安装

- 完成 workspace 包与产品入口收敛：Local Host 承担实际安装、服务和应用组合职责，Web 与桌面共享工作台和业务事实。
- 清理退役协议的适配、注册和无用代码，保留真实 Session、终端进程、文件版本、历史查询和数据库升级能力。
- 安装器校验源码与构建产物的一致性；同版本内容更新也会刷新程序与共享 Skill，失败可恢复上一份程序。
- 修复重复构建把桌面缓存和旧 Runtime 包再次打入新包的问题；安装内容和更新检测遵守同一发布文件范围，保留运行代码、声明资产和原生依赖。

## 兼容与升级

**本版包含 Runtime 接口调整。** 旧工具名不再可调用，已有 Runtime 必须加载新版 MCP 与 `goal-advance` Skill，并新开 Session 后继续工作。

- 旧项目有数据库升级路径。Goal、关系、原始说明和历史执行／证据／审查记录保留；迁入的历史完成会明确标记，后续工作使用当前事件流程。
- 升级前停止 GoalBoard 写入进程，并完整备份 GoalBoard Home，保留 Catalog、项目、Session、配置和加密材料；不要只复制单个项目数据库。
- 更新 Core／App 后，检查常驻服务和已经接入的 Runtime。旧会话不会自动重载工具，不能作为新版运行证据。
- 安装和启动本身不会替用户创建项目、重新绑定 Runtime、启动目标工作或重置演示数据。

## 发布范围与验证

完整测试 647 项通过，0 失败、0 跳过。已验证当前事件主流程、旧库升级与历史读取、失败重试与重启恢复、临时及本机安装／升级，以及桌面和窄窗口的关键交互。终端渲染或模型推理速度没有在本版作性能收益声明。

本次 GitHub Release 提供版本标签与源码。公开 macOS 安装包将在完成 Developer ID 签名和 Apple 公证后提供；本机内部构建不等同于已公证的公开发行包。

维护补充：全新 workspace 的 CI 验证顺序已在发布后的 [c58a6ec](https://github.com/molis-ai/GoalBoard/commit/c58a6ec61cdfb32c73bebfa6ab626bd766b7cd72) 修正为先构建依赖、再检查类型。这项维护修复位于 main；v0.2.0 标签和本版运行程序保持不变。

**完整变更：** [v0.1.14...v0.2.0](https://github.com/molis-ai/GoalBoard/compare/v0.1.14...v0.2.0)

releases.name: GoalBoard v0.1.14
releases.body:
这次发布集中升级了 Goal 的连续推进、首次使用、Session 工作记录和整体桌面体验，并修复了超大 Codex Session 会拖垮服务的问题。

## 新增与升级

- **连续 Goal 行动流**：统一为“可继续、进行中、等你、等待中、受阻、已完成”六种状态，每个 Goal 都有稳定的下一步主动作。
- **自动生命周期收口**：Runtime 完成职责后自动释放 Claim；证据和门禁满足后自动完成 Goal，返工、反证或 Contract 修订时可重新打开，并同步影响父 Goal 与依赖关系。
- **更可靠的人工决策**：Human Review 可在可信对话中一次确认；Risk 只把必须由用户承担的接受决策送入 Decision Center，减少重复确认。
- **Goal Contract 修订**：Accepted Goal 可以保留身份进行 revision，记录变更影响，并明确恢复需要返工或重新验证的下游。
- **首次使用 Onboarding**：空安装可通过四步引导创建真实 Project、根 Draft Goal，并选择工作目录与 Runtime；初始化内容只预填，不会自动发送。
- **Sessions 工作记录重做**：整合工作目录、“新建 / 关联已有 Session”、结构化目录选择器、按日期时间流、搜索、事件筛选、技术输出折叠、关系与 Goal 历史。
- **Feed 富内容**：安全渲染 GitHub 风格 Markdown 与常用内嵌 HTML，支持链接、列表、引用、代码、表格和折叠详情，同时过滤脚本与危险链接。
- **Runtime 与 MCP 连续性**：统一动作投影与写入回执，支持过期 action token 安全恢复、唯一工作区自动连接和数据库驱动的 Session 恢复。

## 体验优化

- 完成桌面、窄屏、手机布局，以及 Light、Dark、System 三种主题的整体校验和优化。
- Sessions 目录、时间流、关系区和新建弹窗升级为更清晰的高信息密度布局。
- Goal Tree 展开父节点自动收紧，折叠后恢复完整标题与子项进度，依赖门禁持续可见。
- 统一项目入口、浅色页签、目录箭头、依赖提案深色主题和 Runtime 状态标签。
- 修正窄屏 Settings、Diagnostics 间距、Work 标签、Session 工具栏、长内容换行，以及 Feed / Inbox 空状态表达。

## 关键修复

- **修复超大 Codex Session 崩溃**：改为读取元数据和最近 50 个 Turn 的分页摘要，不再一次加载完整历史。
- Codex JSONL Transport 改为增量 Buffer 解析，并加入 16 MiB 单响应上限；异常会安全失败并重建进程，不再带崩 GoalBoard Web 服务。
- 大型 Session 会提示仅展示最近历史，同时继续合并 GoalBoard 本地事件作为可验证记录。
- 修复迁移、自动完成/重开、返工、Review、Risk、Contract revision、父子 Goal 传播与并发 token 的边界问题。
- 从 v0.1.13 升级会保留 Project、Goal、Session 关系、设置和历史记录。

## 验证

- 475 项 Node 测试、12 项 Rust 测试、TypeScript 类型检查与版本一致性检查全部通过。
- 已完成空安装、Onboarding、重启、v0.1.13 数据升级、真实超大 Session，以及主要模块的端到端和视觉验证。

> macOS 正式安装包将在完成 Apple Developer ID 签名和公证后补充；当前标签与代码已发布。

**完整变更**：[v0.1.13...v0.1.14](https://github.com/adeptify/GoalBoard/compare/v0.1.13...v0.1.14)

releases.name: GoalBoard Desktop v0.1.11 — Human Handoffs & Semantic Replanning
releases.body:
## GoalBoard v0.1.11 Preview

这是未使用 Developer ID 签名、未经过 Apple 公证的 Preview。请只从本仓库下载；首次打开仍需在 macOS“系统设置 → 隐私与安全性”中明确允许。

这一版把 v0.1.8 之后已经在真实 CGS、Arena 和 GoalBoard Casebook 流程中暴露的交接、证据、恢复和界面问题合到同一个可下载版本。重点不是增加一层流程，而是让 Runtime 在已有事实上继续推进，并把真正需要用户决定的事项说清楚。

### 这次更新了什么

- **人工验收不再要求重复抄写**：唯一待决人工事项可把当前对话中的明确原话、来源和 Evidence 安全交接到 Inbox 预填；最终 Human Review 仍由用户本人提交，Runtime 不能冒充审批人。
- **Goal Tree 变更后主动提示语义复核**：Proposal 成功落地后会区分“结构校验通过”和“现有 Contract 仍需复核”，返回受影响的祖先、下游消费者、相邻上游依赖、复核顺序和下一动作；不会自动改树。
- **复杂 Goal Tree 修订更可恢复**：Native Proposal 可以直接 supersede raw 或 synthetic legacy Contract Proposal；精确整份确认、部分失败恢复和 Run→Review release handoff 都给出可执行动作。
- **Available 不再隐藏关键去向**：已替代 Goal 退出可领取队列，依赖受阻 Goal 保留摘要和恢复路径；选择前要求核对完整 Contract 的 in_scope/out_of_scope，减少误领和 Evidence 污染。
- **Evidence 支持真实工作区形态**：跨仓 `file:///` 可以保留 locator 与 digest 并明确标为 UNVERIFIED；同一 canonical Git 仓库正式登记的隔离 worktree 文件可验证、记录实际根并安全打开；大文件不再因无法预览而整条拒绝。
- **Goal Tree 与依赖视图更可读**：顶部工作标签滚动而不重叠；Goal Tree 分栏可继续拉宽，长中文标题完整换行，同时保留 Runtime 使用的 G2A、G2B/C、G2G/V2 等短引用与状态。
- **升级后的服务交接更可靠**：Desktop 更新 Core 后会修复 owned LaunchAgent 的 release PATH，避免健康页面仍运行旧 Runtime；版本一致性在打包前由四处源文件共同校验。
- **长流程收口后继续推进**：完成 Run、提交 Evidence/Review、release 后，Skill 会重新读取 Available，并固定汇报下一 Goal、动作、why-now、是否能自主继续及真正缺少的用户决定。
- **Casebook 集成契约进入源码**：新增授权规划导出与公开 Showcase 工件的 schema、fixtures 和合同回归，保留公开/私有数据边界。

### 下载

- Apple Silicon：`GoalBoard-0.1.11-macos-arm64.dmg`
- Intel Mac：`GoalBoard-0.1.11-macos-x64.dmg`
- `.app.zip` 用于手动部署与调试；普通用户优先下载 DMG。
- 每个安装包都附有独立 SHA-256 校验文件。

### 验证

- TypeScript 构建、typecheck 与完整自动化回归：338/338 通过。
- macOS Desktop Rust：12/12 通过，Rust format 与发布版本一致性门禁通过。
- Apple Silicon 本地 App/DMG 构建、包内版本回读、App/内嵌 Node 架构、严格 codesign、构建指纹与 SHA-256 sidecar 校验通过。
- GitHub Actions 从同一 `main` 提交分别生成 Apple Silicon 与 Intel 资产；Release 发布后回读资产名称、大小和 digest。

### 已知边界

- 当前 Release 是 Preview，不含 Developer ID 签名与 Apple 公证，会触发 Gatekeeper。
- 当前没有自动更新器。
- Runtime Session 不会热加载新 MCP/Skill；升级后新建 Session 才能读取 0.1.11 的协议改进。
- 对话人工验收仍保留最后一次用户提交；本版减少重复录入，但没有把 Runtime 提升为 human approver。
- GB49（双轨战略分组表达）与 GB50（旧 Session 跨仓 Evidence 复现）截至发布时只完成分析，没有作为已修复功能进入本版。
- Bug 台账继续分开记录工程验证、最终交付物实操和用户本人验收；自动化测试不会被当作用户验收。

**完整变更**：[v0.1.8...v0.1.11](https://github.com/adeptify/GoalBoard/compare/v0.1.8...v0.1.11)

releases.name: GoalBoard Desktop v0.1.8 — Runtime Continuity & Auditable Decisions
releases.body:
## GoalBoard v0.1.8 Preview

这是未使用 Developer ID 签名、未经过 Apple 公证的 Preview。请只从本仓库下载；首次打开仍需在 macOS“系统设置 → 隐私与安全性”中明确允许。

这一版集中修复 Runtime 连续推进、Goal Tree 决策和 Evidence 审计中的真实摩擦。用户现在更容易把 Agent 口中的编号对应到 Goal Tree，也不会因为租约、历史状态或完成门禁被引导去重复执行已经做过的工作。

### 这次更新了什么

- **Runtime 连续推进更可靠**：已绑定 Session 的生命周期调用可以安全刷新并重试；过期 Claim/Run 会统一显示为可恢复状态；长任务可在同一 Claim/Run 上续租。
- **完成门禁不再伪装成“还没执行”**：实现已结束但验收被新反证推翻时，会明确给出 rework 恢复动作；`completion` Risk 只约束完成，不阻止合法修复。
- **Goal Tree 编号可以和 Runtime 对上**：树中显示稳定、唯一、可读的短引用；编号碰撞会确定性消歧，同时保留中文标题。
- **Goal Tree 提案先检查、再原子落地**：preflight 与 decide 共用不变量校验，提前报告 accepted Contract、criterion/item ID、baseline 等冲突；整份确认不会留下只改了一半的孤立子图。
- **提案对人更容易理解**：大型变更保存“原问题 → 修改 → 预期效果”、主链路、非目标和逐项影响；关系方向与 `leaf_readiness` 枚举直接出现在 MCP schema 和修复建议里。
- **Legacy 与 Native 提案只保留一份当前真相**：旧 Contract/Rewire handle 可以统一 read/check/decide；等价的 Native 变更会把旧提案标为已替代，避免重复确认。
- **Evidence 更适合真实项目**：支持项目内绝对路径、`repo:`/`project://`、Markdown anchor；大文件可凭 locator 与 digest 登记为不可预览，而不是整条拒绝。
- **人工验收和 Runtime 复核分开**：只剩真人判断时明确显示 `waiting_for_human`；Goal 深链自动展开并可安全预填对话中的结论、原话和 Evidence，用户最多做一次清晰确认。
- **大型项目的 MCP 输出更克制**：Available 默认返回紧凑摘要；Planning Methods 可按需读取正文；Draft Dialogue 默认只返回本轮增量，避免长历史挤满上下文。
- **服务恢复更可信**：LaunchAgent PID 与监听者归属统一判断；配置需要修复时给出正确动作；Desktop 不再与已受管 Web 服务抢占端口。
- **已替代 Goal 不再诱导领取**：replacement 生效后旧 Goal 保留为历史，但退出 Ready、Available 与 select。

### 下载

- Apple Silicon：`GoalBoard-0.1.8-macos-arm64.dmg`
- Intel Mac：`GoalBoard-0.1.8-macos-x64.dmg`
- `.app.zip` 用于手动部署与调试；普通用户优先下载 DMG。
- 每个安装包都附有独立 SHA-256 校验文件。

- macOS Desktop Rust 测试、Apple Silicon 本地 DMG/App zip 构建、版本回读、严格 codesign 与 SHA-256 校验通过。
- GitHub Actions 从 `main` 分别构建 Apple Silicon 与 Intel 产物；Release 上传后再次回读资产名称、大小和 digest。

### 已知边界

- 当前 Release 是 Preview，不含 Developer ID 签名与 Apple 公证，会触发 Gatekeeper。
- 当前没有自动更新器。
- Runtime Session 不会热加载新 MCP/Skill；升级后新建 Session 才能读取 0.1.8 的协议改进。

releases.name: GoalBoard Desktop v0.1.5 — Continuous Work & Contract Clarity
releases.body:
## GoalBoard Desktop Preview v0.1.5

这一版重点解决“工作明明在继续，却被系统显示成没开始”和“局部完成被理解成整体能力完成”两类误导，同时把 Web 与 Desktop 收束为同一个个人工作台。

> **Preview：本版本使用开发签名，尚未完成 Apple Developer ID 签名和公证。** macOS Gatekeeper 可能提示无法验证开发者；请只从本仓库下载，并在确认来源后通过“系统设置 → 隐私与安全性”允许打开。

### 下载

- Apple Silicon（M1/M2/M3/M4…）：`GoalBoard-0.1.5-macos-arm64.dmg`
- Intel Mac：`GoalBoard-0.1.5-macos-x64.dmg`
- `.app.zip` 用于手动部署与调试；普通用户优先下载 DMG。
- 每个安装包都附有独立 SHA-256 校验文件。

### 这次最重要的变化

- **长任务可以续租**：活跃 Claim 会显示剩余时间与临期状态，执行者可以在同一 Claim/Run 上幂等续租，不必因为实现和 review 超过 30 分钟而重新领取、割裂证据链。
- **人工验收不再伪装成 Runtime 待复核**：当工程复核已经完成、只剩 Owner 的真实判断时，状态变为 `waiting_for_human`，Runtime 不会反复领取同一 self-verifier 工作。
- **Goal Tree 提案契约可自描述**：MCP schema 和错误信息直接给出 goal、relation、dependency、risk 等 payload 的必填字段、方向语义与最小示例，消费者不再需要查 TypeScript 源码猜参数。
- **父子 Contract 不再静默降级**：关闭复合 Goal 前必须记录父级 promised output / acceptance criterion 到具体子 Contract 字段的覆盖映射；局部样本、形式验收或缺少集成的结果会保持为未覆盖或需集成，不再自动提升成父级能力完成。
- **Risk 解决依据可回读**：将 Risk 标记为 resolved 时必须记录总结、Evidence 引用和剩余缺口，历史 Risk 不会被伪造补全，新决策可以看见“为什么认为已解决、还没解决什么”。
- **Web 与 Desktop 统一为一个工作台**：两端共享项目、Goal Tree、Focus、Runtime 和编辑面，Desktop 只增加原生窗口与 PTY 能力，减少两套界面状态不一致。

### 用户体验差异

- 修复前：长任务过期后又显示 `execution_pending`；修复后：原 Claim 可续租，临期动作明确。
- 修复前：只剩真人决策时 Runtime 仍显示 ready；修复后：明确等待 Owner，不再进入复核循环。
- 修复前：子 Goal 做出几个样本也可能让父 Goal 看起来已完成；修复后：父级每项承诺必须能追到子 Contract 的具体产物或验收字段，缺口保持可见。
- 修复前：集成方要查源码构造 Goal Tree payload；修复后：工具契约本身给出合法结构和修正示例。

### 已验证

- 完整 TypeScript、Web、安装升级、Runtime/MCP 与端到端测试：273/273 通过。
- GitHub Actions 从 `main` 提交 `97b971e` 分别构建 Apple Silicon 与 Intel 产物。
- 两种架构的 DMG 与 App ZIP 均通过产物自带 SHA-256 的独立复核。
- 两种架构 App 的 `CFBundleShortVersionString` 与 `CFBundleVersion` 均为 `0.1.5`。

### Known limits

- 尚未 Apple notarize，会触发 Gatekeeper。
- 尚无自动更新器。
- 当前仅提供 macOS 13+。
- GB-20260829-13 的 Opportunity 研究过程展示归属于 CGS 产品实现，不在本次 GoalBoard 包中冒充已修复。

**完整变更**：[v0.1.2...v0.1.5](https://github.com/adeptify/GoalBoard/compare/v0.1.2...v0.1.5)

releases.name: GoalBoard Desktop v0.1.2 — Calm Workbench
releases.body:
## macOS Desktop Preview 更新

这一版把 GoalBoard 从“功能都在，但视觉和路径彼此打架”，整理成一套更安静、更紧凑、更容易读懂的桌面工作台。Goal Tree、Focus 与 Runtime 仍然使用同一份本地事实，只是现在更容易看清目标、下一步、依赖和正在运行的工作。

> **Preview：本版本使用开发签名，尚未完成 Apple Developer ID 签名和公证。** macOS Gatekeeper 可能提示无法验证开发者；请只从本仓库下载，并在确认来源后通过“系统设置 → 隐私与安全性”允许打开。

- Intel Mac：`GoalBoard-0.1.2-macos-x64.dmg`

- 每个安装包都附有独立 SHA-256 校验文件。

### 这次最重要的变化

- **Calm Desktop 工作台**：重新组织整体层级、留白、字体、边框和背景，让项目、Goal 导航与 Focus 正文成为连续但彼此有边界的工作空间。
- **真正可感知的紧凑模式**：Goal Tree 与右侧正文同步降低间距和控件高度，在窄窗与中等宽度下保留信息密度，不再只是名称变化。
- **更清楚的项目与系统设置**：语言、外观、密度和终端主题集中到系统设置；项目切换与项目设置回到项目上下文，不再占据顶栏或重复出现齿轮入口。
- **统一的 Focus 信息结构**：当前、上下文、进展、关系、记录使用一致的横向 Section 卡片；卡片保持位置稳定，详情在下方展开，摘要不再截断，关系信息也改为对齐的可读结构。
- **更易扫读的 Goal 列表**：等待、就绪、澄清、阻塞、完成等状态改为克制的标签，层级线、依赖摘要与中间宽度布局得到修正。
- **Runtime 视觉边界**：应用工具栏与终端画布分开着色，终端可独立选择跟随界面、浅色或深色主题，并保持文字对比度。
- **macOS 桌面体验**：恢复本地化的菜单栏工作胶囊，增强窗口与进程恢复边界，并换用新的 GoalBoard App 图标。
- **文档与展示更新**：README 改为英文优先的产品页，补充中文指南和经过隐私处理的 Goal、Focus、Runtime 与桌面工作台截图。

### 已验证

- TypeScript、Web、安装升级和端到端流程：209 项测试通过。
- 视觉基础与菜单栏工作胶囊：22 项测试通过。
- Rust Desktop：10 项测试通过。
- `package.json`、Tauri 配置与 Cargo 包版本一致为 `0.1.2`。
- Apple Silicon 与 Intel 产物均由 GitHub Actions 从提交 `17876b3` 构建，并附独立 SHA-256 校验文件。
- 两种架构的 DMG 与 App ZIP SHA-256 均通过下载后的独立复核。

### Known limits

- 尚未 Apple notarize，会触发 Gatekeeper。
- 尚无自动更新器。
- 当前仅提供 macOS 13+。

**完整变更**：[v0.1.1...v0.1.2](https://github.com/adeptify/GoalBoard/compare/v0.1.1...v0.1.2)
